pertanyaan: Sebuah perusahaan menggunakan jaringan operator untuk menghubungkan main enterprise site dengan beberapa branch office. Modul Cisco Enterprise Architecture manakah yang merepresentasikan bagian jaringan milik provider yang menyediakan konektivitas tersebut?
opsi_a: Enterprise Campus
opsi_b: Enterprise Edge
opsi_c: Service Provider Edge
opsi_d: Remote Locations
pembahasan: Service Provider Edge merepresentasikan bagian sisi provider yang menyediakan konektivitas antara main enterprise site dan remote locations. Enterprise Edge masih berada pada domain perusahaan, sedangkan Remote Locations merupakan lokasi enterprise yang dihubungkan melalui layanan tersebut.

pertanyaan: A company uses a carrier network to connect its main enterprise site to several branch offices. Which Cisco Enterprise Architecture module represents the provider-owned portion that delivers this connectivity?
opsi_a: Enterprise Campus
opsi_b: Enterprise Edge
opsi_c: Service Provider Edge
opsi_d: Remote Locations
pembahasan: Service Provider Edge represents the provider-side portion that delivers connectivity between the main enterprise site and remote locations. Enterprise Edge remains within the enterprise domain, while Remote Locations are the enterprise sites reached through the service.

pertanyaan: Manakah deskripsi yang paling tepat mengenai Enterprise Campus?
opsi_a: Jaringan enterprise dalam fixed geographic area seperti satu gedung atau beberapa gedung yang saling terhubung
opsi_b: Jaringan backbone milik ISP yang membawa traffic beberapa pelanggan
opsi_c: Seluruh jaringan perusahaan yang berada di luar main office
opsi_d: Bagian jaringan operator yang men-terminate koneksi MPLS pelanggan
pembahasan: Enterprise Campus mencakup jaringan enterprise dalam fixed geographic area, misalnya satu gedung, universitas, atau beberapa gedung dalam sebuah kompleks. Backbone ISP dan terminasi layanan provider termasuk domain service provider, bukan Enterprise Campus.

pertanyaan: Which description best matches an Enterprise Campus?
opsi_a: An enterprise network within a fixed geographic area such as one building or a group of interconnected buildings
opsi_b: An ISP backbone carrying traffic for multiple customers
opsi_c: All company networks located outside the main office
opsi_d: The carrier portion that terminates customer MPLS connectivity
pembahasan: An Enterprise Campus covers an enterprise network within a fixed geographic area, such as a building, university, or group of buildings in a complex. ISP backbones and provider service termination belong to the service provider domain, not the Enterprise Campus.

pertanyaan: Dalam traditional three-tier Enterprise Campus architecture, urutan layer dari tempat endpoint terhubung menuju backbone utama adalah apa?
opsi_a: Distribution, Access, Core
opsi_b: Access, Distribution, Core
opsi_c: Access, Core, Distribution
opsi_d: Core, Access, Distribution
pembahasan: Endpoint pertama kali terhubung ke Access Layer. Traffic kemudian menuju Distribution Layer sebelum mencapai Core Layer yang berfungsi sebagai backbone utama campus.

pertanyaan: In a traditional three-tier Enterprise Campus architecture, what is the layer order from endpoint attachment toward the main backbone?
opsi_a: Distribution, Access, Core
opsi_b: Access, Distribution, Core
opsi_c: Access, Core, Distribution
opsi_d: Core, Access, Distribution
pembahasan: Endpoints first attach to the Access Layer. Traffic then reaches the Distribution Layer before reaching the Core Layer, which provides the primary campus backbone.

pertanyaan: Sebuah switch digunakan untuk menghubungkan PC, printer, IP phone, dan wireless access point secara langsung. Dalam three-tier campus design, switch tersebut paling sesuai menjalankan fungsi layer apa?
opsi_a: Core Layer
opsi_b: Service Provider Edge
opsi_c: Distribution Layer
opsi_d: Access Layer
pembahasan: Access Layer merupakan titik attachment utama bagi endpoint seperti PC, IP phone, printer, dan AP. Distribution mengagregasi access switch, sedangkan Core berfungsi sebagai backbone dan bukan titik koneksi langsung endpoint.

pertanyaan: A switch directly connects PCs, printers, IP phones, and wireless access points. In a three-tier campus design, which layer function does this switch most appropriately perform?
opsi_a: Core Layer
opsi_b: Service Provider Edge
opsi_c: Distribution Layer
opsi_d: Access Layer
pembahasan: The Access Layer is the primary attachment point for endpoints such as PCs, IP phones, printers, and APs. Distribution aggregates access switches, while Core provides backbone transport rather than direct endpoint connectivity.

pertanyaan: Sebuah perusahaan ingin menempatkan inter-VLAN routing, route filtering, summarization, dan first-hop redundancy di antara kelompok access switch dan backbone campus. Layer manakah yang paling sesuai?
opsi_a: Access Layer
opsi_b: Distribution Layer
opsi_c: Core Layer
opsi_d: Service Provider Edge
pembahasan: Distribution Layer merupakan titik yang umum untuk mengagregasi Access Layer sekaligus menyediakan Layer 3 boundary dan policy. Access berfokus pada endpoint, sedangkan Core sebaiknya tetap sederhana dan dioptimalkan untuk forwarding cepat.

pertanyaan: A company wants to place inter-VLAN routing, route filtering, summarization, and first-hop redundancy between groups of access switches and the campus backbone. Which layer is the most appropriate?
opsi_a: Access Layer
opsi_b: Distribution Layer
opsi_c: Core Layer
opsi_d: Service Provider Edge
pembahasan: The Distribution Layer commonly aggregates the Access Layer while providing Layer 3 boundaries and policy functions. Access focuses on endpoints, while the Core should remain relatively simple and optimized for fast forwarding.

pertanyaan: Seorang engineer berencana menambahkan banyak ACL kompleks dan packet inspection langsung pada Core Layer. Mengapa desain tersebut umumnya kurang ideal?
opsi_a: Core Layer seharusnya hanya beroperasi pada Layer 2
opsi_b: Core Layer seharusnya digunakan khusus untuk koneksi server data center
opsi_c: Core Layer sebaiknya memprioritaskan forwarding yang cepat, resilient, dan low-latency dengan complex policy seminimal mungkin
opsi_d: Core Layer tidak boleh menjalankan routing protocol
pembahasan: Core Layer dirancang sebagai backbone yang menyediakan forwarding cepat dan resilient, sehingga policy kompleks sebaiknya tidak membebani jalur inti jika dapat ditempatkan pada layer yang lebih sesuai. Core tetap dapat menjalankan Layer 3 dan routing protocol; masalahnya bukan karena fungsi tersebut dilarang.

pertanyaan: An engineer plans to add extensive complex ACLs and packet inspection directly to the Core Layer. Why is this generally less desirable?
opsi_a: The Core Layer must operate only at Layer 2
opsi_b: The Core Layer should be used exclusively for data center server connections
opsi_c: The Core Layer should prioritize fast, resilient, low-latency forwarding with minimal complex policy
opsi_d: The Core Layer is not allowed to run routing protocols
pembahasan: The Core Layer is designed as a backbone providing fast and resilient forwarding, so complex policies should avoid burdening the core path when they can be placed at a more appropriate layer. The Core can still operate at Layer 3 and run routing protocols; those functions are not inherently prohibited.

pertanyaan: Pada sebuah modern data center, setiap leaf switch memiliki koneksi menuju setiap spine switch dan beberapa equal-cost path tersedia di antara leaf. Arsitektur apakah yang digunakan?
opsi_a: Spine-leaf
opsi_b: Collapsed core
opsi_c: Hub-and-spoke
opsi_d: Traditional three-tier campus
pembahasan: Spine-leaf menggunakan leaf dan spine sebagai dua tier utama, dengan setiap leaf terhubung ke seluruh spine. Desain ini memberikan beberapa jalur yang konsisten dan cocok untuk penggunaan ECMP di data center.

pertanyaan: In a modern data center, every leaf switch connects to every spine switch, providing multiple equal-cost paths between leaf switches. Which architecture is being used?
opsi_a: Spine-leaf
opsi_b: Collapsed core
opsi_c: Hub-and-spoke
opsi_d: Traditional three-tier campus
pembahasan: Spine-leaf uses leaf and spine as its two primary tiers, with each leaf connected to every spine. This provides multiple consistent paths and is well suited to ECMP in a data center.

pertanyaan: Sebuah perusahaan ingin mengelompokkan fungsi Internet connectivity, remote-access VPN, site-to-site VPN, dan koneksi menuju layanan WAN provider dalam satu area arsitektur. Modul manakah yang paling sesuai?
opsi_a: Enterprise Campus
opsi_b: Remote Locations
opsi_c: Service Provider Edge
opsi_d: Enterprise Edge
pembahasan: Enterprise Edge menjadi perantara antara jaringan internal enterprise dan jaringan eksternal. Area ini dapat mencakup Internet connectivity, VPN, serta WAN connectivity menuju layanan provider seperti MPLS atau Metro Ethernet.

pertanyaan: A company wants to group Internet connectivity, remote-access VPN, site-to-site VPN, and connectivity to provider WAN services into one architectural area. Which module best fits these functions?
opsi_a: Enterprise Campus
opsi_b: Remote Locations
opsi_c: Service Provider Edge
opsi_d: Enterprise Edge
pembahasan: Enterprise Edge acts as the intermediary between the internal enterprise network and external networks. It can include Internet connectivity, VPN services, and WAN connectivity to provider services such as MPLS or Metro Ethernet.

pertanyaan: Manakah pernyataan yang paling tepat membedakan remote-access VPN dengan site-to-site VPN?
opsi_a: Remote-access VPN hanya digunakan melalui MPLS, sedangkan site-to-site VPN hanya melalui Internet
opsi_b: Remote-access VPN menghubungkan dua branch router, sedangkan site-to-site VPN hanya menghubungkan satu laptop
opsi_c: Remote-access VPN biasanya menghubungkan individual user atau device ke enterprise, sedangkan site-to-site VPN menghubungkan network pada dua lokasi
opsi_d: Keduanya merupakan istilah berbeda untuk fungsi yang sama
pembahasan: Remote-access VPN biasanya digunakan oleh individual user atau endpoint untuk mengakses jaringan perusahaan. Site-to-site VPN menghubungkan network pada lokasi yang berbeda, misalnya branch network dengan headquarters network.

pertanyaan: Which statement best distinguishes remote-access VPN from site-to-site VPN?
opsi_a: Remote-access VPN is used only over MPLS, while site-to-site VPN is used only over the Internet
opsi_b: Remote-access VPN connects two branch routers, while site-to-site VPN connects only a single laptop
opsi_c: Remote-access VPN typically connects an individual user or device to the enterprise, while site-to-site VPN connects networks at two locations
opsi_d: They are different terms for the same function
pembahasan: Remote-access VPN is typically used by an individual user or endpoint to reach the enterprise network. Site-to-site VPN connects networks at different locations, such as a branch network and a headquarters network.

pertanyaan: Manakah kelompok yang seluruh anggotanya merupakan contoh Remote Locations?
opsi_a: Core Layer, Branch Office, Teleworker
opsi_b: Branch Office, Teleworker, Remote Data Center
opsi_c: ISP, MPLS Provider, Remote Data Center
opsi_d: WAN Edge, Branch Office, Internet Edge
pembahasan: Remote Locations dapat berupa Branch Office, Teleworker, dan Remote Data Center yang secara geografis terpisah dari main enterprise site. Core Layer dan Enterprise Edge bukan remote location, sedangkan ISP dan MPLS Provider merupakan infrastruktur provider.

pertanyaan: Which group contains only examples of Remote Locations?
opsi_a: Core Layer, Branch Office, Teleworker
opsi_b: Branch Office, Teleworker, Remote Data Center
opsi_c: ISP, MPLS Provider, Remote Data Center
opsi_d: WAN Edge, Branch Office, Internet Edge
pembahasan: Remote Locations can include Branch Offices, Teleworkers, and Remote Data Centers that are geographically separated from the main enterprise site. Core Layer and Enterprise Edge are not remote locations, while ISP and MPLS Provider represent provider infrastructure.

pertanyaan: Sebuah routed link utama mengalami failure. Routing protocol melakukan reconvergence dan traffic otomatis menggunakan backup path sehingga layanan tetap tersedia. Karakteristik jaringan apakah yang paling langsung ditunjukkan?
opsi_a: Self-healing
opsi_b: Self-aware
opsi_c: Self-defending
opsi_d: Self-optimizing
pembahasan: Self-healing menggambarkan kemampuan jaringan mempertahankan atau memulihkan layanan ketika terjadi failure, misalnya melalui redundancy dan routing convergence. Self-aware hanya mendeteksi kondisi, sedangkan self-optimizing dan self-defending mempunyai tujuan utama yang berbeda.

pertanyaan: A primary routed link fails. The routing protocol reconverges and traffic automatically uses a backup path so that service remains available. Which network characteristic is demonstrated most directly?
opsi_a: Self-healing
opsi_b: Self-aware
opsi_c: Self-defending
opsi_d: Self-optimizing
pembahasan: Self-healing describes the network's ability to maintain or restore service after a failure, for example through redundancy and routing convergence. Self-aware is focused on recognizing conditions, while self-optimizing and self-defending serve different primary purposes.

pertanyaan: Sebuah perusahaan menerapkan 802.1X, firewall policy, ACL, segmentation, dan kontrol authentication untuk membatasi unauthorized access. Konsep desain apakah yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Self-aware
opsi_b: Self-optimizing
opsi_c: Self-healing
opsi_d: Self-defending
pembahasan: Self-defending berfokus pada perlindungan jaringan, user, device, dan resource perusahaan dari unauthorized atau malicious access. Mekanisme pada skenario terutama merupakan security controls, bukan mekanisme recovery atau optimization.

pertanyaan: A company implements 802.1X, firewall policies, ACLs, segmentation, and authentication controls to restrict unauthorized access. Which design concept best applies?
opsi_a: Self-aware
opsi_b: Self-optimizing
opsi_c: Self-healing
opsi_d: Self-defending
pembahasan: Self-defending focuses on protecting the network, users, devices, and enterprise resources from unauthorized or malicious access. The mechanisms in the scenario are primarily security controls rather than recovery or optimization mechanisms.

pertanyaan: Dua WAN path sama-sama aktif. Policy mengarahkan voice yang sensitif terhadap latency melalui path dengan latency lebih rendah, sedangkan bulk file transfer menggunakan path lainnya. Karakteristik apakah yang paling tepat menggambarkan tindakan tersebut?
opsi_a: Self-healing
opsi_b: Self-optimizing
opsi_c: Self-defending
opsi_d: Self-aware
pembahasan: Self-optimizing berarti jaringan menyesuaikan penggunaan resource berdasarkan kebutuhan aplikasi atau kondisi jaringan. Self-aware dapat menyediakan data latency sebagai input, tetapi tindakan memilih path yang lebih sesuai merupakan optimization.

pertanyaan: Two WAN paths are operational. A policy sends latency-sensitive voice traffic over the lower-latency path while bulk file transfers use the other path. Which characteristic best describes this action?
opsi_a: Self-healing
opsi_b: Self-optimizing
opsi_c: Self-defending
opsi_d: Self-aware
pembahasan: Self-optimizing means adapting network resource usage to application requirements or network conditions. Self-aware mechanisms may provide latency information as input, but selecting the more appropriate path is the optimization action.

pertanyaan: Sebuah network management system mengumpulkan SNMP information, Syslog messages, flow data, dan streaming telemetry untuk memberikan visibility terhadap aktivitas dan kondisi jaringan. Konsep apakah yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Self-healing
opsi_b: Self-defending
opsi_c: Self-aware
opsi_d: Self-optimizing
pembahasan: Self-aware berarti jaringan memiliki visibility dan insight terhadap aktivitas serta kondisinya. SNMP, Syslog, flow information, dan telemetry membantu menyediakan informasi yang kemudian dapat digunakan untuk troubleshooting atau automation.

pertanyaan: A network management system collects SNMP information, Syslog messages, flow data, and streaming telemetry to provide visibility into network activity and conditions. Which concept best applies?
opsi_a: Self-healing
opsi_b: Self-defending
opsi_c: Self-aware
opsi_d: Self-optimizing
pembahasan: Self-aware means that the network provides visibility and insight into its activity and condition. SNMP, Syslog, flow information, and telemetry can provide information that is later used for troubleshooting or automation.

pertanyaan: Sebuah perusahaan akan mengganti teknologi WAN tanpa ingin mendesain ulang access, distribution, dan core campus. Mengapa modular enterprise architecture membantu memenuhi tujuan tersebut?
opsi_a: Perubahan dapat difokuskan pada functional module yang terkait sehingga bagian jaringan lain tidak perlu diubah jika tidak terdampak
opsi_b: Setiap module otomatis menggunakan konfigurasi dan protocol yang identik
opsi_c: Modular design membuat redundancy tidak lagi diperlukan
opsi_d: Seluruh fungsi WAN, security, dan QoS selalu ditempatkan pada Core Layer
pembahasan: Modular architecture memisahkan jaringan berdasarkan fungsi sehingga perubahan pada satu area dapat lebih mudah dibatasi pada module yang relevan. Modularitas tidak mewajibkan protocol yang identik, tidak menghilangkan kebutuhan redundancy, dan tidak memusatkan seluruh policy di Core.

pertanyaan: A company plans to replace its WAN technology without redesigning the campus access, distribution, and core. Why does a modular enterprise architecture help achieve this goal?
opsi_a: The change can be focused on the relevant functional module so other network areas do not need modification when unaffected
opsi_b: Every module automatically uses identical configurations and protocols
opsi_c: A modular design eliminates the need for redundancy
opsi_d: All WAN, security, and QoS functions are always placed in the Core Layer
pembahasan: A modular architecture separates the network by function, allowing a change in one area to be contained within the relevant module when other areas are unaffected. Modularity does not require identical protocols, eliminate redundancy, or place all policy functions in the Core.

pertanyaan: Sebuah campus network memiliki 300 end device yang ditempatkan dalam satu VLAN dan satu subnet besar menggunakan switch Layer 2. Apa konsekuensi utama dari desain flat network tersebut?
opsi_a: Broadcast dan flooding dapat menjangkau lebih banyak perangkat dalam broadcast domain yang sama
opsi_b: Setiap switch otomatis membuat broadcast domain sendiri meskipun VLAN-nya sama
opsi_c: Router akan otomatis membagi subnet berdasarkan jumlah host
opsi_d: STP akan mengubah setiap access port menjadi routed port
pembahasan: Pada flat network, banyak host berada pada broadcast domain yang sama sehingga traffic seperti ARP dan DHCP broadcast dapat menjangkau banyak perangkat. Secara teknis jaringan tetap memiliki subnet, tetapi tidak disegmentasi menjadi beberapa subnet yang lebih kecil. Opsi lain salah karena switch Layer 2 tidak otomatis membuat subnet dan STP tidak melakukan routing.

pertanyaan: A campus network has 300 end devices placed in one VLAN and one large subnet using Layer 2 switches. What is the main consequence of this flat network design?
opsi_a: Broadcasts and flooding can reach more devices within the same broadcast domain
opsi_b: Each switch automatically creates its own broadcast domain even when the VLAN is the same
opsi_c: The router automatically divides the subnet based on the number of hosts
opsi_d: STP converts every access port into a routed port
pembahasan: In a flat network, many hosts share the same broadcast domain, so traffic such as ARP and DHCP broadcasts can reach many devices. Technically the network still has a subnet, but it is not segmented into multiple smaller subnets. The other choices are incorrect because Layer 2 switches do not automatically create subnets and STP does not perform routing.

pertanyaan: Host pada VLAN 10 mengirim ARP broadcast. VLAN 10 dan VLAN 20 memiliki SVI berbeda pada Layer 3 switch yang sama. Apa yang terjadi terhadap ARP broadcast tersebut?
opsi_a: Broadcast diteruskan ke VLAN 20 selama kedua VLAN berada pada switch yang sama
opsi_b: Broadcast berhenti pada batas Layer 3 dan tidak dirutekan ke VLAN 20
opsi_c: Broadcast diteruskan ke VLAN 20 jika STP dalam keadaan forwarding
opsi_d: Broadcast selalu diteruskan ke seluruh VLAN yang memiliki default gateway
pembahasan: Router atau Layer 3 switch menjadi batas broadcast domain. ARP broadcast dari VLAN 10 tidak dirutekan ke VLAN 20; komunikasi antar-subnet dilakukan melalui routing setelah host mengirim traffic ke default gateway. Lokasi kedua SVI pada perangkat fisik yang sama tidak menggabungkan broadcast domain keduanya.

pertanyaan: A host in VLAN 10 sends an ARP broadcast. VLAN 10 and VLAN 20 have different SVIs on the same Layer 3 switch. What happens to the ARP broadcast?
opsi_a: The broadcast is forwarded to VLAN 20 as long as both VLANs are on the same switch
opsi_b: The broadcast stops at the Layer 3 boundary and is not routed into VLAN 20
opsi_c: The broadcast is forwarded to VLAN 20 if STP is in the forwarding state
opsi_d: The broadcast is always forwarded to every VLAN that has a default gateway
pembahasan: A router or Layer 3 switch forms a broadcast-domain boundary. An ARP broadcast from VLAN 10 is not routed into VLAN 20; communication between the subnets occurs through routing after the host sends traffic to its default gateway. Having both SVIs on the same physical device does not merge their broadcast domains.

pertanyaan: Sebuah perusahaan menambah gedung baru dengan distribution block dan beberapa access switch tanpa mendesain ulang gedung yang sudah ada. Karakteristik hierarchical design apa yang paling terlihat?
opsi_a: High-speed forwarding
opsi_b: VLAN stretching
opsi_c: Modularity dan scalability
opsi_d: Spanning-tree blocking
pembahasan: Hierarchical design membentuk jaringan menjadi blok-blok modular sehingga bagian baru dapat ditambahkan tanpa perubahan besar pada blok yang sudah ada. Kemampuan tersebut mendukung scalability. High-speed forwarding lebih berkaitan dengan fungsi core, sedangkan VLAN stretching dan STP blocking bukan tujuan utama penambahan modular.

pertanyaan: A company adds a new building with its own distribution block and several access switches without redesigning the existing buildings. Which hierarchical-design characteristic is demonstrated most clearly?
opsi_a: High-speed forwarding
opsi_b: VLAN stretching
opsi_c: Modularity and scalability
opsi_d: Spanning-tree blocking
pembahasan: Hierarchical design organizes the network into modular blocks, allowing a new block to be added without major changes to existing ones. This directly supports scalability. High-speed forwarding is more closely associated with the core, while VLAN stretching and STP blocking are not the primary goals of modular growth.

pertanyaan: Dalam hierarchical campus design, layer mana yang terutama menyediakan konektivitas langsung untuk PC, IP phone, printer, dan access point?
opsi_a: Core layer
opsi_b: Distribution layer
opsi_c: WAN edge layer
opsi_d: Access layer
pembahasan: Access layer merupakan titik tempat end device memperoleh akses ke jaringan. Fungsi yang umum meliputi VLAN assignment, PoE, 802.1X, port security, dan fitur edge lainnya. Distribution melakukan agregasi dan policy, sedangkan core menjadi backbone.

pertanyaan: In a hierarchical campus design, which layer primarily provides direct connectivity for PCs, IP phones, printers, and access points?
opsi_a: Core layer
opsi_b: Distribution layer
opsi_c: WAN edge layer
opsi_d: Access layer
pembahasan: The access layer is where end devices obtain network connectivity. Common functions include VLAN assignment, PoE, 802.1X, port security, and other edge features. The distribution layer performs aggregation and policy functions, while the core acts as the backbone.

pertanyaan: Fungsi mana yang paling sesuai ditempatkan pada distribution layer dalam hierarchical campus design?
opsi_a: Menghubungkan setiap workstation secara langsung
opsi_b: Mengagregasikan access switch serta menyediakan routing, policy, dan isolasi masalah
opsi_c: Menjadi jalur backbone dengan policy seminimal mungkin
opsi_d: Menggantikan kebutuhan subnet dan VLAN pada access layer
pembahasan: Distribution layer mengagregasikan access layer dan sering menjadi titik untuk inter-VLAN routing, filtering, route summarization, dan policy. Layer ini juga membantu membatasi fault domain. Koneksi end device merupakan fungsi access, sedangkan transport backbone berkecepatan tinggi merupakan fungsi core.

pertanyaan: Which function is most appropriately placed at the distribution layer in a hierarchical campus design?
opsi_a: Connecting every workstation directly
opsi_b: Aggregating access switches while providing routing, policy, and fault isolation
opsi_c: Acting as the backbone path with minimal policy processing
opsi_d: Eliminating the need for subnets and VLANs at the access layer
pembahasan: The distribution layer aggregates the access layer and commonly provides inter-VLAN routing, filtering, route summarization, and policy enforcement. It also helps contain fault domains. Direct end-device connectivity belongs to the access layer, while high-speed backbone transport belongs to the core.

pertanyaan: Mengapa core layer disebut high-speed backbone?
opsi_a: Karena core membawa traffic agregat antar-distribution block dengan kapasitas dan forwarding yang tinggi
opsi_b: Karena core harus menjadi default gateway untuk setiap user VLAN
opsi_c: Karena semua port user harus terhubung langsung ke core
opsi_d: Karena core bertugas memperluas broadcast domain ke seluruh campus
pembahasan: Core merupakan jalur transport utama antarbagian besar jaringan sehingga harus dapat menangani traffic agregat dengan cepat dan stabil. Core biasanya dirancang dengan kapasitas tinggi, redundancy, serta konfigurasi forwarding yang relatif sederhana. Menjadi gateway seluruh user atau memperluas broadcast domain bukan fungsi utama core.

pertanyaan: Why is the core layer described as a high-speed backbone?
opsi_a: Because the core carries aggregated traffic between distribution blocks with high capacity and forwarding performance
opsi_b: Because the core must be the default gateway for every user VLAN
opsi_c: Because every user-facing port must connect directly to the core
opsi_d: Because the core extends the broadcast domain across the entire campus
pembahasan: The core is the primary transport path between major parts of the network, so it must carry aggregated traffic quickly and reliably. It is commonly designed for high capacity, redundancy, and relatively simple forwarding. Acting as the gateway for every user or extending broadcast domains is not its primary role.

pertanyaan: Pernyataan mana yang paling tepat membedakan high availability dengan fast convergence?
opsi_a: High availability menentukan bandwidth link, sedangkan fast convergence menentukan jumlah VLAN
opsi_b: High availability berarti semua link aktif, sedangkan fast convergence berarti tidak menggunakan routing protocol
opsi_c: High availability menyediakan jalur atau perangkat alternatif, sedangkan fast convergence menentukan seberapa cepat jaringan pulih setelah perubahan
opsi_d: High availability hanya berlaku di Layer 2, sedangkan fast convergence hanya berlaku di Layer 3
pembahasan: High availability berfokus pada ketersediaan layanan melalui redundancy dan penghilangan single point of failure. Fast convergence berfokus pada seberapa cepat kegagalan terdeteksi dan jalur forwarding yang valid digunakan kembali. Keduanya berkaitan, tetapi bukan konsep yang sama.

pertanyaan: Which statement best distinguishes high availability from fast convergence?
opsi_a: High availability determines link bandwidth, while fast convergence determines the number of VLANs
opsi_b: High availability means all links are active, while fast convergence means routing protocols are not used
opsi_c: High availability provides an alternate path or device, while fast convergence determines how quickly the network recovers after a change
opsi_d: High availability applies only to Layer 2, while fast convergence applies only to Layer 3
pembahasan: High availability focuses on keeping services available through redundancy and removal of single points of failure. Fast convergence focuses on how quickly a failure is detected and a valid forwarding path is restored. The concepts support each other but are not identical.

pertanyaan: Sebuah campus memiliki Core-1 dan Core-2. Ketika Core-1 gagal, Core-2 tetap tersedia, tetapi routing membutuhkan sekitar 30 detik sebelum traffic kembali berjalan. Kesimpulan yang paling tepat adalah apa?
opsi_a: Jaringan memiliki fast convergence tetapi tidak memiliki high availability
opsi_b: Jaringan tidak memiliki high availability karena terjadi packet loss
opsi_c: Kedua konsep sudah terpenuhi karena ada dua core
opsi_d: High availability tersedia, tetapi convergence masih lambat
pembahasan: Core-2 merupakan jalur/perangkat alternatif sehingga desain memiliki redundancy dan mendukung high availability. Namun pemulihan selama sekitar 30 detik menunjukkan convergence belum cepat. Availability menjawab apakah alternatif tersedia, sedangkan convergence menjawab seberapa cepat alternatif digunakan.

pertanyaan: A campus has Core-1 and Core-2. When Core-1 fails, Core-2 remains available, but routing takes about 30 seconds before traffic resumes. What is the best conclusion?
opsi_a: The network has fast convergence but lacks high availability
opsi_b: The network lacks high availability because packet loss occurred
opsi_c: Both goals are fully achieved simply because two core switches exist
opsi_d: High availability is present, but convergence is still slow
pembahasan: Core-2 provides an alternate path or device, so the design has redundancy and supports high availability. However, a recovery time of about 30 seconds indicates that convergence is not fast. Availability asks whether an alternative exists, while convergence asks how quickly it is used.

pertanyaan: Sebuah enterprise merencanakan satu address block yang terstruktur untuk setiap gedung dan memungkinkan distribution switch mengiklankan summary route ke core. Bagaimana desain ini membantu scalability?
opsi_a: Core dapat mempelajari lebih sedikit route detail dan penambahan subnet lokal tidak selalu memerlukan perubahan besar di seluruh jaringan
opsi_b: Semua gedung dapat menggunakan subnet yang sama tanpa Layer 2 connectivity
opsi_c: STP tidak lagi diperlukan pada seluruh access port
opsi_d: Semua perangkat dapat menggunakan satu default gateway yang sama
pembahasan: Addressing yang terstruktur dan route summarization membantu menjaga routing table serta routing updates tetap lebih sederhana ketika jaringan berkembang. Penambahan subnet di dalam satu blok dapat disembunyikan di balik summary yang stabil. Hal ini berbeda dari menggunakan subnet yang sama di banyak lokasi atau menghilangkan STP secara keseluruhan.

pertanyaan: An enterprise assigns a structured address block to each building and allows the distribution switches to advertise summarized routes toward the core. How does this design improve scalability?
opsi_a: The core can learn fewer detailed routes, and adding local subnets does not always require major changes throughout the network
opsi_b: Every building can use the same subnet without Layer 2 connectivity
opsi_c: STP is no longer required on any access ports
opsi_d: Every device can use the same default gateway
pembahasan: Structured addressing and route summarization help keep routing tables and routing updates simpler as the network grows. Additional subnets inside a block can remain hidden behind a stable summary. This is different from reusing the same subnet across locations or eliminating STP everywhere.

pertanyaan: Pada traditional switched access design, access switch terhubung ke distribution switch menggunakan trunk Layer 2. Di mana default gateway user VLAN biasanya ditempatkan?
opsi_a: Pada setiap access port
opsi_b: Pada SVI di distribution layer
opsi_c: Pada routed interface di access switch
opsi_d: Pada core switch tanpa SVI
pembahasan: Pada switched access, Layer 2 domain membentang dari access menuju distribution dan VLAN diterminasi pada distribution layer. Karena itu SVI/default gateway user biasanya berada di distribution. Pada routed access, batas Layer 3 dipindahkan ke access switch.

pertanyaan: In a traditional switched-access design, the access switch connects to the distribution switches using Layer 2 trunks. Where is the user VLAN default gateway normally located?
opsi_a: On every access port
opsi_b: On an SVI at the distribution layer
opsi_c: On a routed interface at the access switch
opsi_d: On the core switch without an SVI
pembahasan: In switched access, the Layer 2 domain extends from the access layer to the distribution layer and VLANs terminate at distribution. Therefore, the user default gateway is commonly an SVI on the distribution switches. In routed access, the Layer 3 boundary moves down to the access switch.

pertanyaan: Sebuah access switch memiliki dua uplink trunk Layer 2 yang membentuk jalur redundant menuju dua distribution switch. Mengapa STP diperlukan pada desain tersebut?
opsi_a: Untuk memilih default gateway IP pada setiap host
opsi_b: Untuk menjalankan route summarization
opsi_c: Untuk mencegah loop Layer 2 dengan mengendalikan jalur forwarding redundant
opsi_d: Untuk mengubah kedua trunk menjadi routed link
pembahasan: Redundant Layer 2 paths dapat membentuk bridging loop. STP membangun topologi Layer 2 yang bebas loop dengan menentukan port forwarding dan, jika diperlukan, alternate/blocking. STP tidak melakukan route summarization atau mengubah trunk menjadi routed interface.

pertanyaan: An access switch has two Layer 2 trunk uplinks that create redundant paths toward two distribution switches. Why is STP required in this design?
opsi_a: To select the IP default gateway for every host
opsi_b: To perform route summarization
opsi_c: To prevent Layer 2 loops by controlling redundant forwarding paths
opsi_d: To convert both trunks into routed links
pembahasan: Redundant Layer 2 paths can create bridging loops. STP creates a loop-free Layer 2 topology by selecting forwarding ports and, when necessary, alternate or blocking ports. STP does not summarize routes or convert trunks into routed interfaces.

pertanyaan: Dalam routed access design, bagaimana hubungan Layer 2 dan Layer 3 yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: End device dan distribution tetap satu Layer 2 domain yang sama
opsi_b: Seluruh access port user harus dikonfigurasi sebagai routed port
opsi_c: Gateway user tetap berada di distribution tetapi uplink menjadi Layer 3
opsi_d: End device menggunakan Layer 2 ke access switch, sedangkan uplink access-to-distribution menggunakan Layer 3
pembahasan: Routed access tidak berarti seluruh port pada access switch menjadi Layer 3. Port user tetap dapat menjadi access/trunk Layer 2, tetapi SVI dan routing berada pada access switch, sementara uplink menuju distribution menjadi routed link. Dengan demikian batas Layer 2/Layer 3 berada di access layer.

pertanyaan: In a routed-access design, which description of the Layer 2 and Layer 3 boundaries is most accurate?
opsi_a: End devices and distribution remain in the same Layer 2 domain
opsi_b: Every user-facing access port must become a routed port
opsi_c: The user gateway remains at distribution while the uplinks become Layer 3
opsi_d: End devices use Layer 2 toward the access switch, while access-to-distribution uplinks use Layer 3
pembahasan: Routed access does not mean that every port on the access switch becomes Layer 3. User-facing ports can remain Layer 2 access or trunk ports, while the access switch owns the SVIs and routing and uses routed uplinks toward distribution. The Layer 2/Layer 3 boundary therefore moves into the access layer.

pertanyaan: Dalam routed access design disebutkan bahwa VLAN bersifat local. Apa arti pernyataan tersebut?
opsi_a: Satu access switch hanya boleh memiliki satu VLAN
opsi_b: Sebuah VLAN dan subnet biasanya dibatasi pada satu access switch atau access block dan tidak di-stretch melalui routed uplink
opsi_c: Setiap VLAN harus memiliki nomor yang berbeda pada seluruh enterprise meskipun tidak terhubung Layer 2
opsi_d: Inter-VLAN routing tidak dapat digunakan pada access switch
pembahasan: Local VLAN bukan berarti satu switch hanya boleh memiliki satu VLAN. Satu access switch dapat memiliki banyak VLAN, tetapi Layer 2 domain masing-masing VLAN biasanya berhenti pada access block tersebut. Routed uplink tidak membawa broadcast domain VLAN seperti trunk Layer 2.

pertanyaan: In a routed-access design, VLANs are described as local. What does this mean?
opsi_a: One access switch is allowed to have only one VLAN
opsi_b: A VLAN and subnet are normally confined to one access switch or access block and are not stretched across routed uplinks
opsi_c: Every VLAN must use a globally unique VLAN number across the enterprise even when no Layer 2 connection exists
opsi_d: Inter-VLAN routing cannot be performed on the access switch
pembahasan: A local VLAN does not mean that a switch can have only one VLAN. An access switch can support many VLANs, but each VLAN's Layer 2 domain normally ends within that access block. A routed uplink does not carry the VLAN broadcast domain in the way a Layer 2 trunk does.

pertanyaan:
Sebuah multilayer access switch menggunakan konfigurasi berikut:
[cli]
ip routing

interface Vlan10
 ip address 10.10.10.1 255.255.255.0

interface Vlan20
 ip address 10.10.20.1 255.255.255.0
[/cli]
PC-A berada di VLAN 10 dan PC-B berada di VLAN 20. Dengan asumsi kedua SVI dalam keadaan up dan host menggunakan default gateway yang benar, bagaimana komunikasi PC-A ke PC-B dilakukan?
opsi_a: Access switch melakukan inter-VLAN routing antara SVI VLAN 10 dan VLAN 20
opsi_b: Traffic harus terlebih dahulu di-bridge sebagai VLAN 10 hingga core
opsi_c: Komunikasi tidak dapat terjadi karena VLAN pada routed access harus berjumlah satu
opsi_d: STP menerjemahkan frame VLAN 10 menjadi VLAN 20
pembahasan: Perintah 'ip routing' memungkinkan multilayer switch merutekan traffic antar-SVI. PC-A mengirim traffic untuk subnet VLAN 20 ke default gateway VLAN 10, lalu switch merutekannya menuju SVI VLAN 20. Local VLAN tidak melarang satu access switch memiliki beberapa VLAN atau melakukan inter-VLAN routing.

pertanyaan:
A multilayer access switch uses the following configuration:
[cli]
ip routing

interface Vlan10
 ip address 10.10.10.1 255.255.255.0

interface Vlan20
 ip address 10.10.20.1 255.255.255.0
[/cli]
PC-A is in VLAN 10 and PC-B is in VLAN 20. Assuming both SVIs are up and the hosts use the correct default gateways, how is communication from PC-A to PC-B handled?
opsi_a: The access switch performs inter-VLAN routing between the VLAN 10 and VLAN 20 SVIs
opsi_b: Traffic must first be bridged as VLAN 10 all the way to the core
opsi_c: Communication is impossible because routed access permits only one VLAN per switch
opsi_d: STP translates VLAN 10 frames into VLAN 20 frames
pembahasan: The 'ip routing' command allows the multilayer switch to route traffic between its SVIs. PC-A sends traffic for the VLAN 20 subnet to its VLAN 10 default gateway, and the switch routes it toward the VLAN 20 SVI. Local VLANs do not prevent one access switch from hosting multiple VLANs or performing inter-VLAN routing.

pertanyaan: Access-SW1 dan Access-SW2 menggunakan routed uplink ke distribution. Seorang administrator menempatkan PC-A pada VLAN 10 subnet 10.10.10.0/24 di Access-SW1 dan PC-B juga pada subnet 10.10.10.0/24 di Access-SW2, tetapi tidak ada Layer 2 extension antara kedua access switch. Mengapa desain ini bermasalah?
opsi_a: OSPF tidak mendukung prefix /24 pada access layer
opsi_b: Nomor VLAN yang sama tidak boleh digunakan pada dua switch Cisco
opsi_c: Distribution switch akan otomatis melakukan NAT terhadap kedua subnet
opsi_d: PC-A menganggap PC-B berada pada subnet lokal dan menggunakan ARP, tetapi broadcast ARP tidak melintasi routed boundary
pembahasan: Host menentukan bahwa alamat dalam subnet yang sama adalah on-link sehingga PC-A mencoba menemukan MAC PC-B melalui ARP. Routed link tidak meneruskan broadcast ARP tersebut ke Layer 2 domain Access-SW2. Karena itu subnet yang sama tidak seharusnya dianggap sebagai satu LAN pada dua access block yang hanya terhubung melalui Layer 3.

pertanyaan: Access-SW1 and Access-SW2 use routed uplinks toward distribution. An administrator places PC-A in VLAN 10 subnet 10.10.10.0/24 on Access-SW1 and PC-B in the same 10.10.10.0/24 subnet on Access-SW2, but there is no Layer 2 extension between the two access switches. Why is this design problematic?
opsi_a: OSPF does not support /24 prefixes at the access layer
opsi_b: The same VLAN number cannot be configured on two Cisco switches
opsi_c: The distribution switch automatically performs NAT between the two subnets
opsi_d: PC-A considers PC-B to be on-link and uses ARP, but the ARP broadcast cannot cross the routed boundary
pembahasan: A host treats an address in its own subnet as directly connected, so PC-A attempts to discover PC-B's MAC address using ARP. The routed boundary does not forward that ARP broadcast into Access-SW2's Layer 2 domain. Therefore, the same subnet should not be treated as one LAN across two access blocks connected only by Layer 3.

pertanyaan: Access-SW1 memiliki VLAN ID 10 dengan subnet 10.10.10.0/24, sedangkan Access-SW2 juga memiliki VLAN ID 10 tetapi menggunakan subnet 10.10.20.0/24. Kedua switch hanya terhubung melalui routed links dan tidak ada Layer 2 extension. Pernyataan mana yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Kedua VLAN otomatis menjadi satu broadcast domain karena VLAN ID-nya sama
opsi_b: Konfigurasi tidak valid karena VLAN ID harus unik secara global
opsi_c: VLAN ID yang sama dapat ada secara independen; keduanya merupakan broadcast domain dan subnet yang berbeda
opsi_d: Kedua switch tidak dapat melakukan routing karena menggunakan VLAN ID yang sama
pembahasan: VLAN ID memiliki makna dalam domain Layer 2 tempat VLAN tersebut berada dan tidak otomatis menjadi identitas global antar-routed domain. Karena tidak ada Layer 2 extension, VLAN 10 pada kedua access switch merupakan broadcast domain yang terpisah. Subnet yang berbeda dapat dirutekan melalui infrastruktur Layer 3.

pertanyaan: Access-SW1 has VLAN ID 10 using subnet 10.10.10.0/24, while Access-SW2 also has VLAN ID 10 but uses subnet 10.10.20.0/24. The switches are connected only by routed links with no Layer 2 extension. Which statement is most accurate?
opsi_a: The two VLANs automatically become one broadcast domain because their VLAN IDs match
opsi_b: The configuration is invalid because VLAN IDs must be globally unique
opsi_c: The same VLAN ID can exist independently; the two instances are separate broadcast domains and subnets
opsi_d: The two switches cannot perform routing because they use the same VLAN ID
pembahasan: A VLAN ID has significance within the Layer 2 domain in which that VLAN exists and does not automatically form a global identity across routed domains. With no Layer 2 extension, VLAN 10 on each access switch is a separate broadcast domain. Their different IP subnets can communicate through Layer 3 routing.

pertanyaan:
Sebuah uplink pada Access-SW menggunakan konfigurasi berikut:
[cli]
interface TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1
 description UPLINK_TO_DIST1
 no switchport
 ip address 10.255.1.1 255.255.255.252
[/cli]
Desain access-to-distribution mana yang paling sesuai dengan konfigurasi tersebut?
opsi_a: Routed access dengan Layer 3 point-to-point uplink
opsi_b: Traditional switched access dengan trunk VLAN
opsi_c: Layer 2 access dengan STP blocking
opsi_d: Access link yang hanya digunakan untuk VLAN management
pembahasan: Perintah 'no switchport' menjadikan interface sebagai routed port dan IP /30 digunakan sebagai koneksi Layer 3 point-to-point. Ini merupakan ciri routed access. Pada switched access tradisional, uplink biasanya merupakan switchport trunk yang membawa VLAN.

pertanyaan:
An uplink on Access-SW uses the following configuration:
[cli]
interface TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1
 description UPLINK_TO_DIST1
 no switchport
 ip address 10.255.1.1 255.255.255.252
[/cli]
Which access-to-distribution design best matches this configuration?
opsi_a: Routed access using a Layer 3 point-to-point uplink
opsi_b: Traditional switched access using a VLAN trunk
opsi_c: Layer 2 access relying on STP blocking
opsi_d: An access link used only for the management VLAN
pembahasan: The 'no switchport' command makes the interface a routed port, and the /30 address is being used for a Layer 3 point-to-point connection. This is characteristic of routed access. In traditional switched access, the uplink is typically a switchport trunk carrying VLANs.

pertanyaan:
Sebuah access switch memiliki dua trunk Layer 2 menuju dua distribution switch. Potongan output ilustratif berikut ditampilkan:
[output]
Access-SW# show spanning-tree vlan 10

Interface       Role Sts
Gi1/0/49        Root FWD
Gi1/0/50        Altn BLK
[/output]
Tidak ada keluhan link fisik. Apa interpretasi yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Gi1/0/50 pasti mengalami kerusakan kabel
opsi_b: STP sengaja menempatkan Gi1/0/50 sebagai alternate/blocking untuk mencegah loop Layer 2 VLAN 10
opsi_c: VLAN 10 sedang dirutekan melalui Gi1/0/50
opsi_d: Kedua uplink harus diubah menjadi access port agar keduanya forwarding
pembahasan: Pada redundant Layer 2 topology, status alternate/blocking dapat merupakan hasil normal perhitungan STP. Port tersebut tidak digunakan untuk forwarding VLAN 10 agar loop tidak terbentuk, bukan berarti link fisiknya rusak. Pada routed access, STP tidak mengendalikan routed uplink seperti ini.

pertanyaan:
An access switch has two Layer 2 trunks toward two distribution switches. The following simplified illustrative output is displayed:
[output]
Access-SW# show spanning-tree vlan 10

Interface       Role Sts
Gi1/0/49        Root FWD
Gi1/0/50        Altn BLK
[/output]
There is no physical-link alarm. What is the best interpretation?
opsi_a: Gi1/0/50 must have a cabling failure
opsi_b: STP intentionally placed Gi1/0/50 in the alternate/blocking state to prevent a Layer 2 loop for VLAN 10
opsi_c: VLAN 10 is being routed through Gi1/0/50
opsi_d: Both uplinks must be converted to access ports so that both can forward
pembahasan: In a redundant Layer 2 topology, an alternate/blocking state can be a normal result of STP calculation. The port is prevented from forwarding VLAN 10 to maintain a loop-free topology; this does not mean that the physical link has failed. In routed access, STP does not control routed uplinks in this manner.

pertanyaan: Access-SW memiliki dua routed uplink menuju Dist-1 dan Dist-2. OSPF menghitung cost yang sama menuju suatu destination prefix melalui kedua distribution switch. Apa keuntungan yang mungkin diperoleh dibanding dual Layer 2 uplink yang salah satunya diblokir STP untuk VLAN tersebut?
opsi_a: Kedua link otomatis menjadi trunk VLAN yang sama
opsi_b: ARP broadcast dapat melintasi kedua routed uplink
opsi_c: STP dapat melakukan inter-VLAN routing pada kedua link
opsi_d: Kedua next hop dapat digunakan sebagai equal-cost paths tanpa STP memblokir routed uplink
pembahasan: Pada routed access, uplink merupakan Layer 3 links sehingga tidak membentuk bridging loop yang harus dihentikan STP. Jika routing protocol menghasilkan jalur equal-cost dan platform mendukung ECMP, kedua next hop dapat terpasang dan digunakan. Hal ini meningkatkan penggunaan bandwidth dibanding jalur Layer 2 yang harus diblokir untuk menjaga topologi bebas loop.

pertanyaan: Access-SW has two routed uplinks toward Dist-1 and Dist-2. OSPF calculates the same cost to a destination prefix through both distribution switches. What benefit may be gained compared with dual Layer 2 uplinks where STP blocks one path for that VLAN?
opsi_a: Both links automatically become trunks carrying the same VLAN
opsi_b: ARP broadcasts can cross both routed uplinks
opsi_c: STP can perform inter-VLAN routing over both links
opsi_d: Both next hops can be used as equal-cost paths without STP blocking the routed uplinks
pembahasan: In routed access, the uplinks are Layer 3 links and therefore do not create a bridging loop that STP must block. If the routing protocol produces equal-cost paths and the platform supports ECMP, both next hops can be installed and used. This can make better use of the available bandwidth than a Layer 2 path that must be blocked to maintain a loop-free topology.

pertanyaan:
Dalam switched access design, dua distribution switch menyediakan gateway redundant untuk VLAN 10. Potongan konfigurasi ilustratifnya adalah:
[cli]
Dist-1:
interface Vlan10
 ip address 10.10.10.2 255.255.255.0
 standby 10 ip 10.10.10.1

Dist-2:
interface Vlan10
 ip address 10.10.10.3 255.255.255.0
 standby 10 ip 10.10.10.1
[/cli]
Alamat mana yang seharusnya digunakan host VLAN 10 sebagai default gateway?
opsi_d: Alamat routed uplink menuju core
pembahasan: HSRP menyediakan virtual IP yang digunakan host sebagai default gateway, yaitu 10.10.10.1 pada contoh ini. Alamat .2 dan .3 merupakan alamat SVI fisik masing-masing distribution switch. Penggunaan FHRP umum pada switched access ketika gateway VLAN berada pada distribution layer.

pertanyaan:
In a switched-access design, two distribution switches provide a redundant gateway for VLAN 10. Their simplified illustrative configuration is:
[cli]
Dist-1:
interface Vlan10
 ip address 10.10.10.2 255.255.255.0
 standby 10 ip 10.10.10.1

Dist-2:
interface Vlan10
 ip address 10.10.10.3 255.255.255.0
 standby 10 ip 10.10.10.1
[/cli]
Which address should VLAN 10 hosts use as their default gateway?
opsi_d: The address of the routed uplink toward the core
pembahasan: HSRP provides the virtual IP used by hosts as their default gateway, which is 10.10.10.1 in this example. Addresses .2 and .3 are the physical SVI addresses of the individual distribution switches. FHRP is commonly used in switched-access designs where the VLAN gateway resides at the distribution layer.

pertanyaan: Dalam routed access design, VLAN 10 hanya berada pada Access-SW1 dan uplink ke distribution adalah Layer 3. Jika terjadi broadcast storm di VLAN 10 akibat loop pada port Layer 2 lokal, apa keuntungan desain tersebut dibanding VLAN 10 yang di-stretch ke banyak access switch?
opsi_a: Broadcast storm otomatis diubah menjadi unicast oleh OSPF
opsi_b: Layer 3 boundary membantu membatasi penyebaran broadcast/fault tersebut pada Layer 2 domain lokal
opsi_c: Distribution switch akan meneruskan broadcast ke semua routed access switch
opsi_d: Core dapat menghapus broadcast menggunakan route summarization
pembahasan: Layer 3 boundary tidak meneruskan broadcast Layer 2, sehingga fault seperti broadcast storm lebih mudah dibatasi pada domain lokal selama tidak ada mekanisme Layer 2 extension lain. Hal ini memperkecil failure domain dibanding VLAN yang membentang ke banyak access switch. OSPF dan summarization tidak mengubah broadcast menjadi unicast.

pertanyaan: In a routed-access design, VLAN 10 exists only on Access-SW1 and the uplinks toward distribution are Layer 3. If a local Layer 2 loop causes a broadcast storm in VLAN 10, what advantage does this design have over stretching VLAN 10 across many access switches?
opsi_a: OSPF automatically converts the broadcast storm into unicast traffic
opsi_b: The Layer 3 boundary helps contain the broadcast or fault within the local Layer 2 domain
opsi_c: The distribution switch forwards the broadcast to every routed access switch
opsi_d: The core removes the broadcast through route summarization
pembahasan: A Layer 3 boundary does not forward Layer 2 broadcasts, so a fault such as a broadcast storm can remain contained within the local domain as long as no other Layer 2 extension exists. This reduces the failure domain compared with a VLAN stretched across multiple access switches. OSPF and summarization do not convert broadcasts into unicast traffic.

pertanyaan: Sebuah campus berukuran kecil menggabungkan fungsi core dan distribution pada pasangan multilayer switch yang sama, sementara access layer tetap terpisah. Apa nama umum desain tersebut?
opsi_a: Flat campus
opsi_b: Routed VLAN core
opsi_c: Single-tier access
opsi_d: Collapsed core
pembahasan: Collapsed core menggabungkan fungsi core dan distribution pada satu perangkat atau pasangan perangkat karena skala jaringan belum membutuhkan tier core yang terpisah. Desain tersebut tetap hierarchical secara fungsi. Flat network berbeda karena tidak memiliki pemisahan fungsi dan segmentasi yang terstruktur seperti ini.

pertanyaan: A small campus combines the core and distribution functions on the same pair of multilayer switches while keeping the access layer separate. What is this design commonly called?
opsi_a: Flat campus
opsi_b: Routed VLAN core
opsi_c: Single-tier access
opsi_d: Collapsed core
pembahasan: A collapsed-core design combines the core and distribution functions on one device or pair of devices when the network does not require a separate core tier. The architecture remains hierarchical in function. A flat network lacks this structured functional segmentation.

pertanyaan: Tim desain mempertimbangkan menempatkan banyak ACL yang sangat kompleks, user authentication, dan policy yang sering berubah langsung pada core layer. Prinsip hierarchical design mana yang paling relevan untuk mengevaluasi keputusan ini?
opsi_a: Core sebaiknya fokus pada transport cepat, stabil, redundant, dan relatif sederhana
opsi_b: Core harus menjadi tempat seluruh policy user agar distribution tidak perlu routing
opsi_c: Core harus memperluas semua VLAN agar policy dapat diterapkan sekali
opsi_d: Semakin banyak fungsi pada core, semakin cepat convergence selalu terjadi
pembahasan: Core merupakan bagian kritis yang membawa traffic antar-distribution block, sehingga desain umumnya menjaga fungsi forwarding core tetap sederhana dan stabil. Policy yang dekat dengan user lebih lazim ditempatkan pada access atau distribution sesuai kebutuhan. Menambah kompleksitas tidak otomatis meningkatkan convergence atau availability.

pertanyaan: A design team is considering placing many complex ACLs, user-authentication functions, and frequently changing policies directly in the core layer. Which hierarchical-design principle is most relevant when evaluating this decision?
opsi_a: The core should primarily provide fast, stable, redundant, and relatively simple transport
opsi_b: The core should host all user policies so the distribution layer does not need routing
opsi_c: The core should extend every VLAN so that policy can be applied once
opsi_d: Adding more functions to the core always improves convergence speed
pembahasan: The core is a critical transport layer carrying traffic between distribution blocks, so designs generally keep core forwarding simple and stable. Policies close to users are more commonly applied at the access or distribution layers as appropriate. Increasing core complexity does not automatically improve convergence or availability.

pertanyaan: Sebuah organisasi membutuhkan Layer 2 access karena beberapa VLAN masih harus mencapai distribution, tetapi ingin kedua uplink access dapat aktif tanpa pola STP tradisional yang memblokir salah satunya. Distribution dapat dibangun sebagai satu logical switch menggunakan teknologi seperti StackWise Virtual. Desain mana yang paling sesuai?
opsi_a: Routed access dengan subnet user yang sama di semua access switch
opsi_b: Flat Layer 2 campus tanpa STP
opsi_c: Layer 2 access dengan simplified distribution dan EtherChannel dual-homing ke logical distribution switch
opsi_d: Menghapus seluruh redundancy dan menggunakan satu uplink access
pembahasan: Pada simplified distribution design, dua perangkat fisik distribution dapat beroperasi sebagai satu logical switch. Access switch dapat membentuk EtherChannel menuju logical system tersebut sehingga link anggota aktif tanpa menciptakan loop Layer 2 tradisional yang memerlukan satu uplink independen diblokir STP. Ini mempertahankan Layer 2 access tanpa harus mengubah access uplink menjadi routed links.

pertanyaan: An organization still requires Layer 2 access because some VLANs must reach the distribution layer, but it wants both access uplinks to be active without the traditional STP pattern of blocking one independent path. The distribution layer can operate as one logical switch using a technology such as StackWise Virtual. Which design best fits the requirement?
opsi_a: Routed access using the same user subnet on every access switch
opsi_b: A flat Layer 2 campus with STP removed
opsi_c: Layer 2 access with a simplified distribution design and EtherChannel dual-homing to the logical distribution switch
opsi_d: Removing all redundancy and using only one access uplink
pembahasan: In a simplified distribution design, two physical distribution devices can operate as one logical switch. The access switch can form an EtherChannel toward that logical system so member links can actively forward without creating the traditional independent Layer 2 loop that causes STP blocking. This retains Layer 2 access without converting the uplinks to routed links.

pertanyaan: Tim jaringan membangun routed access campus dan ingin dynamic routing yang mendukung scalability, fault tolerance, dan fast convergence. Pilihan desain mana yang paling sesuai dengan panduan routed access enterprise?
opsi_a: Menggunakan hanya default static route pada seluruh access switch tanpa redundancy
opsi_b: Menggunakan RIP pada access dan static route pada distribution
opsi_c: Menggunakan beberapa IGP berbeda pada setiap access block lalu melakukan redistribution secara luas
opsi_d: Menggunakan full-featured IGP seperti OSPF atau EIGRP secara konsisten pada routed campus
pembahasan: Routed access mendapat manfaat besar dari dynamic IGP yang mampu bereaksi terhadap perubahan topology dan mendukung desain redundant. Cisco secara historis merekomendasikan IGP seperti OSPF atau EIGRP untuk routed access dibanding desain yang sangat bergantung pada static route, RIP, atau redistribution kompleks. Pilihan yang konsisten juga menyederhanakan troubleshooting.

pertanyaan: A network team is building a routed-access campus and wants dynamic routing that supports scalability, fault tolerance, and fast convergence. Which design choice best aligns with enterprise routed-access guidance?
opsi_a: Using only a default static route on every access switch with no redundancy
opsi_b: Using RIP at the access layer and static routes at distribution
opsi_c: Using a different IGP in each access block and performing extensive redistribution
opsi_d: Using a full-featured IGP such as OSPF or EIGRP consistently across the routed campus
pembahasan: Routed access benefits from a dynamic IGP that can react to topology changes and support redundant paths. Cisco has historically recommended IGPs such as OSPF or EIGRP for routed-access designs instead of relying heavily on static routing, RIP, or complex redistribution. A consistent routing design also simplifies troubleshooting.

pertanyaan: Setiap gedung memiliki address block tersendiri, dan distribution layer mengiklankan satu summary menuju core. Selain mengurangi jumlah route pada core, manfaat desain apa yang paling relevan ketika satu subnet internal gedung mengalami perubahan?
opsi_a: Perubahan lokal dapat lebih mudah diisolasi sehingga tidak setiap detail route harus dipropagasikan ke seluruh campus
opsi_b: Semua host dalam gedung otomatis menjadi satu broadcast domain
opsi_c: STP tidak lagi diperlukan pada access switch
opsi_d: Summary route membuat semua jalur memiliki bandwidth yang sama
pembahasan: Hierarchical addressing dan summarization dapat membatasi dampak perubahan routing lokal pada bagian lain jaringan. Core dapat mempertahankan summary yang stabil walaupun detail internal suatu distribution block berubah. Summarization tidak menyatukan broadcast domain, menghapus kebutuhan STP pada port Layer 2, atau menyamakan bandwidth link.

pertanyaan: Each building has its own address block, and the distribution layer advertises one summary toward the core. In addition to reducing the number of routes in the core, what benefit is most relevant when an internal subnet in one building changes?
opsi_a: The local change can be better isolated so that every detailed route does not need to propagate throughout the campus
opsi_b: All hosts in the building automatically become one broadcast domain
opsi_c: STP is no longer required on the access switches
opsi_d: The summary route makes every path have equal bandwidth
pembahasan: Hierarchical addressing and summarization can limit the impact of local routing changes on the rest of the network. The core can retain a stable summary even when detailed routes inside a distribution block change. Summarization does not merge broadcast domains, eliminate STP from Layer 2 ports, or equalize link bandwidth.

pertanyaan:
Pada routed access, Access-SW menjalankan OSPF dan memiliki dua equal-cost uplink. Potongan output ilustratif berikut terlihat:
[output]
Access-SW# show ip route 10.20.0.0

O 10.20.0.0/16
  via 10.255.1.2, TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1
  via 10.255.2.2, TenGigabitEthernet1/1/2
[/output]
Apa interpretasi yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: STP telah memilih dua root port untuk VLAN yang sama
opsi_b: Kedua interface harus berada dalam satu VLAN trunk
opsi_c: Routing telah menyediakan dua equal-cost next hop yang dapat digunakan untuk ECMP
opsi_d: Prefix 10.20.0.0/16 merupakan connected network pada Access-SW
pembahasan: Output menunjukkan prefix OSPF dengan dua next hop melalui dua routed interface. Jika keduanya terpasang sebagai equal-cost paths, forwarding dapat memanfaatkan ECMP sesuai mekanisme platform. STP tidak menentukan jalur routing tersebut, dan prefix berstatus OSPF bukan connected.

pertanyaan:
In a routed-access design, Access-SW runs OSPF and has two equal-cost uplinks. The following simplified illustrative output is shown:
[output]
Access-SW# show ip route 10.20.0.0

O 10.20.0.0/16
  via 10.255.1.2, TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1
  via 10.255.2.2, TenGigabitEthernet1/1/2
[/output]
What is the best interpretation?
opsi_a: STP has selected two root ports for the same VLAN
opsi_b: Both interfaces must belong to the same VLAN trunk
opsi_c: Routing has installed two equal-cost next hops that can be used for ECMP
opsi_d: The 10.20.0.0/16 prefix is directly connected to Access-SW
pembahasan: The output shows an OSPF prefix with two next hops over two routed interfaces. When both are installed as equal-cost paths, forwarding can use ECMP according to the platform's behavior. STP does not select these routing paths, and an OSPF route is not a connected route.

pertanyaan:
Administrator sedang memverifikasi uplink Access-SW. Potongan output ilustratif menunjukkan:
[output]
Access-SW# show interfaces TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1 switchport
Name: Te1/1/1
Switchport: Disabled

Access-SW# show ip interface brief
Interface              IP-Address      Status  Protocol
Te1/1/1                10.255.1.1      up      up
[/output]
Apa kesimpulan paling tepat?
opsi_a: Interface adalah trunk Layer 2 tetapi VLAN belum dibuat
opsi_b: Interface bekerja sebagai routed Layer 3 port
opsi_c: Interface adalah access port pada native VLAN
opsi_d: Interface sedang diblokir STP
pembahasan: 'Switchport: Disabled' bersama IP address pada interface menunjukkan bahwa interface beroperasi sebagai routed port, bukan switchport Layer 2. Karena itu interface tersebut tidak menjadi trunk atau access port dan tidak dikendalikan STP sebagai jalur Layer 2 VLAN. Kondisi ini sesuai dengan routed uplink.

pertanyaan:
An administrator is verifying an Access-SW uplink. The following simplified illustrative output is shown:
[output]
Access-SW# show interfaces TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1 switchport
Name: Te1/1/1
Switchport: Disabled

Access-SW# show ip interface brief
Interface              IP-Address      Status  Protocol
Te1/1/1                10.255.1.1      up      up
[/output]
What is the best conclusion?
opsi_a: The interface is a Layer 2 trunk but the VLAN has not been created
opsi_b: The interface operates as a routed Layer 3 port
opsi_c: The interface is an access port in the native VLAN
opsi_d: The interface is being blocked by STP
pembahasan: 'Switchport: Disabled' together with an IP address on the interface indicates that the interface is operating as a routed port rather than a Layer 2 switchport. It is therefore not an access or trunk port and is not controlled by STP as a Layer 2 VLAN path. This is consistent with a routed uplink.

pertanyaan:
Sebuah access switch awalnya menggunakan uplink berikut:
[cli]
interface TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1
 switchport mode trunk
[/cli]
Desain baru mensyaratkan routed access dengan point-to-point IP adjacency menuju distribution. Perubahan prinsip konfigurasi apa yang paling tepat pada uplink tersebut?
opsi_a: Mengubah interface menjadi routed port dengan 'no switchport', memberikan IP point-to-point, lalu memasukkannya ke desain routing yang sesuai
opsi_b: Mempertahankan trunk dan menambahkan lebih banyak allowed VLAN
opsi_c: Mengubah trunk menjadi access port pada user VLAN
opsi_d: Mengaktifkan PortFast trunk agar interface dapat melakukan routing
pembahasan: Routed access membutuhkan Layer 3 uplink, sehingga switchport trunk harus diubah menjadi routed interface dan diberi addressing Layer 3 yang sesuai. Routing static atau dynamic kemudian harus menyediakan reachability melalui link tersebut sesuai desain. Menambah VLAN, menggunakan access mode, atau PortFast tidak mengubah interface menjadi routed uplink.

pertanyaan:
An access switch initially uses the following uplink:
[cli]
interface TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1
 switchport mode trunk
[/cli]
A new design requires routed access with point-to-point IP adjacency toward the distribution layer. Which configuration change best reflects the required design?
opsi_a: Convert the interface to a routed port with 'no switchport', assign point-to-point IP addressing, and include it in the appropriate routing design
opsi_b: Keep the trunk and add more allowed VLANs
opsi_c: Convert the trunk into an access port in a user VLAN
opsi_d: Enable PortFast trunk so that the interface can perform routing
pembahasan: Routed access requires a Layer 3 uplink, so the Layer 2 trunk must become a routed interface and receive appropriate Layer 3 addressing. Static or dynamic routing must then provide reachability over that link according to the design. Adding VLANs, using access mode, or enabling PortFast does not convert the uplink into a routed interface.

pertanyaan: Sebuah aplikasi lama mensyaratkan dua server yang berada pada wiring closet berbeda tetap berada dalam subnet dan Layer 2 broadcast domain yang sama. Tidak ada overlay Layer 2 seperti VXLAN. Dari dua pilihan traditional switched access dan routed access murni, mana yang lebih sesuai dengan kebutuhan tersebut?
opsi_a: Routed access, karena routed uplink meneruskan ARP broadcast antar-access switch
opsi_b: Traditional switched access, karena Layer 2 VLAN dapat diperpanjang melalui trunk menuju distribution dan access switch lain sesuai desain
opsi_c: Routed access, karena OSPF secara otomatis melakukan VLAN stretching
opsi_d: Keduanya identik karena VLAN ID yang sama selalu membentuk satu broadcast domain
pembahasan: Routed access secara sengaja membatasi Layer 2 domain pada access block sehingga kurang fleksibel untuk aplikasi yang membutuhkan Layer 2 adjacency lintas wiring closet. Traditional switched access dapat membawa VLAN melalui trunk dan mempertahankan satu Layer 2 domain, meskipun desain VLAN yang terlalu luas memiliki konsekuensi terhadap failure domain dan STP. Tanpa overlay khusus, routing biasa tidak meneruskan ARP broadcast untuk membuat satu subnet Layer 2 yang sama.

pertanyaan: A legacy application requires two servers in different wiring closets to remain in the same IP subnet and Layer 2 broadcast domain. No Layer 2 overlay such as VXLAN is available. Between traditional switched access and pure routed access, which design better satisfies this requirement?
opsi_a: Routed access, because routed uplinks forward ARP broadcasts between access switches
opsi_b: Traditional switched access, because the Layer 2 VLAN can be extended through trunks toward distribution and other access switches as required by the design
opsi_c: Routed access, because OSPF automatically performs VLAN stretching
opsi_d: Both are identical because matching VLAN IDs always form one broadcast domain
pembahasan: Routed access intentionally confines the Layer 2 domain to the access block, making it less flexible for applications that require Layer 2 adjacency across wiring closets. Traditional switched access can carry a VLAN over trunks and maintain one Layer 2 domain, although excessively large VLANs have failure-domain and STP consequences. Without a special overlay, ordinary routing does not forward ARP broadcasts to create one common Layer 2 subnet.

pertanyaan: Sebuah cloud infrastructure dimiliki dan dioperasikan oleh third-party provider serta menyediakan resource kepada banyak pelanggan. Deployment model apakah yang paling sesuai?
opsi_a: Private cloud
opsi_b: Hybrid cloud
opsi_c: Public cloud
opsi_d: Community cloud
pembahasan: Public cloud disediakan oleh third-party provider untuk digunakan banyak pelanggan atau organisasi. Private cloud didedikasikan untuk satu organisasi, hybrid mengintegrasikan beberapa environment, sedangkan community cloud digunakan oleh kelompok organisasi dengan kebutuhan serupa.

pertanyaan: A cloud infrastructure is owned and operated by a third-party provider and provides resources to many customers. Which deployment model best fits this description?
opsi_a: Private cloud
opsi_b: Hybrid cloud
opsi_c: Public cloud
opsi_d: Community cloud
pembahasan: A public cloud is provided by a third-party provider for use by many customers or organizations. A private cloud is dedicated to one organization, hybrid integrates multiple environments, and community cloud serves organizations with similar requirements.

pertanyaan: Sebuah bank menginginkan cloud infrastructure yang hanya dapat digunakan oleh organisasinya. Infrastruktur tersebut boleh ditempatkan di data center milik provider dan tidak harus berada di gedung bank. Deployment model apakah ini?
opsi_a: Private cloud
opsi_b: Public cloud
opsi_c: Hybrid cloud
opsi_d: Community cloud
pembahasan: Private cloud didedikasikan untuk satu organisasi dan tidak wajib berada secara fisik di premises organisasi tersebut. Infrastruktur dapat di-host atau dikelola pihak ketiga selama penggunaannya tetap eksklusif untuk organisasi itu.

pertanyaan: A bank requires cloud infrastructure that can be used only by its organization. The infrastructure may be hosted in a provider data center and does not have to be located on the bank's premises. Which deployment model is this?
opsi_a: Private cloud
opsi_b: Public cloud
opsi_c: Hybrid cloud
opsi_d: Community cloud
pembahasan: A private cloud is dedicated to one organization and does not have to be physically located on that organization's premises. It can be hosted or managed by a third party as long as its use remains exclusive to that organization.

pertanyaan: Sebuah perusahaan mempertahankan database internal pada private cloud tetapi menjalankan aplikasi customer-facing pada public cloud. Kedua environment diintegrasikan agar aplikasi dapat menggunakan resource dari keduanya. Deployment model apakah yang digunakan?
opsi_a: Community cloud
opsi_b: Public cloud
opsi_c: Private cloud
opsi_d: Hybrid cloud
pembahasan: Hybrid cloud mengintegrasikan sedikitnya dua cloud environment yang berbeda, paling umum private dan public cloud. Sekadar memiliki dua environment tanpa integrasi tidak cukup menggambarkan desain hybrid yang digunakan sebagai satu arsitektur layanan.

pertanyaan: A company keeps its internal database in a private cloud but runs a customer-facing application in a public cloud. The two environments are integrated so that the application can use resources from both. Which deployment model is being used?
opsi_a: Community cloud
opsi_b: Public cloud
opsi_c: Private cloud
opsi_d: Hybrid cloud
pembahasan: A hybrid cloud integrates at least two different cloud environments, most commonly private and public clouds. Merely owning two separate environments without integration would not fully represent a hybrid architecture operating as one solution.

pertanyaan: Beberapa organisasi kesehatan dengan persyaratan regulasi yang serupa menggunakan cloud infrastructure bersama yang hanya tersedia bagi anggota kelompok tersebut. Model apakah yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Public cloud
opsi_b: Community cloud
opsi_c: Private cloud
opsi_d: Hybrid cloud
pembahasan: Community cloud digunakan bersama oleh beberapa organisasi yang mempunyai kebutuhan, regulasi, atau tujuan yang serupa. Infrastruktur tersebut bukan public cloud karena aksesnya terbatas pada komunitas organisasi tertentu.

pertanyaan: Several healthcare organizations with similar regulatory requirements share cloud infrastructure that is available only to members of that group. Which model best fits this design?
opsi_a: Public cloud
opsi_b: Community cloud
opsi_c: Private cloud
opsi_d: Hybrid cloud
pembahasan: A community cloud is shared by multiple organizations that have similar requirements, regulations, or objectives. It is not a public cloud because access is limited to a specific community of organizations.

pertanyaan: Pernyataan manakah yang paling tepat membedakan cloud deployment model dengan cloud service model?
opsi_a: Deployment model menjelaskan pola kepemilikan dan penggunaan cloud, sedangkan service model menjelaskan jenis layanan serta pembagian tanggung jawab seperti IaaS, PaaS, dan SaaS
opsi_b: Deployment model menjelaskan IaaS, PaaS, dan SaaS, sedangkan service model menjelaskan public, private, hybrid, dan community
opsi_c: Deployment model hanya membahas lokasi server fisik, sedangkan service model hanya membahas bandwidth
opsi_d: Keduanya merupakan istilah yang dapat dipertukarkan
pembahasan: Deployment model menjawab bagaimana dan oleh siapa cloud digunakan, misalnya public, private, hybrid, atau community. Service model menjelaskan lapisan layanan yang dikonsumsi dan bagian yang dikelola provider atau customer, seperti IaaS, PaaS, dan SaaS.

pertanyaan: Which statement best distinguishes a cloud deployment model from a cloud service model?
opsi_a: A deployment model describes cloud ownership and usage patterns, while a service model describes the type of service and responsibility split such as IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS
opsi_b: A deployment model describes IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS, while a service model describes public, private, hybrid, and community
opsi_c: A deployment model only describes physical server location, while a service model only describes bandwidth
opsi_d: The two terms are interchangeable
pembahasan: A deployment model describes how and by whom a cloud is used, such as public, private, hybrid, or community. A service model describes the service layer being consumed and the responsibility split between provider and customer, such as IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS.

pertanyaan: Dalam network fabric, layer manakah yang bertanggung jawab menyediakan IP reachability dasar dan transport yang stabil antar-node fabric?
opsi_a: Overlay
opsi_b: Policy plane
opsi_c: Control plane
opsi_d: Underlay
pembahasan: Underlay merupakan jaringan transport IP dasar yang memastikan seluruh node fabric dapat saling mencapai. Overlay bergantung pada reachability underlay untuk membangun konektivitas logis di atas jaringan fisik tersebut.

pertanyaan: In a network fabric, which layer is responsible for providing basic IP reachability and stable transport between fabric nodes?
opsi_a: Overlay
opsi_b: Policy plane
opsi_c: Control plane
opsi_d: Underlay
pembahasan: The underlay is the underlying IP transport network that ensures fabric nodes can reach one another. The overlay depends on underlay reachability to build logical connectivity over the physical network.

pertanyaan: Sebuah fabric membawa segmentasi endpoint menggunakan tunnel logis di atas routed IP network. Jika routed IP network tetap sehat tetapi informasi overlay bermasalah, pernyataan manakah yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Underlay pasti gagal karena overlay dan underlay adalah jaringan yang sama
opsi_b: Konektivitas IP antar-node dapat tetap tersedia walaupun konektivitas logis endpoint pada overlay terganggu
opsi_c: Semua endpoint otomatis menggunakan Layer 2 flooding sebagai pengganti overlay
opsi_d: Border node tidak lagi dapat memiliki IP address
pembahasan: Underlay dan overlay mempunyai fungsi berbeda. Underlay dapat tetap menyediakan reachability antar-node sementara masalah pada control atau data plane overlay menyebabkan konektivitas endpoint atau segmentasi terganggu.

pertanyaan: A fabric carries endpoint segmentation through logical tunnels over a routed IP network. If the routed IP network remains healthy but overlay information fails, which statement is most accurate?
opsi_a: The underlay must also fail because the overlay and underlay are the same network
opsi_b: IP connectivity between fabric nodes may remain available even though logical endpoint connectivity in the overlay is disrupted
opsi_c: All endpoints automatically use Layer 2 flooding instead of the overlay
opsi_d: The border node can no longer have an IP address
pembahasan: The underlay and overlay perform different functions. The underlay can continue to provide node-to-node reachability while an overlay control-plane or data-plane problem disrupts endpoint connectivity or segmentation.

pertanyaan: Dalam campus fabric, sebuah user harus mengakses network non-fabric dan data center eksternal. Node fabric manakah yang secara utama menyediakan konektivitas keluar dan masuk antara fabric dengan external network tersebut?
opsi_a: Intermediate node
opsi_b: Control-plane node
opsi_c: Border node
opsi_d: Fabric edge node
pembahasan: Border node menjadi titik konektivitas antara fabric dan network di luar fabric, misalnya WAN, data center, internet, atau domain non-fabric. Fabric edge terutama menjadi attachment point endpoint, sedangkan intermediate node menyediakan transport.

pertanyaan: In a campus fabric, a user must reach a non-fabric network and an external data center. Which fabric node primarily provides connectivity into and out of the fabric toward those external networks?
opsi_a: Intermediate node
opsi_b: Control-plane node
opsi_c: Border node
opsi_d: Fabric edge node
pembahasan: A border node provides connectivity between the fabric and external networks such as a WAN, data center, internet, or non-fabric domain. A fabric edge primarily attaches endpoints, while an intermediate node provides transport.

pertanyaan: Sebuah organisasi ingin menghubungkan private network miliknya ke AWS menggunakan private connection sehingga internet publik tidak menjadi transport utama menuju cloud. Opsi manakah yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Community cloud
opsi_b: Cloud Direct Connect
opsi_c: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS
opsi_d: Internet VPN saja
pembahasan: Cloud Direct Connect menyediakan private atau dedicated connectivity dari enterprise menuju public cloud provider. VPN melalui internet menggunakan public internet sebagai transport, sedangkan Cloud OnRamp for SaaS berfokus pada optimasi akses SaaS.
