pertanyaan: An organization wants to connect its private network to AWS using a private connection so that the public internet is not the primary transport toward the cloud. Which option is most appropriate?
opsi_a: Community cloud
opsi_b: Cloud Direct Connect
opsi_c: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS
opsi_d: Internet VPN only
pembahasan: Cloud Direct Connect provides private or dedicated connectivity from the enterprise toward a public cloud provider. An internet VPN still uses the public internet as its transport, while Cloud OnRamp for SaaS focuses on SaaS access optimization.

pertanyaan: Engineer menyatakan bahwa Cloud Direct Connect pasti lebih terenkripsi daripada site-to-site IPsec VPN karena Direct Connect menggunakan private network. Apa koreksi yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Direct Connect selalu menggunakan dua lapisan IPsec
opsi_b: VPN tidak pernah mengenkripsi traffic
opsi_c: Private connection hanya berarti bandwidth lebih kecil
opsi_d: Private connection tidak otomatis berarti encrypted; IPsec VPN melalui internet biasanya mengenkripsi traffic, sedangkan enkripsi Direct Connect bergantung pada desain dan layanan
pembahasan: Private path dan encryption adalah dua karakteristik berbeda. Direct Connect menghindari public internet sebagai jalur utama, tetapi enkripsi tambahan seperti IPsec, MACsec jika didukung, atau application encryption mungkin tetap diperlukan.

pertanyaan: An engineer claims that Cloud Direct Connect is always more encrypted than a site-to-site IPsec VPN because Direct Connect uses a private network. What is the best correction?
opsi_a: Direct Connect always uses two layers of IPsec
opsi_b: A VPN never encrypts traffic
opsi_c: A private connection only means lower bandwidth
opsi_d: A private connection does not automatically mean encrypted; an IPsec VPN over the internet normally encrypts traffic, while Direct Connect encryption depends on the service and design
pembahasan: A private path and encryption are different characteristics. Direct Connect avoids the public internet as the primary path, but additional encryption such as IPsec, supported MACsec, or application-layer encryption may still be required.

pertanyaan: Sebuah perusahaan menggunakan satu Cloud Direct Connect sebagai satu-satunya jalur menuju aplikasi bisnis kritis di public cloud. Perusahaan ingin mengurangi risiko kehilangan akses jika circuit tersebut gagal. Desain manakah yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Tambahkan redundant cloud connection atau jalur backup seperti IPsec VPN dengan routing failover yang dirancang dengan benar
opsi_b: Naikkan bandwidth circuit yang sama tanpa menambah path lain
opsi_c: Pindahkan seluruh routing ke static route tanpa backup
opsi_d: Hapus return route agar traffic menggunakan internet secara otomatis
pembahasan: Satu Direct Connect dapat menjadi single point of failure. Redundant direct connection atau backup IPsec VPN memberikan path alternatif, sedangkan hanya menambah bandwidth tidak menghilangkan ketergantungan pada satu circuit.

pertanyaan: A company uses a single Cloud Direct Connect as the only path to a business-critical application in a public cloud. The company wants to reduce the risk of losing access if that circuit fails. Which design is most appropriate?
opsi_a: Add a redundant cloud connection or a backup path such as an IPsec VPN with properly designed routing failover
opsi_b: Increase the bandwidth of the same circuit without adding another path
opsi_c: Move all routing to static routes without a backup
opsi_d: Remove the return route so traffic automatically uses the internet
pembahasan: A single Direct Connect can become a single point of failure. A redundant direct connection or backup IPsec VPN provides an alternate path, while simply increasing bandwidth does not eliminate dependence on one circuit.

pertanyaan: Sebuah organisasi tidak dapat menjangkau lokasi Cloud Direct Connect provider secara langsung tetapi sudah mempunyai MPLS WAN yang dapat mencapai Direct Connect Partner. Opsi konektivitas manakah yang paling sesuai?
opsi_a: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS
opsi_b: Community cloud
opsi_c: MPLS Direct Connect
opsi_d: Public internet tanpa encryption
pembahasan: MPLS Direct Connect menggunakan jaringan MPLS organisasi untuk mencapai Direct Connect Partner. Partner kemudian menggunakan koneksi cloud miliknya untuk membawa traffic menuju public cloud provider.

pertanyaan: An organization cannot directly reach a cloud provider's Direct Connect location but already has an MPLS WAN that can reach a Direct Connect Partner. Which connectivity option best fits this requirement?
opsi_a: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS
opsi_b: Community cloud
opsi_c: MPLS Direct Connect
opsi_d: Public internet without encryption
pembahasan: MPLS Direct Connect uses the organization's MPLS network to reach a Direct Connect Partner. The partner then uses its cloud connectivity to carry traffic toward the public cloud provider.

pertanyaan: Apa fungsi utama Direct Connect Partner pada desain MPLS Direct Connect?
opsi_a: Menggantikan seluruh branch router dengan SaaS
opsi_b: Menyediakan private cloud khusus untuk setiap customer
opsi_c: Membuat MPLS label tetap aktif hingga application server di cloud
opsi_d: Menjadi perantara yang menerima konektivitas organisasi melalui MPLS dan menyediakan koneksi menuju cloud provider
pembahasan: Direct Connect Partner menjembatani konektivitas organisasi dengan cloud provider. Organisasi mencapai partner melalui MPLS, kemudian partner menggunakan cloud interconnect atau direct connection miliknya menuju provider.

pertanyaan: What is the primary function of a Direct Connect Partner in an MPLS Direct Connect design?
opsi_a: Replace every branch router with SaaS
opsi_b: Provide a dedicated private cloud for every customer
opsi_c: Keep MPLS labels active all the way to the application server in the cloud
opsi_d: Act as an intermediary that receives the organization's connectivity through MPLS and provides connectivity toward the cloud provider
pembahasan: A Direct Connect Partner bridges the organization's connectivity to the cloud provider. The organization reaches the partner through MPLS, and the partner then uses its cloud interconnect or direct connection toward the provider.

pertanyaan: Pada MPLS Direct Connect, seorang engineer mengira MPLS label milik WAN enterprise harus diteruskan sampai ke VM yang berada di public cloud. Pernyataan manakah yang benar?
opsi_a: MPLS label biasanya digunakan di domain MPLS provider dan tidak berarti label enterprise harus berlanjut sampai ke cloud workload
opsi_b: VM cloud wajib menjadi MPLS P router
opsi_c: Semua cloud VPC harus menggunakan LDP milik enterprise
opsi_d: Direct Connect Partner hanya dapat meneruskan Ethernet frame tanpa IP routing
pembahasan: MPLS digunakan sebagai transport pada domain provider menuju partner. Setelah traffic meninggalkan domain MPLS tersebut, konektivitas ke cloud dapat menggunakan mekanisme IP dan routing lain sehingga workload tidak harus memahami MPLS label enterprise.

pertanyaan: In an MPLS Direct Connect design, an engineer assumes that the enterprise WAN MPLS label must be carried all the way to a VM in the public cloud. Which statement is correct?
opsi_a: MPLS labels are normally used inside the provider MPLS domain and do not imply that enterprise labels must continue to the cloud workload
opsi_b: The cloud VM must operate as an MPLS P router
opsi_c: Every cloud VPC must run the enterprise's LDP
opsi_d: A Direct Connect Partner can forward only Ethernet frames and cannot use IP routing
pembahasan: MPLS acts as transport inside the provider domain toward the partner. After traffic leaves that MPLS domain, connectivity toward the cloud can use other IP and routing mechanisms, so the workload does not need to understand the enterprise MPLS label.

pertanyaan: Pernyataan manakah yang paling tepat menggambarkan Cisco SD-WAN Cloud OnRamp?
opsi_a: Cloud deployment model yang menggantikan hybrid cloud
opsi_b: Jenis physical circuit yang harus menggunakan 5G
opsi_c: Kemampuan SD-WAN untuk menyederhanakan, mengotomatisasi, mengamankan, dan mengoptimalkan konektivitas menuju layanan cloud
opsi_d: Hypervisor untuk menjalankan virtual machine
pembahasan: Cloud OnRamp merupakan sekumpulan kemampuan Cisco SD-WAN untuk mengintegrasikan enterprise WAN dengan cloud. Ia dapat memanfaatkan transport seperti internet, MPLS, 5G, atau interconnect dan bukan merupakan sebuah deployment model atau satu jenis circuit fisik.

pertanyaan: Which statement best describes Cisco SD-WAN Cloud OnRamp?
opsi_a: A cloud deployment model that replaces hybrid cloud
opsi_b: A physical circuit type that must use 5G
opsi_c: An SD-WAN capability that simplifies, automates, secures, and optimizes connectivity to cloud services
opsi_d: A hypervisor used to run virtual machines
pembahasan: Cloud OnRamp is a set of Cisco SD-WAN capabilities that integrates the enterprise WAN with cloud environments. It can use transports such as internet, MPLS, 5G, or interconnect services and is not a cloud deployment model or a single physical circuit type.

pertanyaan: Perusahaan memiliki branch Cisco SD-WAN dan workload yang tersebar di AWS, Azure, dan Google Cloud. Administrator ingin mengurangi konfigurasi manual konektivitas, tunnel, dan integrasi cloud gateway. Use case manakah yang paling sesuai?
opsi_a: Cloud Direct Connect saja
opsi_b: Cloud OnRamp for Multicloud
opsi_c: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS
opsi_d: Community Cloud
pembahasan: Cloud OnRamp for Multicloud memperluas Cisco SD-WAN fabric menuju public cloud dan mengotomatisasi banyak tugas integrasi cloud. Cloud OnRamp for SaaS berfokus pada optimasi jalur menuju aplikasi SaaS, bukan integrasi workload IaaS di beberapa cloud.

pertanyaan: A company has Cisco SD-WAN branches and workloads distributed across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. The administrator wants to reduce manual configuration of connectivity, tunnels, and cloud-gateway integration. Which use case best fits this requirement?
opsi_a: Cloud Direct Connect only
opsi_b: Cloud OnRamp for Multicloud
opsi_c: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS
opsi_d: Community Cloud
pembahasan: Cloud OnRamp for Multicloud extends the Cisco SD-WAN fabric into public clouds and automates many cloud-integration tasks. Cloud OnRamp for SaaS focuses on path optimization toward SaaS applications rather than IaaS workload integration across multiple clouds.

pertanyaan: Dalam konteks cloud enterprise design, apakah yang dimaksud dengan cloud workload?
opsi_a: Aplikasi atau layanan beserta resource komputasi yang menjalankan suatu fungsi di cloud
opsi_b: Hanya kabel yang menghubungkan enterprise ke cloud
opsi_c: Hanya routing table pada cloud gateway
opsi_d: Seluruh gedung data center milik provider
pembahasan: Cloud workload adalah sesuatu yang benar-benar dijalankan di cloud, misalnya ERP, web server, database, VM, container, atau managed application. VPC, subnet, route table, dan gateway lebih tepat dipandang sebagai bagian dari infrastruktur yang menyediakan konektivitas bagi workload tersebut.

pertanyaan: In cloud enterprise design, what is a cloud workload?
opsi_a: An application or service together with computing resources that performs a function in the cloud
opsi_b: Only the cable connecting the enterprise to the cloud
opsi_c: Only the routing table on a cloud gateway
opsi_d: The entire physical data center building owned by the provider
pembahasan: A cloud workload is something actually running in the cloud, such as an ERP system, web server, database, VM, container, or managed application. VPCs, subnets, route tables, and gateways are more accurately considered infrastructure that provides connectivity for those workloads.

pertanyaan: Manakah pasangan yang paling tepat membedakan cloud infrastructure dan cloud workload?
opsi_a: VPC adalah workload dan ERP server adalah infrastructure
opsi_b: Keduanya selalu berarti hal yang sama
opsi_c: Internet circuit adalah workload dan database adalah underlay
opsi_d: VPC, subnet, dan gateway merupakan infrastructure; ERP application atau database yang dijalankan di atas environment tersebut merupakan workload
pembahasan: Infrastructure menyediakan lingkungan compute dan networking tempat layanan dijalankan. Workload adalah aplikasi atau fungsi bisnis yang menggunakan infrastructure tersebut, sehingga VPC dan gateway tidak sama dengan ERP atau database application.

pertanyaan: Which pairing most accurately distinguishes cloud infrastructure from a cloud workload?
opsi_a: A VPC is a workload and an ERP server is infrastructure
opsi_b: They always mean exactly the same thing
opsi_c: An internet circuit is a workload and a database is an underlay
opsi_d: VPCs, subnets, and gateways are infrastructure; an ERP application or database running in that environment is a workload
pembahasan: Infrastructure provides the compute and networking environment in which services operate. A workload is the application or business function using that infrastructure, so a VPC or gateway is not the same thing as an ERP or database application.

pertanyaan: Dalam contoh Cloud OnRamp for Multicloud dengan AWS, beberapa application VPC perlu dihubungkan ke virtual SD-WAN edge melalui satu titik transit. Komponen AWS manakah yang paling sesuai menjalankan fungsi routing hub tersebut?
opsi_a: SaaS gateway
opsi_b: AWS Transit Gateway
opsi_c: Public DNS resolver
opsi_d: Cloud Direct Connect Partner
pembahasan: AWS Transit Gateway dapat bertindak sebagai transit routing hub yang menghubungkan beberapa VPC dan koneksi jaringan lainnya. Virtual SD-WAN edge menyediakan integrasi dengan SD-WAN, sedangkan Transit Gateway membantu mendistribusikan konektivitas menuju application VPC.

pertanyaan: In an AWS Cloud OnRamp for Multicloud example, several application VPCs must connect to a virtual SD-WAN edge through a common transit point. Which AWS component best performs this routing-hub function?
opsi_a: SaaS gateway
opsi_b: AWS Transit Gateway
opsi_c: Public DNS resolver
opsi_d: Cloud Direct Connect Partner
pembahasan: AWS Transit Gateway can operate as a transit routing hub connecting multiple VPCs and other network connections. The virtual SD-WAN edge provides SD-WAN integration, while Transit Gateway distributes connectivity toward application VPCs.

pertanyaan: Branch memiliki dua path menuju Microsoft 365. Path pertama memiliki latency dan packet loss yang lebih buruk daripada path kedua. Fitur manakah yang dirancang untuk mengukur kualitas jalur menuju SaaS dan mengarahkan traffic melalui path yang lebih baik?
opsi_a: Cloud Hub
opsi_b: MPLS Direct Connect
opsi_c: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS
opsi_d: Private cloud
pembahasan: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS menggunakan pengukuran performa secara real time untuk membantu memilih path yang optimal menuju SaaS application. Faktor seperti latency dan packet loss dapat membuat SD-WAN mengarahkan traffic melalui egress yang memberikan application experience lebih baik.

pertanyaan: A branch has two paths to Microsoft 365. The first path has worse latency and packet loss than the second. Which feature is designed to measure SaaS path quality and steer traffic through the better path?
opsi_a: Cloud Hub
opsi_b: MPLS Direct Connect
opsi_c: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS
opsi_d: Private cloud
pembahasan: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS uses real-time performance measurements to help select an optimal path to SaaS applications. Metrics such as latency and packet loss can cause SD-WAN to steer traffic through the egress that provides a better application experience.

pertanyaan: Sebuah perusahaan ingin menggunakan Cisco SD-WAN untuk mengotomatisasi koneksi ke cloud melalui provider interconnect seperti Megaport atau Equinix. Use case Cloud OnRamp manakah yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Cloud Hub
opsi_b: Secure SD-WAN
opsi_c: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS
opsi_d: Cloud Interconnect
pembahasan: Cloud Interconnect memungkinkan SD-WAN mengotomatisasi connectivity melalui interconnect provider menuju cloud provider network. Cloud OnRamp for SaaS lebih berfokus pada optimal path menuju SaaS, sedangkan Cloud Hub menggunakan cloud network sebagai hub connectivity.

pertanyaan: A company wants to use Cisco SD-WAN to automate cloud connectivity through an interconnect provider such as Megaport or Equinix. Which Cloud OnRamp use case best fits this requirement?
opsi_a: Cloud Hub
opsi_b: Secure SD-WAN
opsi_c: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS
opsi_d: Cloud Interconnect
pembahasan: Cloud Interconnect allows SD-WAN to automate connectivity through an interconnect provider toward cloud-provider networks. Cloud OnRamp for SaaS focuses on optimal SaaS paths, while Cloud Hub uses a cloud network as a connectivity hub.

pertanyaan: Dalam Cisco SD-WAN Cloud Hub with Google Cloud, sebuah branch dihubungkan melalui SD-WAN agar user dapat mengakses ERP yang dijalankan di Google Cloud. Use case apakah yang sedang digunakan?
opsi_a: Site-to-site melalui cloud backbone
opsi_b: Site-to-Google Cloud
opsi_c: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS
opsi_d: Community cloud
pembahasan: Pada site-to-Google Cloud, destination utama adalah workload yang berada di Google Cloud. Google Cloud berperan sebagai lokasi aplikasi atau resource yang ingin diakses oleh enterprise site.

pertanyaan: In Cisco SD-WAN Cloud Hub with Google Cloud, a branch is connected through SD-WAN so that users can access an ERP system running in Google Cloud. Which use case is being used?
opsi_a: Site-to-site through the cloud backbone
opsi_b: Site-to-Google Cloud
opsi_c: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS
opsi_d: Community cloud
pembahasan: In the site-to-Google Cloud use case, the primary destination is a workload hosted in Google Cloud. Google Cloud acts as the location of the application or resource that the enterprise site needs to access.

pertanyaan: Site A dan Site B berada di region berbeda. Perusahaan menggunakan Cisco SD-WAN Cloud Hub with Google Cloud sehingga traffic antarsite dapat melewati Google Cloud global infrastructure. Apa peran utama Google Cloud pada skenario ini?
opsi_a: Menjadi transit backbone untuk konektivitas site-to-site
opsi_b: Menjadi SaaS application yang diakses kedua site
opsi_c: Menggantikan seluruh SD-WAN edge dengan VM aplikasi
opsi_d: Menyediakan private cloud khusus untuk Site A
pembahasan: Dalam use case site-to-site, Google Cloud global infrastructure digunakan sebagai jalur transit antara enterprise site yang berbeda. Destination akhirnya adalah site lain, bukan harus workload yang berada di Google Cloud.

pertanyaan: Site A and Site B are in different regions. The company uses Cisco SD-WAN Cloud Hub with Google Cloud so that intersite traffic can traverse Google Cloud global infrastructure. What is Google Cloud's primary role in this scenario?
opsi_a: Act as a transit backbone for site-to-site connectivity
opsi_b: Act as a SaaS application accessed by both sites
opsi_c: Replace every SD-WAN edge with an application VM
opsi_d: Provide a private cloud dedicated only to Site A
pembahasan: In the site-to-site use case, Google Cloud global infrastructure is used as a transit path between different enterprise sites. The final destination is another site rather than necessarily a workload hosted in Google Cloud.

pertanyaan: Sebuah perusahaan memiliki private cloud sendiri serta menggunakan AWS dan Azure. Environment private dan public saling terintegrasi, dan perusahaan juga sengaja menggunakan dua public cloud provider. Pernyataan manakah yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Desain tersebut hanya dapat disebut public cloud
opsi_b: Desain tersebut hanya dapat disebut community cloud
opsi_c: Desain tersebut dapat bersifat hybrid cloud sekaligus multicloud
opsi_d: Hybrid cloud dan multicloud tidak dapat digunakan bersamaan
pembahasan: Hybrid menjelaskan integrasi antara environment seperti private dan public cloud, sedangkan multicloud menjelaskan penggunaan lebih dari satu cloud environment atau provider. Karena kedua kondisi dapat terjadi sekaligus, sebuah enterprise dapat mempunyai desain hybrid dan multicloud pada saat yang sama.

pertanyaan: A company operates its own private cloud and also uses AWS and Azure. The private and public environments are integrated, and the company intentionally uses two public cloud providers. Which statement is most accurate?
opsi_a: The design can only be called public cloud
opsi_b: The design can only be called community cloud
opsi_c: The design can be both hybrid cloud and multicloud
opsi_d: Hybrid cloud and multicloud cannot be used together
pembahasan: Hybrid describes integration between environments such as private and public clouds, while multicloud describes the use of more than one cloud environment or provider. Because both conditions can exist simultaneously, an enterprise can have both a hybrid and multicloud design.

pertanyaan: Sebuah enterprise menggunakan Direct Connect sebagai primary cloud path dan IPsec VPN melalui internet sebagai backup. Agar backup benar-benar berguna ketika Direct Connect gagal, aspek desain manakah yang paling penting?
opsi_a: Semua application server harus menggunakan public IP
opsi_b: Routing harus menyediakan failover dan cloud maupun enterprise harus memiliki return path yang sesuai melalui jalur yang masih tersedia
opsi_c: VPN harus selalu mempunyai bandwidth lebih besar daripada Direct Connect
opsi_d: Direct Connect harus tetap aktif agar VPN dapat membentuk tunnel
pembahasan: Redundant transport tidak berguna jika routing tidak dapat berpindah ke jalur cadangan atau return route tetap menunjuk ke path yang gagal. Desain harus mempertimbangkan route advertisement, preference, dan reachability dua arah pada kondisi normal maupun failure.

pertanyaan: An enterprise uses Direct Connect as its primary cloud path and an IPsec VPN over the internet as backup. For the backup to be useful when Direct Connect fails, which design aspect is most important?
opsi_a: All application servers must use public IP addresses
opsi_b: Routing must provide failover, and both the cloud and enterprise must have a valid return path over the remaining connection
opsi_c: The VPN must always have more bandwidth than Direct Connect
opsi_d: Direct Connect must remain operational for the VPN tunnel to form
pembahasan: Redundant transport is not useful if routing cannot move to the backup path or if the return route still points toward the failed connection. The design must consider route advertisement, preference, and bidirectional reachability during both normal and failure conditions.

pertanyaan: Network on-premises 10.10.0.0/16 terhubung secara private ke cloud VPC 172.16.0.0/16. Router enterprise sudah memiliki route menuju 172.16.0.0/16, tetapi cloud tidak memiliki route menuju 10.10.0.0/16. Apa hasil yang paling mungkin?
opsi_a: Traffic dapat mencapai sisi cloud tetapi komunikasi dua arah gagal karena tidak tersedia return path yang benar
opsi_b: Komunikasi tetap normal karena route hanya diperlukan pada sisi pengirim
opsi_c: Cloud secara otomatis membuat route ke seluruh private prefix
opsi_d: Direct Connect akan mengubah alamat 10.10.0.0/16 menjadi public IP tanpa konfigurasi
pembahasan: IP connectivity memerlukan forwarding path yang benar pada kedua arah. Walaupun paket dapat dikirim dari enterprise menuju cloud, response tidak dapat kembali dengan benar jika cloud tidak mengetahui route menuju network on-premises.

pertanyaan: An on-premises network 10.10.0.0/16 is privately connected to cloud VPC 172.16.0.0/16. The enterprise router already has a route to 172.16.0.0/16, but the cloud has no route to 10.10.0.0/16. What is the most likely result?
opsi_a: Traffic may reach the cloud side, but bidirectional communication fails because a correct return path is missing
opsi_b: Communication remains normal because a route is needed only on the sender
opsi_c: The cloud automatically creates a route to every private prefix
opsi_d: Direct Connect automatically translates 10.10.0.0/16 into a public IP without configuration
pembahasan: IP connectivity requires a valid forwarding path in both directions. Even if the enterprise can send a packet toward the cloud, the response cannot return correctly when the cloud has no route to the on-premises network.

pertanyaan: Sebuah application team menyimpulkan bahwa security group dan firewall tidak lagi diperlukan karena koneksi enterprise ke cloud menggunakan private interconnect. Apa masalah utama dari kesimpulan tersebut?
opsi_a: Private interconnect otomatis menggantikan identity dan authorization
opsi_b: Cloud workload tidak dapat menggunakan firewall jika menggunakan private IP
opsi_c: Private interconnect hanya dapat membawa encrypted SaaS traffic
opsi_d: Private transport mengurangi exposure terhadap public internet tetapi tidak menggantikan access control, segmentation, dan security policy pada endpoint atau cloud network
pembahasan: Pemilihan private transport dan penerapan security policy merupakan kontrol yang berbeda. Firewall, security group, identity policy, dan segmentation tetap diperlukan untuk menentukan siapa yang boleh mengakses workload meskipun path ke cloud bersifat private.

pertanyaan: An application team concludes that security groups and firewalls are no longer required because the enterprise connects to the cloud through a private interconnect. What is the main problem with this conclusion?
opsi_a: A private interconnect automatically replaces identity and authorization
opsi_b: Cloud workloads cannot use firewalls when private IP addresses are used
opsi_c: A private interconnect can carry only encrypted SaaS traffic
opsi_d: Private transport reduces exposure to the public internet but does not replace access control, segmentation, and security policy on endpoints or cloud networks
pembahasan: Choosing private transport and enforcing security policy are separate controls. Firewalls, security groups, identity policies, and segmentation are still needed to determine who may access workloads even when the cloud path is private.

pertanyaan: Branch memiliki local internet connection yang memberikan latency 20 ms ke SaaS, sedangkan jalur Branch ? MPLS ? HQ ? Internet memberikan latency 90 ms. Dengan policy yang mengizinkan direct internet access dan Cloud OnRamp for SaaS, keputusan manakah yang paling masuk akal?
opsi_a: Selalu kirim SaaS melalui HQ karena SaaS harus melewati data center
opsi_b: Matikan probing agar kedua path dianggap sama
opsi_c: Gunakan local internet breakout selama jalur tersebut memenuhi policy dan memberikan application experience yang lebih baik
opsi_d: Pindahkan SaaS menjadi private cloud agar SD-WAN dapat bekerja
pembahasan: Local breakout dapat menghindari hairpin Branch ? HQ ? Internet yang menambah latency. Cloud OnRamp for SaaS dapat mengukur path yang tersedia dan memilih egress yang memberikan kualitas aplikasi lebih baik selama tetap sesuai dengan policy keamanan.

pertanyaan: A branch has a local internet connection with 20 ms latency to a SaaS application, while the Branch ? MPLS ? HQ ? Internet path has 90 ms latency. With policy allowing direct internet access and Cloud OnRamp for SaaS, which decision is most reasonable?
opsi_a: Always send SaaS traffic through HQ because SaaS must traverse the data center
opsi_b: Disable probing so both paths are treated as equal
opsi_c: Use local internet breakout while that path satisfies policy and provides a better application experience
opsi_d: Move the SaaS application into a private cloud so SD-WAN can operate
pembahasan: Local breakout can avoid Branch ? HQ ? Internet hairpinning that increases latency. Cloud OnRamp for SaaS can measure available paths and select an egress with better application quality as long as security policy permits it.

pertanyaan: Sebuah perusahaan memiliki 80 branch yang seluruhnya sudah terhubung melalui MPLS. Lokasi perusahaan tidak dekat dengan fasilitas direct-connect cloud provider, tetapi MPLS provider dapat membawa traffic menuju partner yang memiliki private cloud connection. Solusi manakah yang paling selaras dengan kondisi tersebut?
opsi_a: MPLS Direct Connect melalui Direct Connect Partner
opsi_b: Membangun dedicated cloud circuit terpisah dari setiap branch tanpa menggunakan WAN yang ada
opsi_c: Cloud OnRamp for SaaS sebagai pengganti koneksi ke IaaS workload
opsi_d: Community cloud tanpa mengubah konektivitas WAN
pembahasan: MPLS Direct Connect memanfaatkan MPLS WAN yang sudah tersedia untuk mencapai partner yang mempunyai koneksi menuju cloud provider. Membangun direct circuit dari setiap branch akan menambah biaya dan kompleksitas, sedangkan Cloud OnRamp for SaaS tidak menggantikan kebutuhan konektivitas menuju private IaaS workload.

pertanyaan: A company has 80 branches that are already connected through MPLS. The company is not close to a cloud provider's direct-connect facility, but its MPLS provider can carry traffic to a partner that has private cloud connectivity. Which solution best aligns with these conditions?
opsi_a: MPLS Direct Connect through a Direct Connect Partner
opsi_b: Build a separate dedicated cloud circuit from every branch without using the existing WAN
opsi_c: Use Cloud OnRamp for SaaS as a replacement for connectivity to IaaS workloads
opsi_d: Use a community cloud without changing WAN connectivity
pembahasan: MPLS Direct Connect can use the existing MPLS WAN to reach a partner that already has connectivity to the cloud provider. Building a direct circuit from every branch increases cost and complexity, while Cloud OnRamp for SaaS does not replace connectivity required for private IaaS workloads.

pertanyaan: User on-premises dapat melihat route menuju cloud application subnet dan ping cloud gateway berhasil, tetapi koneksi TCP ke application server tetap gagal. Routing dua arah telah diverifikasi benar. Pemeriksaan berikutnya yang paling relevan adalah?
opsi_a: Mengganti hybrid cloud menjadi community cloud
opsi_b: Periksa firewall, security group, ACL, atau policy akses yang melindungi application workload
opsi_c: Hapus seluruh route cloud agar aplikasi menggunakan default route
opsi_d: Mengaktifkan MPLS label pada application server
pembahasan: Jika routing dan return path sudah benar tetapi koneksi ke aplikasi tetap gagal, access-control policy menjadi kandidat berikutnya yang logis. Security group, firewall, ACL, atau host policy dapat mengizinkan reachability jaringan tertentu tetapi tetap memblokir TCP port aplikasi.

pertanyaan: An on-premises user can see a route to the cloud application subnet and can successfully ping the cloud gateway, but a TCP connection to the application server still fails. Bidirectional routing has been verified as correct. What should be checked next?
opsi_a: Change the hybrid cloud into a community cloud
opsi_b: Check the firewall, security group, ACL, or access policy protecting the application workload
opsi_c: Remove all cloud routes so the application uses a default route
opsi_d: Enable MPLS labels on the application server
pembahasan: If routing and the return path are correct but application connectivity still fails, access-control policy is a logical next area to investigate. A security group, firewall, ACL, or host policy may permit some network reachability while still blocking the application's TCP port.

pertanyaan: Dalam hierarchical campus design, apa fungsi utama access layer?
opsi_a: Menjadi backbone berkecepatan tinggi antar-distribution block
opsi_b: Menghubungkan end device dan menyediakan layanan akses seperti VLAN, PoE, serta edge security
opsi_c: Melakukan route summarization untuk seluruh campus
opsi_d: Menjadi titik transit utama antar-core switch
pembahasan: Access layer merupakan titik tempat PC, printer, IP phone, access point, dan end device lain memperoleh konektivitas jaringan. Fungsi backbone berada pada core, sedangkan routing dan policy agregat umumnya berada pada distribution.

pertanyaan: In a hierarchical campus design, what is the primary function of the access layer?
opsi_a: Provide the high-speed backbone between distribution blocks
opsi_b: Connect end devices and provide access services such as VLANs, PoE, and edge security
opsi_c: Perform route summarization for the entire campus
opsi_d: Act as the main transit point between core switches
pembahasan: The access layer is where PCs, printers, IP phones, access points, and other end devices obtain network connectivity. The core provides the backbone, while aggregated routing and policy functions are generally placed at the distribution layer.

pertanyaan: Sebuah campus kecil menggunakan satu pasangan multilayer switch untuk menjalankan fungsi distribution sekaligus backbone campus. Apa nama desain ini?
opsi_a: Routed-access fabric
opsi_b: Distributed core
opsi_c: Extended access design
opsi_d: Collapsed core atau two-tier design
pembahasan: Collapsed core menggabungkan fungsi distribution dan core pada layer fisik yang sama. Pendekatan ini umum digunakan ketika hanya terdapat satu distribution block dan core terpisah belum diperlukan.

pertanyaan: A small campus uses one pair of multilayer switches to provide both distribution functions and the campus backbone. What is this design called?
opsi_a: Routed-access fabric
opsi_b: Distributed core
opsi_c: Extended access design
opsi_d: Collapsed core or two-tier design
pembahasan: A collapsed core combines the distribution and core functions at the same physical layer. This approach is common when there is only one distribution block and a separate core is not yet required.

pertanyaan: Manakah pernyataan yang benar mengenai hubungan antara hierarchical layer dan jumlah tier fisik pada campus network?
opsi_a: Hierarki menentukan fungsi tiap layer, tetapi tidak mewajibkan setiap fungsi berada pada tier fisik yang terpisah
opsi_b: Setiap campus wajib memiliki tepat tiga kelompok switch fisik
opsi_c: Core dan distribution tidak boleh berada pada perangkat yang sama
opsi_d: Jumlah tier fisik selalu harus sama dengan jumlah fungsi logis
pembahasan: Hierarchical design terutama mendefinisikan peran dan fungsi access, distribution, dan core. Pada jaringan kecil core dan distribution dapat digabung, sedangkan kondisi geografis tertentu bahkan dapat menghasilkan lebih banyak tier fisik.

pertanyaan: Which statement correctly describes the relationship between hierarchical layers and physical tiers in a campus network?
opsi_a: The hierarchy defines the function of each layer but does not require every function to use a separate physical tier
opsi_b: Every campus must have exactly three physical groups of switches
opsi_c: Core and distribution functions can never exist on the same device
opsi_d: The number of physical tiers must always equal the number of logical functions
pembahasan: Hierarchical design primarily defines the roles and functions of the access, distribution, and core layers. In a smaller network the core and distribution functions can be combined, while physical geography may even require additional physical tiers.

pertanyaan: Perangkat mana yang pada access layer dapat memperluas konektivitas satu tingkat lagi dari access switch menuju perangkat lain?
opsi_a: Core switch dan WAN router
opsi_b: Distribution switch dan firewall
opsi_c: Wireless access point dan IP phone
opsi_d: Load balancer dan storage controller
pembahasan: Wireless AP memperluas konektivitas kabel menjadi wireless bagi client, sedangkan IP phone dapat memiliki port yang meneruskan konektivitas ke PC. Keduanya tetap memperoleh koneksi upstream dari access switch.

pertanyaan: Which devices at the access layer can extend connectivity one additional level beyond the access switch to other devices?
opsi_a: Core switches and WAN routers
opsi_b: Distribution switches and firewalls
opsi_c: Wireless access points and IP phones
opsi_d: Load balancers and storage controllers
pembahasan: A wireless AP extends wired connectivity to wireless clients, while an IP phone can provide an additional connection to a PC. Both still obtain their upstream connectivity from the access switch.

pertanyaan: Access layer memiliki kemampuan self-healing. Contoh yang paling tepat untuk kemampuan tersebut adalah apa?
opsi_a: Mencatat jenis aplikasi dengan NetFlow
opsi_b: Menggunakan ACL untuk memblokir guest menuju server
opsi_c: Memanfaatkan redundancy dan mekanisme recovery agar layanan tetap tersedia ketika link atau komponen gagal
opsi_d: Memberikan DSCP yang lebih tinggi kepada voice traffic
pembahasan: Self-healing berkaitan dengan resiliency dan kemampuan jaringan mempertahankan atau memulihkan layanan saat terjadi kegagalan. NetFlow lebih berkaitan dengan self-aware, security policy dengan self-defending, dan prioritas traffic dengan self-optimizing.

pertanyaan: The access layer can provide self-healing capabilities. Which example best represents this capability?
opsi_a: Record application types using NetFlow
opsi_b: Use an ACL to block guest access to servers
opsi_c: Use redundancy and recovery mechanisms to keep services available when a link or component fails
opsi_d: Assign a higher DSCP value to voice traffic
pembahasan: Self-healing relates to resiliency and the ability to maintain or restore service after a failure. NetFlow is more closely associated with self-awareness, security policy with self-defense, and traffic prioritization with self-optimization.

pertanyaan: Kemampuan access layer yang berfokus mencegah perangkat atau traffic yang tidak sah menimbulkan gangguan disebut apa?
opsi_a: Self-defending
opsi_b: Self-aggregating
opsi_c: Self-routing
opsi_d: Self-balancing
pembahasan: Self-defending mencakup mekanisme yang melindungi jaringan, misalnya access control, device authentication, segmentation, dan rogue-device detection. Tujuannya adalah mencegah gangguan sebelum berdampak pada layanan jaringan.

pertanyaan: What is the access-layer capability focused on preventing unauthorized devices or traffic from disrupting the network?
opsi_a: Self-defending
opsi_b: Self-aggregating
opsi_c: Self-routing
opsi_d: Self-balancing
pembahasan: Self-defending includes mechanisms that protect the network, such as access control, device authentication, segmentation, and rogue-device detection. Its purpose is to prevent disruptions before they affect network services.

pertanyaan: Sebuah jaringan memberikan prioritas kepada voice dan menyesuaikan resource wireless ketika kondisi RF berubah. Kemampuan access layer mana yang paling sesuai?
opsi_a: Self-aware
opsi_b: Self-defending
opsi_c: Self-healing
opsi_d: Self-optimizing
pembahasan: Self-optimizing berarti jaringan menyesuaikan penggunaan resource agar aplikasi atau perangkat memperoleh layanan yang sesuai. QoS dan optimasi radio wireless merupakan contoh penerapan konsep ini.

pertanyaan: A network prioritizes voice traffic and adjusts wireless resources when RF conditions change. Which access-layer capability best matches this behavior?
opsi_a: Self-aware
opsi_b: Self-defending
opsi_c: Self-healing
opsi_d: Self-optimizing
pembahasan: Self-optimizing means adapting network resources so applications or devices receive an appropriate level of service. QoS and wireless radio optimization are examples of this concept.

pertanyaan: Administrator ingin mengetahui aplikasi yang digunakan, pola traffic, dan bagaimana user berinteraksi dengan jaringan. Kemampuan access layer mana yang paling relevan?
opsi_a: Self-healing
opsi_b: Self-aware
opsi_c: Self-defending
opsi_d: Self-optimizing
pembahasan: Self-aware berfokus pada visibility dan insight mengenai user, perangkat, aplikasi, dan traffic jaringan. Teknologi seperti NetFlow, NBAR, telemetry, dan wireless analytics dapat mendukung kemampuan tersebut.

pertanyaan: An administrator wants visibility into applications, traffic patterns, and how users interact with the network. Which access-layer capability is most relevant?
opsi_a: Self-healing
opsi_b: Self-aware
opsi_c: Self-defending
opsi_d: Self-optimizing
pembahasan: Self-aware focuses on visibility and insight into users, devices, applications, and network traffic. Technologies such as NetFlow, NBAR, telemetry, and wireless analytics can support this capability.

pertanyaan: Mengapa access layer disebut sebagai salah satu bagian campus network yang paling feature-rich?
opsi_a: Karena berhadapan dengan beragam jenis endpoint serta kebutuhan connectivity, security, QoS, PoE, dan dynamic configuration
opsi_b: Karena access layer harus menyimpan seluruh route Internet
opsi_c: Karena semua traffic antar-campus wajib dirutekan oleh access switch
opsi_d: Karena access layer selalu menjalankan fungsi core sekaligus distribution
pembahasan: Access layer berhadapan langsung dengan banyak jenis perangkat dan kebutuhan layanan yang berbeda. Karena itu berbagai fungsi connectivity, authentication, segmentation, QoS, PoE, dan protection sering diterapkan pada layer ini.

pertanyaan: Why is the access layer considered one of the most feature-rich parts of a campus network?
opsi_a: Because it handles many endpoint types and their connectivity, security, QoS, PoE, and dynamic configuration requirements
opsi_b: Because the access layer must store every Internet route
opsi_c: Because all inter-campus traffic must be routed by access switches
opsi_d: Because the access layer always performs both core and distribution functions
pembahasan: The access layer directly serves many device types with different service requirements. Therefore, connectivity, authentication, segmentation, QoS, PoE, and protection functions are commonly implemented there.

pertanyaan: Mengapa distribution layer disebut service and control boundary antara access dan core?
opsi_a: Karena hanya menyediakan physical port untuk endpoint
opsi_b: Karena hanya memperpanjang VLAN tanpa melakukan keputusan Layer 3
opsi_c: Karena menjadi titik agregasi, routing, filtering, QoS, dan penerapan policy sebelum traffic menuju core
opsi_d: Karena menggantikan seluruh fungsi core pada semua ukuran campus
pembahasan: Distribution mengumpulkan access layer sekaligus menjadi lokasi yang tepat untuk routing dan policy. Core kemudian dapat tetap fokus pada transport berkecepatan tinggi dan high availability.

pertanyaan: Why is the distribution layer described as a service and control boundary between the access and core layers?
opsi_a: Because it only provides physical ports for endpoints
opsi_b: Because it only extends VLANs without making Layer 3 decisions
opsi_c: Because it serves as an aggregation, routing, filtering, QoS, and policy enforcement point before traffic reaches the core
opsi_d: Because it replaces every core function in campuses of all sizes
pembahasan: The distribution layer aggregates the access layer while providing an appropriate location for routing and policy enforcement. This allows the core to remain focused on high-speed transport and high availability.

pertanyaan: Apa manfaat utama distribution layer mengagregasi beberapa access switch?
opsi_a: Membuat setiap endpoint memiliki koneksi langsung ke core
opsi_b: Mengurangi kompleksitas koneksi menuju core dengan mengumpulkan banyak access node pada distribution block
opsi_c: Menghilangkan kebutuhan VLAN pada access layer
opsi_d: Membuat semua access switch menjadi satu perangkat fisik
pembahasan: Distribution layer mengumpulkan banyak access switch sehingga core tidak perlu menerima koneksi dari setiap access switch secara langsung. Struktur ini meningkatkan modularity dan menyederhanakan pertumbuhan serta troubleshooting.

pertanyaan: What is a primary benefit of aggregating multiple access switches at the distribution layer?
opsi_a: It gives every endpoint a direct connection to the core
opsi_b: It reduces connectivity complexity toward the core by collecting multiple access nodes into a distribution block
opsi_c: It eliminates the need for VLANs at the access layer
opsi_d: It physically combines all access switches into one device
pembahasan: The distribution layer aggregates many access switches so the core does not require a direct link from every access switch. This structure improves modularity and simplifies growth and troubleshooting.

pertanyaan: Mengapa access switch pada desain resilien sering memiliki koneksi menuju dua distribution node?
opsi_a: Agar kedua distribution menggunakan physical IP yang sama
opsi_b: Agar STP tidak perlu berjalan dalam kondisi apa pun
opsi_c: Agar semua traffic selalu melewati kedua distribution secara berurutan
opsi_d: Agar kegagalan satu link atau satu distribution node tidak langsung memutus access layer
pembahasan: Dual attachment menyediakan jalur alternatif ketika salah satu uplink atau distribution node gagal. Cara forwarding kedua jalur bergantung pada apakah desain menggunakan Layer 2, EtherChannel, stacking, atau routed access.

pertanyaan: Why does an access switch in a resilient design commonly connect to two distribution nodes?
opsi_a: So both distribution nodes can use the same physical IP address
opsi_b: So STP never needs to operate under any condition
opsi_c: So all traffic always traverses both distribution nodes sequentially
opsi_d: So failure of one link or one distribution node does not immediately disconnect the access layer
pembahasan: Dual attachment provides an alternate path if an uplink or distribution node fails. How both paths forward traffic depends on whether the design uses Layer 2, EtherChannel, stacking, or routed access.

pertanyaan: DIST1 memiliki dua routed uplink ke CORE1 dan CORE2. Untuk prefix yang sama, routing table memasang dua next hop dengan metric identik. Apa karakteristik desain yang sedang dimanfaatkan?
opsi_a: FHRP gateway virtualization
opsi_b: STP root redundancy
opsi_c: Unequal-cost traffic sharing
opsi_d: Layer 3 equal-cost load sharing atau ECMP
pembahasan: ECMP memungkinkan beberapa jalur Layer 3 dengan metric sama berada di routing table dan digunakan untuk forwarding. Ini berbeda dari FHRP yang menyediakan gateway redundancy dan STP yang mengendalikan loop Layer 2.

pertanyaan: DIST1 has two routed uplinks to CORE1 and CORE2. For the same prefix, the routing table installs two next hops with identical metrics. Which design characteristic is being used?
opsi_a: FHRP gateway virtualization
opsi_b: STP root redundancy
opsi_c: Unequal-cost traffic sharing
opsi_d: Layer 3 equal-cost load sharing or ECMP
pembahasan: ECMP allows multiple Layer 3 paths with equal metrics to be installed and used for forwarding. This differs from FHRP, which provides gateway redundancy, and STP, which controls Layer 2 loops.

pertanyaan:
Pada traditional Layer 2 access design, uplink ACCESS1 menuju DIST1 membawa VLAN 10 sebagai trunk. DIST1 memiliki konfigurasi berikut:
[cli]
interface Vlan10
 ip address 10.10.10.2 255.255.255.0
[/cli]
Apa arti desain tersebut?
opsi_a: VLAN 10 diterminasi pada ACCESS1 dan DIST1 hanya melakukan Layer 2 forwarding
opsi_b: VLAN 10 dibawa secara Layer 2 menuju DIST1 dan boundary Layer 3-nya berada pada SVI di DIST1
opsi_c: VLAN 10 diterminasi pada core sehingga SVI DIST1 tidak digunakan untuk routing
opsi_d: Interface Vlan10 mengubah seluruh uplink DIST1 menjadi routed port
pembahasan: Pada traditional multilayer campus, access dapat membawa user VLAN melalui trunk menuju distribution. SVI pada distribution menjadi titik Layer 3 untuk subnet tersebut dan dapat berfungsi sebagai default gateway atau bagian dari gateway redundancy.

pertanyaan:
In a traditional Layer 2 access design, the ACCESS1 uplink to DIST1 carries VLAN 10 as a trunk. DIST1 has the following configuration:
[cli]
interface Vlan10
 ip address 10.10.10.2 255.255.255.0
[/cli]
What does this design indicate?
opsi_a: VLAN 10 terminates at ACCESS1 and DIST1 only performs Layer 2 forwarding
opsi_b: VLAN 10 is carried at Layer 2 to DIST1 and its Layer 3 boundary is the SVI on DIST1
opsi_c: VLAN 10 terminates at the core, so the DIST1 SVI is not used for routing
opsi_d: Interface Vlan10 converts every DIST1 uplink into a routed port
pembahasan: In a traditional multilayer campus, the access layer can carry user VLANs over trunks to the distribution layer. The distribution SVI becomes the Layer 3 point for that subnet and can serve as the default gateway or participate in gateway redundancy.

pertanyaan: Satu distribution block memiliki 10.10.0.0/24, 10.10.1.0/24, 10.10.2.0/24, dan 10.10.3.0/24. Apa manfaat utama jika distribution mengiklankan summary 10.10.0.0/22 menuju core?
opsi_a: Core memperoleh lebih banyak route sehingga convergence lebih detail
opsi_b: Seluruh subnet otomatis berubah menjadi satu broadcast domain
opsi_c: Jumlah route pada core berkurang dan perubahan pada more-specific route dapat lebih terisolasi
opsi_d: Core tidak lagi membutuhkan routing protocol
pembahasan: Empat prefix /24 yang kontigu dapat direpresentasikan oleh 10.10.0.0/22. Summarization mengurangi informasi routing yang harus diproses core dan dapat membatasi propagasi perubahan route tertentu.

pertanyaan: A distribution block contains 10.10.0.0/24, 10.10.1.0/24, 10.10.2.0/24, and 10.10.3.0/24. What is a primary benefit of advertising the 10.10.0.0/22 summary toward the core?
opsi_a: The core receives more routes for more detailed convergence
opsi_b: All of the subnets automatically become a single broadcast domain
opsi_c: The number of core routes is reduced and changes to more-specific routes can be better isolated
opsi_d: The core no longer requires a routing protocol
pembahasan: The four contiguous /24 prefixes can be represented by 10.10.0.0/22. Summarization reduces the routing information processed by the core and can limit propagation of individual route changes.

pertanyaan:
DIST1 dan DIST2 melayani VLAN 20. DIST1 memiliki konfigurasi:
[cli]
interface Vlan20
 ip address 10.20.20.2 255.255.255.0
 standby 20 ip 10.20.20.1
 standby 20 priority 110
 standby 20 preempt
[/cli]
Apa tujuan utama penggunaan HSRP pada desain ini?
opsi_a: Menyediakan virtual default gateway yang tetap tersedia jika distribution node aktif gagal
opsi_b: Menggabungkan dua physical uplink menjadi satu EtherChannel
opsi_c: Membuat VLAN 20 dapat melewati router tanpa routing
opsi_d: Menggantikan seluruh fungsi dynamic routing menuju core
pembahasan: HSRP menyediakan sebuah virtual IP yang digunakan endpoint sebagai default gateway sementara distribution nodes menentukan perangkat active dan standby. EtherChannel menangani agregasi link, sedangkan routing ke core tetap merupakan fungsi terpisah.

pertanyaan:
DIST1 and DIST2 serve VLAN 20. DIST1 has the following configuration:
[cli]
interface Vlan20
 ip address 10.20.20.2 255.255.255.0
 standby 20 ip 10.20.20.1
 standby 20 priority 110
 standby 20 preempt
[/cli]
What is the primary purpose of HSRP in this design?
opsi_a: Provide a virtual default gateway that remains available if the active distribution node fails
opsi_b: Combine two physical uplinks into one EtherChannel
opsi_c: Allow VLAN 20 to cross a router without routing
opsi_d: Replace all dynamic routing functions toward the core
pembahasan: HSRP provides a virtual IP that endpoints use as their default gateway while the distribution nodes determine active and standby roles. EtherChannel handles link aggregation, while routing toward the core remains a separate function.

pertanyaan: Apa fungsi utama core layer dalam three-tier campus design?
opsi_a: Menjadi lokasi utama endpoint authentication
opsi_b: Menjadi backbone berkecepatan tinggi yang menghubungkan distribution block dan modul campus lainnya
opsi_c: Menyediakan access port untuk PC dan printer
opsi_d: Menjadi lokasi utama seluruh user VLAN dan policy kompleks
pembahasan: Core menyediakan konektivitas backbone antarbagian campus dan harus dirancang untuk availability serta forwarding yang tinggi. Endpoint connectivity berada di access dan sebagian besar policy ditempatkan pada distribution atau service boundary yang sesuai.

pertanyaan: What is the primary function of the core layer in a three-tier campus design?
opsi_a: Serve as the main location for endpoint authentication
opsi_b: Provide a high-speed backbone connecting distribution blocks and other campus modules
opsi_c: Provide access ports for PCs and printers
opsi_d: Host all user VLANs and complex policies
pembahasan: The core provides backbone connectivity between campus components and is designed for high availability and forwarding performance. Endpoint connectivity belongs at the access layer, while most policy functions belong at the distribution or another appropriate service boundary.

pertanyaan: Desain core mana yang paling sesuai dengan prinsip keep the core simple?
opsi_a: Membatasi core pada high-speed Layer 3 forwarding, redundancy, dan layanan kontrol minimum yang diperlukan
opsi_b: Menempatkan seluruh NAT, firewall policy, user authentication, dan application inspection di core
opsi_c: Menghubungkan user dan server langsung ke core untuk mengurangi hop
opsi_d: Memperpanjang sebanyak mungkin VLAN Layer 2 melalui seluruh core
pembahasan: Core sebaiknya memiliki fungsi sesederhana mungkin agar stabil, mudah dikonvergensikan, dan mudah dioperasikan. Complex policy atau koneksi endpoint langsung meningkatkan coupling dan memperbesar dampak kesalahan pada bagian jaringan yang sangat kritis.

pertanyaan: Which core design best follows the keep-the-core-simple principle?
opsi_a: Limit the core to high-speed Layer 3 forwarding, redundancy, and only the necessary control functions
opsi_b: Place all NAT, firewall policy, user authentication, and application inspection in the core
opsi_c: Connect users and servers directly to the core to reduce hop count
opsi_d: Extend as many Layer 2 VLANs as possible through the entire core
pembahasan: The core should remain as simple as practical so it is stable, converges predictably, and is easier to operate. Complex policy or direct endpoint connectivity increases coupling and expands the impact of errors in this critical part of the network.

pertanyaan: Sebuah campus memiliki CORE1 dan CORE2 sehingga kegagalan CORE1 masih menyisakan jalur melalui CORE2. Namun setelah CORE1 gagal, traffic terputus selama 25 detik sebelum berpindah. Kesimpulan paling tepat adalah apa?
opsi_a: Jaringan tidak memiliki redundancy
opsi_b: Masalah hanya dapat diselesaikan dengan menambahkan VLAN
opsi_c: Core seharusnya diubah menjadi Layer 2 agar recovery lebih cepat
opsi_d: Redundancy tersedia, tetapi mekanisme failure detection atau convergence belum memenuhi kebutuhan fast path recovery
pembahasan: Keberadaan CORE2 menunjukkan bahwa jalur cadangan tersedia sehingga redundancy memang ada. Gangguan 25 detik menunjukkan persoalan pada kecepatan deteksi atau convergence, bukan ketiadaan jalur alternatif.

pertanyaan: A campus has CORE1 and CORE2, so failure of CORE1 still leaves a path through CORE2. However, after CORE1 fails, traffic is interrupted for 25 seconds before switching paths. What is the best conclusion?
opsi_a: The network has no redundancy
opsi_b: The problem can only be solved by adding another VLAN
opsi_c: The core should be converted to Layer 2 for faster recovery
opsi_d: Redundancy exists, but failure detection or convergence does not meet the fast path recovery requirement
pembahasan: The existence of CORE2 means an alternate path is available, so redundancy exists. The 25-second interruption indicates a problem with failure detection or convergence speed rather than a lack of an alternate path.

pertanyaan: Mengapa separate core layer menjadi semakin bermanfaat ketika jumlah distribution block bertambah?
opsi_a: Karena setiap distribution tidak lagi membutuhkan IP address
opsi_b: Karena core menghilangkan kebutuhan redundancy pada distribution
opsi_c: Karena core menyediakan common connectivity point sehingga distribution block tidak perlu membentuk interkoneksi kompleks satu sama lain
opsi_d: Karena semua access VLAN dapat digabung menjadi satu subnet
pembahasan: Separate core membuat arsitektur lebih modular saat jumlah distribution block bertambah. Setiap block dapat terhubung ke backbone yang konsisten daripada membuat banyak hubungan langsung antar-distribution.

pertanyaan: Why does a separate core layer become increasingly valuable as the number of distribution blocks grows?
opsi_a: Because distribution devices no longer require IP addresses
opsi_b: Because the core eliminates the need for redundancy at the distribution layer
opsi_c: Because the core provides a common connectivity point so distribution blocks do not need complex interconnections with each other
opsi_d: Because all access VLANs can be combined into one subnet
pembahasan: A separate core makes the architecture more modular as the number of distribution blocks increases. Each block can connect to a consistent backbone instead of requiring numerous direct distribution-to-distribution relationships.

pertanyaan: Organisasi memiliki beberapa gedung, banyak distribution block, lebih dari 15.000 wired dan wireless devices, serta membutuhkan high availability dan advanced segmentation. Desain yang paling sesuai adalah apa?
opsi_a: Small-site campus
opsi_b: Medium-density collapsed core
opsi_c: High-density large campus design
opsi_d: Single access switch design
pembahasan: High-density large campus ditujukan untuk skala besar, beberapa distribution block, core terpisah, dan kebutuhan availability serta advanced capabilities yang tinggi. Angka kapasitas merupakan panduan desain, bukan batas mutlak yang berdiri sendiri.

pertanyaan: An organization has several buildings, multiple distribution blocks, more than 15,000 wired and wireless devices, and requires high availability and advanced segmentation. Which design is most appropriate?
opsi_a: Small-site campus
opsi_b: Medium-density collapsed core
opsi_c: High-density large campus design
opsi_d: Single access switch design
pembahasan: The high-density large campus model is intended for large scale, multiple distribution blocks, a separate core, and strong availability and advanced-feature requirements. The capacity figure is a design guideline rather than an absolute threshold by itself.

pertanyaan: Manakah karakteristik yang paling sesuai dengan medium-density campus design?
opsi_a: Banyak distribution block dan separate core selalu wajib
opsi_b: Hanya boleh menggunakan satu access switch
opsi_c: Selalu digunakan untuk lebih dari 15.000 endpoint
opsi_d: Biasanya memiliki satu distribution layer atau block yang dapat berfungsi sebagai collapsed core dan melayani ratusan perangkat
pembahasan: Medium-density umumnya menambahkan distribution layer di atas sejumlah access switch dan dapat memakai model two-tier. Kebutuhan redundancy dan platform dipilih sesuai business continuity, bukan semata-mata berdasarkan satu angka endpoint.

pertanyaan: Which characteristic best matches a medium-density campus design?
opsi_a: Multiple distribution blocks and a separate core are always mandatory
opsi_b: Only one access switch may be used
opsi_c: It is always used for more than 15,000 endpoints
opsi_d: It typically has a single distribution layer or block that can act as a collapsed core and serve hundreds of devices
pembahasan: A medium-density design generally adds a distribution layer above a number of access switches and can use a two-tier model. Redundancy and platform choices depend on business continuity requirements rather than one endpoint count alone.

pertanyaan: Sebuah kantor memiliki puluhan wired dan wireless devices dan kurang dari sekitar 25 AP. Satu access switch stack mencukupi kebutuhan port. Desain mana yang paling sesuai?
opsi_a: Small-site campus design
opsi_b: High-density three-tier design
opsi_c: Multiple-distribution campus
opsi_d: Dedicated-core campus
pembahasan: Small-site campus dirancang untuk lokasi dengan jumlah endpoint relatif kecil dan dapat menggunakan satu access switch atau satu access stack. Distribution layer terpisah tidak harus ditambahkan jika kebutuhan skala dan fungsi belum memerlukannya.

pertanyaan: An office has dozens of wired and wireless devices and fewer than approximately 25 APs. One access-switch stack provides enough ports. Which design is most appropriate?
opsi_a: Small-site campus design
opsi_b: High-density three-tier design
opsi_c: Multiple-distribution campus
opsi_d: Dedicated-core campus
pembahasan: A small-site campus is intended for locations with a relatively small number of endpoints and may use one access switch or one access stack. A separate distribution layer does not need to be added unless scale or functional requirements justify it.

pertanyaan: Sebuah site hanya memiliki 35 pengguna, tetapi menjalankan layanan operasional yang tidak boleh terputus saat satu uplink atau power supply gagal. Apa keputusan desain yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Karena user sedikit, redundancy tidak boleh digunakan
opsi_b: Tetap dapat menggunakan small-site design sambil menambahkan redundancy yang dibutuhkan oleh business requirement
opsi_c: Site harus dikategorikan high-density hanya karena membutuhkan redundancy
opsi_d: Jumlah user harus dinaikkan sebelum high availability dapat diterapkan
pembahasan: Ukuran site dan tingkat criticality merupakan dimensi yang berbeda. Small-site tetap dapat menggunakan redundant uplink, power, stack, atau fitur advanced ketika kebutuhan bisnis menuntut availability yang lebih tinggi.

pertanyaan: A site has only 35 users but runs an operational service that must remain available after a single uplink or power-supply failure. What is the best design decision?
opsi_a: Redundancy must not be used because the user count is small
opsi_b: Keep a small-site design while adding the redundancy required by the business requirement
opsi_c: The site must be classified as high-density only because it requires redundancy
opsi_d: The number of users must increase before high availability can be implemented
pembahasan: Site size and service criticality are separate design dimensions. A small site can still use redundant uplinks, power, stacking, or advanced capabilities when the business requires higher availability.

pertanyaan: Sebuah perusahaan memiliki satu gedung dengan sekitar 600 endpoint, 20 AP, beberapa access switch, dan hanya satu distribution block. Business continuity dibutuhkan, tetapi tidak ada kebutuhan untuk banyak distribution block. Desain awal mana yang paling rasional?
opsi_a: Medium-density two-tier design dengan redundant distribution/collapsed-core sesuai kebutuhan
opsi_b: High-density three-tier dengan separate core wajib
opsi_c: Small-site dengan satu access switch tanpa distribution
opsi_d: Full-mesh Layer 2 antar-semua access switch
pembahasan: Kebutuhan tersebut lebih cocok dengan medium-density karena terdapat beberapa access switch dan satu distribution block, tetapi belum ada kebutuhan kuat untuk separate core. Redundant distribution dapat tetap digunakan agar business continuity terpenuhi tanpa menambah tier yang tidak diperlukan.

pertanyaan: A company has one building with about 600 endpoints, 20 APs, several access switches, and only one distribution block. Business continuity is required, but there is no need for multiple distribution blocks. Which initial design is most reasonable?
opsi_a: A medium-density two-tier design with redundant distribution or collapsed-core devices as required
opsi_b: A mandatory high-density three-tier design with a separate core
opsi_c: A small-site design with one access switch and no distribution layer
opsi_d: A full Layer 2 mesh between every access switch
pembahasan: This requirement fits a medium-density design because it has multiple access switches and a single distribution block but no strong requirement for a separate core. Redundant distribution devices can still provide business continuity without adding an unnecessary tier.

pertanyaan: Sebuah campus awalnya memiliki dua distribution block yang saling terhubung. Setelah ekspansi menjadi empat block, kebutuhan direct interconnection antar-block menjadi semakin kompleks. Perubahan arsitektur mana yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Memperpanjang seluruh VLAN access ke setiap distribution block
opsi_b: Menghilangkan routing protocol agar topologi lebih sederhana
opsi_c: Menghubungkan setiap access switch langsung ke seluruh distribution switch
opsi_d: Menambahkan redundant Layer 3 core sebagai common backbone bagi seluruh distribution block
pembahasan: Ketika jumlah distribution block bertambah, separate Layer 3 core menyediakan pola konektivitas yang konsisten dan scalable. Membuat direct mesh atau memperluas Layer 2 justru meningkatkan kompleksitas dan failure domain.

pertanyaan: A campus initially has two interconnected distribution blocks. After expansion to four blocks, direct interconnections between the blocks become increasingly complex. Which architectural change is most appropriate?
opsi_a: Extend every access VLAN to every distribution block
opsi_b: Remove the routing protocol to simplify the topology
opsi_c: Connect every access switch directly to every distribution switch
opsi_d: Add a redundant Layer 3 core as a common backbone for all distribution blocks
pembahasan: As the number of distribution blocks increases, a separate Layer 3 core provides a consistent and scalable connectivity model. Building a direct mesh or extending Layer 2 instead increases complexity and failure-domain size.

pertanyaan: Pada traditional Layer 2 access block, DIST1 adalah STP root VLAN 30 tetapi DIST2 adalah HSRP Active untuk VLAN 30. User terhubung pada access switch yang jalur Layer 2 optimalnya menuju DIST1. Apa perbaikan desain yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Menonaktifkan STP pada VLAN 30
opsi_b: Menyelaraskan HSRP Active dan STP root untuk VLAN 30 pada distribution node yang sama
opsi_c: Menghapus HSRP dan menggunakan physical IP DIST1 sebagai gateway seluruh user
opsi_d: Memindahkan STP root ke access switch
pembahasan: Jika STP root dan active default gateway berada pada distribution yang berbeda, traffic dapat melintasi inter-distribution link secara tidak perlu. Menyelaraskan lokasi HSRP Active dan STP root membuat jalur Layer 2 dan Layer 3 lebih deterministik.

pertanyaan: In a traditional Layer 2 access block, DIST1 is the STP root for VLAN 30 but DIST2 is the HSRP Active device for VLAN 30. Users attach to an access switch whose optimal Layer 2 path leads to DIST1. What is the best design correction?
opsi_a: Disable STP for VLAN 30
opsi_b: Align the HSRP Active gateway and STP root for VLAN 30 on the same distribution node
opsi_c: Remove HSRP and use the physical DIST1 address as the gateway for every user
opsi_d: Move the STP root to the access switch
pembahasan: If the STP root and active default gateway reside on different distribution switches, traffic may unnecessarily traverse the inter-distribution link. Aligning the HSRP Active device with the STP root makes Layer 2 and Layer 3 forwarding more deterministic.

pertanyaan:
DIST1 dan DIST2 seharusnya berada dalam HSRP group 10 pada VLAN 10 dengan virtual IP 10.10.10.1. Potongan output ilustratif menunjukkan:
[output]
DIST1# show standby brief
Vlan10  10  110  Active  local  unknown  10.10.10.1

DIST2# show standby brief
Vlan10  10  100  Active  local  unknown  10.10.10.1
[/output]
Keduanya menganggap dirinya Active. Penyebab yang paling masuk akal untuk diperiksa terlebih dahulu adalah apa?
opsi_a: Priority DIST1 terlalu tinggi sehingga kedua perangkat selalu menjadi Active
opsi_b: Virtual IP seharusnya berbeda pada kedua perangkat
opsi_c: Kedua HSRP peer tidak saling menerima hello, sehingga konektivitas Layer 2 atau parameter HSRP di antara keduanya perlu diperiksa
opsi_d: HSRP selalu membutuhkan routed port ke core untuk membentuk neighbor
pembahasan: Dua peer dalam group yang sama seharusnya saling mendengar hello dan melakukan pemilihan state. Kondisi keduanya Active dengan peer unknown mengarah pada hilangnya komunikasi HSRP, misalnya VLAN tidak tersambung dengan benar atau terdapat mismatch konfigurasi group/authentication/version.

pertanyaan:
DIST1 and DIST2 should participate in HSRP group 10 on VLAN 10 with virtual IP 10.10.10.1. The following simplified illustrative output is shown:
[output]
DIST1# show standby brief
Vlan10  10  110  Active  local  unknown  10.10.10.1

DIST2# show standby brief
Vlan10  10  100  Active  local  unknown  10.10.10.1
[/output]
Both devices consider themselves Active. What is the most reasonable condition to investigate first?
opsi_a: DIST1 has too high a priority, which always causes both devices to become Active
opsi_b: The virtual IP must be different on the two devices
opsi_c: The HSRP peers are not receiving each other's hello messages, so Layer 2 connectivity or HSRP parameters between them should be checked
opsi_d: HSRP always requires a routed link to the core before peers can form
pembahasan: Peers in the same HSRP group should hear each other's hello messages and elect their states. Two Active devices with an unknown peer suggest lost HSRP communication, such as incorrect VLAN connectivity or a mismatch in group, authentication, or version parameters.

pertanyaan: Pada Cisco IOS XE multilayer switch, interface TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1 akan digunakan sebagai point-to-point Layer 3 link dari distribution menuju core dengan alamat 10.255.0.1/30. Konfigurasi mana yang tepat?
opsi_a:
[cli]
interface TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10
[/cli]
opsi_b:
[cli]
interface TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 255
[/cli]
opsi_c:
[cli]
interface TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1
 ip address 10.255.0.1 255.255.255.252
 switchport mode trunk
[/cli]
opsi_d:
[cli]
interface TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1
 no switchport
 ip address 10.255.0.1 255.255.255.252
[/cli]
pembahasan: Pada multilayer switch Cisco IOS XE, no switchport menjadikan interface sebagai routed Layer 3 port sehingga IP address dapat diterapkan langsung. Access dan trunk mode tetap merupakan fungsi switchport Layer 2.

pertanyaan: On a Cisco IOS XE multilayer switch, TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1 will be used as a point-to-point Layer 3 link from the distribution layer to the core with address 10.255.0.1/30. Which configuration is correct?
opsi_a:
[cli]
interface TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10
[/cli]
opsi_b:
[cli]
interface TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 255
[/cli]
opsi_c:
[cli]
interface TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1
 ip address 10.255.0.1 255.255.255.252
 switchport mode trunk
[/cli]
opsi_d:
[cli]
interface TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1
 no switchport
 ip address 10.255.0.1 255.255.255.252
[/cli]
pembahasan: On a Cisco IOS XE multilayer switch, no switchport converts the interface into a routed Layer 3 port so an IP address can be configured directly. Access and trunk modes remain Layer 2 switchport functions.

pertanyaan: Dua uplink core masing-masing berkapasitas 40 Gbps dan kondisi normal membawa total traffic 60 Gbps melalui ECMP. Desain mengharuskan layanan tetap berjalan tanpa congestion setelah kegagalan satu uplink. Apa masalah desain yang harus diperbaiki?
opsi_a: ECMP tidak dapat digunakan pada Layer 3 core
opsi_b: Semua traffic harus dipaksa melewati satu link bahkan saat normal
opsi_c: Kapasitas jalur yang tersisa tidak cukup untuk kondisi failure karena 60 Gbps harus melewati satu link 40 Gbps
opsi_d: HSRP harus dikonfigurasi pada routed uplink core
pembahasan: Redundancy tidak hanya berarti tersedia jalur kedua; surviving path juga harus memiliki kapasitas yang memadai untuk kondisi kegagalan yang direncanakan. Dalam skenario ini satu link 40 Gbps tidak mampu membawa load 60 Gbps tanpa congestion.

pertanyaan: Two core uplinks are each 40 Gbps and normally carry a total of 60 Gbps using ECMP. The design requires service to continue without congestion after one uplink fails. What design issue must be corrected?
opsi_a: ECMP cannot be used in a Layer 3 core
opsi_b: All traffic must be forced through one link even during normal operation
opsi_c: The surviving path lacks sufficient failure-state capacity because 60 Gbps would have to cross one 40-Gbps link
opsi_d: HSRP must be configured on the routed core uplinks
pembahasan: Redundancy means more than having a second path; the surviving path must also have enough capacity for the planned failure condition. Here, one 40-Gbps link cannot carry a 60-Gbps load without congestion.

pertanyaan: Distribution mengiklankan summary 10.10.0.0/16 ke core dan memiliki discard route untuk summary tersebut. Hanya beberapa subnet /24 di dalam /16 yang benar-benar tersedia. Core menerima packet menuju 10.10.99.10, tetapi distribution tidak memiliki more-specific route untuk 10.10.99.0/24. Apa hasil yang paling mungkin?
opsi_a: Core otomatis membuat route /24 baru
opsi_b: Packet mencapai distribution berdasarkan summary lalu dibuang oleh discard route karena tidak ada more-specific route
opsi_c: Packet otomatis dikirim kembali ke core tanpa batas
opsi_d: Summary berubah otomatis menjadi default route
pembahasan: Summary membuat core menganggap keseluruhan aggregate dapat dicapai melalui distribution. Pada summarizing router, discard route mencegah routing loop dengan membuang traffic untuk bagian aggregate yang tidak memiliki more-specific route.

pertanyaan: The distribution layer advertises summary 10.10.0.0/16 to the core and has a discard route for that summary. Only some /24 subnets inside the /16 actually exist. The core sends a packet to 10.10.99.10, but the distribution device has no more-specific route for 10.10.99.0/24. What is the most likely result?
opsi_a: The core automatically creates a new /24 route
opsi_b: The packet reaches the distribution device because of the summary and is then discarded because no more-specific route exists
opsi_c: The packet is automatically sent back to the core indefinitely
opsi_d: The summary automatically becomes a default route
pembahasan: The summary causes the core to consider the entire aggregate reachable through the distribution device. A discard route on the summarizing router prevents a routing loop by dropping traffic for portions of the aggregate that do not have a more-specific route.

pertanyaan: Sebuah network architect ingin agar gangguan STP pada satu access-distribution block tidak memengaruhi backbone antar-gedung. Pendekatan mana yang paling mendukung tujuan tersebut?
opsi_a: Gunakan routed Layer 3 core sehingga STP dan broadcast domain dari access block tidak diperpanjang melalui backbone
opsi_b: Perpanjang seluruh user VLAN secara Layer 2 melalui semua core dan distribution switch
opsi_c: Gunakan satu VLAN native yang sama untuk seluruh campus
opsi_d: Hubungkan semua distribution dengan Layer 2 full mesh
pembahasan: Layer 3 core memisahkan Layer 2 failure domain antar-distribution block dan menggunakan routing untuk connectivity backbone. Memperpanjang VLAN serta membuat Layer 2 mesh justru memperluas ketergantungan terhadap STP dan meningkatkan risiko fault propagation.

pertanyaan: A network architect wants an STP problem in one access-distribution block to avoid affecting the inter-building backbone. Which approach best supports this goal?
opsi_a: Use a routed Layer 3 core so STP and broadcast domains from the access block are not extended across the backbone
opsi_b: Extend every user VLAN at Layer 2 through all core and distribution switches
opsi_c: Use one common native VLAN throughout the entire campus
opsi_d: Connect all distribution devices in a Layer 2 full mesh
pembahasan: A Layer 3 core separates Layer 2 failure domains between distribution blocks and uses routing for backbone connectivity. Extending VLANs or building a Layer 2 mesh instead expands STP dependency and increases the potential for fault propagation.

pertanyaan: Manakah tiga model distribution layer design yang dibahas pada materi ini?
opsi_a: Traditional distribution, routed core, dan collapsed core
opsi_b: Traditional distribution, simplified distribution, dan Software-Defined Access
opsi_c: Loop-free distribution, looped distribution, dan routed access
opsi_d: Traditional access, simplified access, dan Software-Defined WAN
pembahasan: Tiga model utama yang dibahas adalah traditional distribution layer design, simplified distribution layer design, dan Software-Defined Access design. Loop-free dan looped merupakan variasi topologi pada traditional design, bukan model utama yang terpisah.

pertanyaan: Which three distribution layer design models are discussed in this material?
opsi_a: Traditional distribution, routed core, and collapsed core
opsi_b: Traditional distribution, simplified distribution, and Software-Defined Access
opsi_c: Loop-free distribution, looped distribution, and routed access
opsi_d: Traditional access, simplified access, and Software-Defined WAN
pembahasan: The three main models are traditional distribution layer design, simplified distribution layer design, and Software-Defined Access design. Loop-free and looped are topology variations within the traditional design, not separate primary models.

pertanyaan: Pada traditional multilayer campus design, di manakah Layer 3 boundary biasanya berada?
opsi_a: Pada endpoint karena setiap endpoint melakukan routing
opsi_b: Pada core karena access dan distribution selalu Layer 2
opsi_c: Pada access karena semua access switch wajib routed access
opsi_d: Pada distribution layer, sedangkan access ke distribution tetap Layer 2
pembahasan: Pada traditional design, konektivitas access-to-distribution menggunakan Layer 2 dan batas menuju Layer 3 berada di distribution layer. Karena itu distribution biasanya menjadi lokasi SVI, default gateway, dan routing menuju bagian jaringan di atasnya.

pertanyaan: In a traditional multilayer campus design, where is the Layer 3 boundary typically located?
opsi_a: At the endpoints because every endpoint performs routing
opsi_b: At the core because both access and distribution are always Layer 2
opsi_c: At the access layer because all access switches must use routed access
opsi_d: At the distribution layer, while access-to-distribution remains Layer 2
pembahasan: In the traditional design, access-to-distribution connectivity is Layer 2 and the Layer 3 boundary is at the distribution layer. Therefore, the distribution layer commonly hosts SVIs, default gateways, and routing toward the rest of the network.

pertanyaan: Apa rekomendasi utama untuk mengurangi atau menghilangkan topology loop pada traditional loop-free distribution design?
opsi_a: Batasi sebuah Layer 2 VLAN pada satu wiring closet atau satu access uplink pair
opsi_b: Perpanjang setiap VLAN ke seluruh access switch dalam distribution block
opsi_c: Jadikan link antar-distribution sebagai trunk untuk semua VLAN
opsi_d: Nonaktifkan STP pada seluruh access switch
pembahasan: Membatasi sebuah VLAN pada satu wiring closet atau satu access uplink pair mencegah VLAN tersebut membentuk banyak jalur Layer 2 yang melingkar. Trade-off-nya adalah fleksibilitas Layer 2 menjadi lebih rendah karena VLAN tidak mudah diperpanjang ke access switch lain.

pertanyaan: What is the main recommendation for reducing or eliminating topology loops in a traditional loop-free distribution design?
opsi_a: Restrict a Layer 2 VLAN to one wiring closet or one access uplink pair
opsi_b: Extend every VLAN to all access switches in the distribution block
opsi_c: Make the inter-distribution link a trunk for all VLANs
opsi_d: Disable STP on all access switches
pembahasan: Restricting a VLAN to one wiring closet or one access uplink pair prevents that VLAN from forming multiple Layer 2 paths that create a loop. The trade-off is reduced Layer 2 flexibility because the VLAN is not easily extended to other access switches.

pertanyaan: Sebuah perusahaan memilih traditional loop-free design dengan VLAN lokal pada setiap access switch. Konsekuensi desain yang paling tepat adalah?
opsi_a: Semua VLAN otomatis dapat berpindah antar-access switch tanpa perubahan
opsi_b: STP harus memblokir salah satu uplink pada setiap VLAN
opsi_c: Layer 2 failure domain lebih kecil, tetapi fleksibilitas memperpanjang VLAN ke wiring closet lain berkurang
