opsi_d: HSRP tidak dapat digunakan pada distribution layer
pembahasan: VLAN yang dibatasi pada satu access switch atau wiring closet mengurangi ukuran Layer 2 failure domain dan menghindari loop yang harus diblokir STP. Namun, kebutuhan untuk mempertahankan Layer 2 adjacency di beberapa closet menjadi lebih sulit dipenuhi.

pertanyaan: A company chooses a traditional loop-free design with VLANs kept local to each access switch. What is the most accurate design consequence?
opsi_a: All VLANs can automatically move between access switches without changes
opsi_b: STP must block one uplink for every VLAN
opsi_c: The Layer 2 failure domain is smaller, but extending a VLAN to another wiring closet becomes less flexible
opsi_d: HSRP cannot be used at the distribution layer
pembahasan: Keeping a VLAN local to one access switch or wiring closet reduces the Layer 2 failure domain and avoids loops that STP would otherwise have to block. However, requirements for Layer 2 adjacency across multiple closets become harder to satisfy.

pertanyaan:
Pada traditional distribution design, potongan output STP untuk VLAN 30 pada sebuah access switch adalah:
[output]
VLAN0030
Interface        Role Sts
Gi1/0/47         Root FWD
Gi1/0/48         Altn BLK
[/output]
Kedua uplink membawa VLAN 30 menuju dua standalone distribution switch. Apa alasan paling tepat Gi1/0/48 berada dalam status blocking?
opsi_a: HSRP menonaktifkan interface standby secara otomatis
opsi_b: Routing protocol memilih hanya satu interface Layer 2
opsi_c: STP mendeteksi redundant Layer 2 path yang dapat membentuk loop dan menempatkan satu jalur sebagai alternate blocking
opsi_d: VLAN 30 hanya dapat aktif pada satu physical interface per switch
pembahasan: Pada topology looped, VLAN yang sama memiliki redundant Layer 2 paths melalui dua standalone distribution switch. STP membentuk topology logis bebas loop dengan menempatkan salah satu jalur sebagai alternate blocking; HSRP tidak mengubah status STP interface.

pertanyaan:
In a traditional distribution design, an access switch shows this simplified STP output for VLAN 30:
[output]
VLAN0030
Interface        Role Sts
Gi1/0/47         Root FWD
Gi1/0/48         Altn BLK
[/output]
Both uplinks carry VLAN 30 toward two standalone distribution switches. Why is Gi1/0/48 most likely blocking?
opsi_a: HSRP automatically shuts down the standby interface
opsi_b: The routing protocol selects only one Layer 2 interface
opsi_c: STP detects a redundant Layer 2 path that could form a loop and places one path in alternate blocking
opsi_d: VLAN 30 can be active on only one physical interface per switch
pembahasan: In a looped topology, the same VLAN has redundant Layer 2 paths through two standalone distribution switches. STP creates a loop-free logical topology by placing one path in alternate blocking; HSRP does not control the STP interface state.

pertanyaan: Pada traditional loop-free design, DIST-01 dan DIST-02 dihubungkan oleh routed Layer 3 link. VLAN 30 hanya berada pada satu access switch yang dual-homed ke kedua distribution. Mengapa link antar-distribution tersebut tidak melengkapi loop Layer 2 VLAN 30?
opsi_a: Karena routed Layer 3 link tidak meneruskan frame VLAN 30 sebagai satu broadcast domain Layer 2
opsi_b: Karena HSRP menghapus VLAN 30 dari salah satu distribution
opsi_c: Karena STP otomatis mengubah routed link menjadi blocking
opsi_d: Karena access switch hanya dapat belajar satu MAC address pada satu waktu
pembahasan: Routed link memisahkan domain Layer 2, sehingga frame VLAN 30 tidak diteruskan sebagai trunk melalui link antar-distribution. Akibatnya, jalur melalui DIST-01 dan DIST-02 tidak membentuk closed Layer 2 loop untuk VLAN tersebut.

pertanyaan: In a traditional loop-free design, DIST-01 and DIST-02 are connected by a routed Layer 3 link. VLAN 30 exists only on one access switch that is dual-homed to both distribution switches. Why does the inter-distribution link not complete a Layer 2 loop for VLAN 30?
opsi_a: Because a routed Layer 3 link does not forward VLAN 30 frames as part of the same Layer 2 broadcast domain
opsi_b: Because HSRP removes VLAN 30 from one distribution switch
opsi_c: Because STP automatically places the routed link into blocking
opsi_d: Because an access switch can learn only one MAC address at a time
pembahasan: A routed link separates Layer 2 domains, so VLAN 30 frames are not trunked across the inter-distribution link. Therefore, the paths through DIST-01 and DIST-02 do not form a closed Layer 2 loop for that VLAN.

pertanyaan:
DIST-01 memiliki konfigurasi berikut untuk VLAN 30:
[cli]
interface Vlan30
 ip address 10.30.0.2 255.255.255.0
 standby 30 ip 10.30.0.1
[/cli]
Apa fungsi 10.30.0.1?
opsi_a: Router ID HSRP
opsi_b: Virtual IP HSRP yang digunakan host sebagai default gateway
opsi_c: Alamat multicast HSRP
opsi_d: Alamat management DIST-02
pembahasan: Perintah standby 30 ip mendefinisikan virtual IP HSRP untuk group 30. Host menggunakan 10.30.0.1 sebagai default gateway sehingga alamat gateway tetap konsisten ketika peran active berpindah ke distribution switch lain.

pertanyaan:
DIST-01 has the following configuration for VLAN 30:
[cli]
interface Vlan30
 ip address 10.30.0.2 255.255.255.0
 standby 30 ip 10.30.0.1
[/cli]
What is the purpose of 10.30.0.1?
opsi_a: The HSRP router ID
opsi_b: The HSRP virtual IP used by hosts as their default gateway
opsi_c: The HSRP multicast address
opsi_d: The management address of DIST-02
pembahasan: The standby 30 ip command defines the HSRP virtual IP for group 30. Hosts use 10.30.0.1 as their default gateway so the gateway address remains consistent when the active role moves to another distribution switch.

pertanyaan: Mengapa HSRP atau VRRP pada traditional distribution design tidak otomatis membuat satu VLAN menggunakan kedua distribution uplink secara bersamaan untuk trafik menuju default gateway?
opsi_a: Keduanya hanya bekerja pada routed access
opsi_b: Keduanya mematikan satu physical uplink
opsi_c: Keduanya hanya melindungi trafik multicast
opsi_d: Untuk satu VLAN, normalnya hanya satu active atau master gateway yang meneruskan trafik menuju virtual gateway
pembahasan: HSRP menggunakan active/standby dan VRRP menggunakan master/backup untuk sebuah virtual gateway. Karena satu gateway aktif menangani trafik normal VLAN tersebut, load sharing biasanya dilakukan per-VLAN dengan membagi peran active/master antar-VLAN, bukan otomatis per-flow dalam satu VLAN.

pertanyaan: Why do HSRP or VRRP in a traditional distribution design not automatically make a single VLAN use both distribution uplinks at the same time for traffic sent to the default gateway?
opsi_a: They work only with routed access
opsi_b: They administratively disable one physical uplink
opsi_c: They protect multicast traffic only
opsi_d: For a given VLAN, normally only one active or master gateway forwards traffic for the virtual gateway
pembahasan: HSRP uses active/standby and VRRP uses master/backup for a virtual gateway. Because one gateway handles normal traffic for that VLAN, load sharing is commonly achieved per VLAN by distributing active/master roles across VLANs rather than automatically per flow within one VLAN.

pertanyaan: Dalam traditional design yang nonlooped, sebuah organisasi ingin pemanfaatan uplink keluar dari access layer lebih baik dengan membagi host ke beberapa forwarder gateway. Protokol mana yang paling sesuai dengan pembahasan materi?
opsi_a: GLBP
opsi_b: RSTP
opsi_c: VRRP
opsi_d: HSRP
pembahasan: GLBP dapat membagi host ke beberapa active virtual forwarder sehingga uplink utilization dapat lebih tinggi dibanding model active/standby biasa. Dalam materi ini, penggunaan tersebut dikaitkan dengan nonlooped topology; STP sendiri bukan gateway redundancy protocol.

pertanyaan: In a nonlooped traditional design, an organization wants better access-layer egress uplink utilization by distributing hosts across multiple gateway forwarders. Which protocol best matches the material?
opsi_a: GLBP
opsi_b: RSTP
opsi_c: VRRP
opsi_d: HSRP
pembahasan: GLBP can distribute hosts across multiple active virtual forwarders, improving uplink utilization compared with a simple active/standby model. In this material, that use is associated with a nonlooped topology; STP itself is not a gateway redundancy protocol.

pertanyaan: Seorang engineer memperkecil timer FHRP untuk mengejar subsecond gateway convergence pada ratusan VLAN. Risiko desain apa yang paling relevan?
opsi_a: Semua VLAN otomatis berubah menjadi routed access
opsi_b: EtherChannel tidak dapat digunakan lagi
opsi_c: Control packets dan processing menjadi lebih sering sehingga penggunaan CPU dapat meningkat
opsi_d: STP akan dinonaktifkan otomatis
pembahasan: Timer yang lebih agresif dapat mempercepat deteksi kegagalan tetapi meningkatkan frekuensi hello/control processing. Pada banyak FHRP group, hal ini dapat menambah beban control plane sehingga tuning harus disesuaikan dengan kemampuan platform dan kebutuhan convergence.

pertanyaan: An engineer reduces FHRP timers to target subsecond gateway convergence across hundreds of VLANs. What is the most relevant design risk?
opsi_a: All VLANs automatically become routed access
opsi_b: EtherChannel can no longer be used
opsi_c: Control packets and processing occur more frequently, which can increase CPU utilization
opsi_d: STP is automatically disabled
pembahasan: More aggressive timers can speed up failure detection but increase the frequency of hello and control-plane processing. With many FHRP groups, this can increase control-plane load, so timer tuning must match the platform capability and convergence requirements.

pertanyaan: Apa karakteristik paling mendasar dari simplified distribution layer design?
opsi_a: Setiap distribution switch harus memiliki gateway berbeda untuk setiap VLAN
opsi_b: Beberapa distribution switch fisik bertindak sebagai satu logical switch
opsi_c: Access layer wajib menggunakan Layer 3 routed ports
opsi_d: Semua VLAN harus dibatasi ke satu access switch
pembahasan: Simplified distribution menggunakan beberapa physical switches yang tampil sebagai satu logical network entity, misalnya switch stack atau StackWise Virtual pair. Pendekatan ini menyederhanakan redundansi access-to-distribution dibanding dua standalone distribution switches.

pertanyaan: What is the most fundamental characteristic of a simplified distribution layer design?
opsi_a: Each distribution switch must have a different gateway for every VLAN
opsi_b: Multiple physical distribution switches operate as one logical switch
opsi_c: The access layer must use Layer 3 routed ports
opsi_d: Every VLAN must be restricted to one access switch
pembahasan: A simplified distribution design uses multiple physical switches that appear as one logical network entity, such as a switch stack or StackWise Virtual pair. This approach simplifies access-to-distribution resiliency compared with two standalone distribution switches.

pertanyaan: Pada simplified distribution design, mengapa seluruh uplink dari access switch menuju distribution dapat aktif dan membawa trafik?
opsi_a: Karena STP selalu dinonaktifkan
opsi_b: Karena setiap physical link diberi VLAN yang berbeda
opsi_c: Karena HSRP membagi packet per interface
opsi_d: Karena dual-homed physical links dapat digabungkan menjadi satu EtherChannel menuju satu logical distribution switch
pembahasan: Distribution pair terlihat sebagai satu logical switch sehingga link dari access dapat membentuk satu logical EtherChannel walaupun terminate pada chassis fisik berbeda yang menjadi satu sistem. STP melihat Port-Channel sebagai satu logical path, sehingga member yang valid dapat aktif dan membawa trafik.

pertanyaan: In a simplified distribution design, why can all uplinks from an access switch to the distribution layer be active and carry traffic?
opsi_a: Because STP is always disabled
opsi_b: Because each physical link uses a different VLAN
opsi_c: Because HSRP load-balances packets per interface
opsi_d: Because dual-homed physical links can be bundled into one EtherChannel toward one logical distribution switch
pembahasan: The distribution pair appears as one logical switch, allowing access links to form one logical EtherChannel even when they terminate on different physical chassis that belong to the same system. STP sees the Port-Channel as one logical path, so valid members can remain active and carry traffic.

pertanyaan:
Pada uplink simplified distribution, konfigurasi awal menggunakan forced-on EtherChannel:
[cli]
interface range TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1-2
 channel-group 10 mode on
[/cli]
Mengapa dynamic channel protocol seperti LACP umumnya lebih disukai?
opsi_a: Dynamic negotiation melakukan consistency checks dan membantu mencegah bundle terbentuk dengan konfigurasi member yang tidak konsisten
opsi_b: Dynamic negotiation otomatis mengubah trunk menjadi routed port
opsi_c: LACP menyediakan virtual default gateway seperti HSRP
opsi_d: Mode on hanya mendukung satu physical member
pembahasan: Dynamic EtherChannel protocol melakukan negotiation dan consistency checking sebelum interface menjadi anggota bundle. Mode on tidak melakukan negotiation tersebut, sehingga kesalahan konfigurasi kedua sisi lebih mudah menghasilkan kondisi forwarding yang bermasalah.

pertanyaan:
A simplified-distribution uplink initially uses a forced-on EtherChannel:
[cli]
interface range TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1-2
 channel-group 10 mode on
[/cli]
Why is a dynamic channel protocol such as LACP generally preferred?
opsi_a: Dynamic negotiation performs consistency checks and helps prevent a bundle from forming with inconsistent member configurations
opsi_b: Dynamic negotiation automatically converts a trunk into a routed port
opsi_c: LACP provides a virtual default gateway like HSRP
opsi_d: Mode on supports only one physical member
pembahasan: A dynamic EtherChannel protocol performs negotiation and consistency checking before an interface becomes a bundle member. Mode on does not perform that negotiation, so mismatched configurations across the two sides are more likely to create forwarding problems.

pertanyaan: Mengapa simplified distribution design umumnya tidak membutuhkan HSRP, VRRP, atau GLBP antara dua chassis distribution yang menjadi satu logical system?
opsi_a: Host pada access layer tidak membutuhkan default gateway
opsi_b: Default gateway berada pada satu logical Layer 3 interface dan resiliency disediakan oleh logical distribution system
opsi_c: STP menggantikan fungsi virtual IP gateway
opsi_d: Semua VLAN berubah menjadi Layer 3 point-to-point
pembahasan: Walaupun terdapat beberapa chassis fisik, jaringan melihat distribution sebagai satu logical device. SVI default gateway adalah satu logical interface, sehingga tidak perlu FHRP untuk memilih gateway di antara dua standalone boxes.

pertanyaan: Why does a simplified distribution design generally not require HSRP, VRRP, or GLBP between two distribution chassis that form one logical system?
opsi_a: Hosts in the access layer do not need a default gateway
opsi_b: The default gateway exists on one logical Layer 3 interface and resiliency is provided by the logical distribution system
opsi_c: STP replaces the virtual IP gateway function
opsi_d: All VLANs become Layer 3 point-to-point networks
pembahasan: Although multiple physical chassis exist, the network sees the distribution layer as one logical device. The SVI default gateway is one logical interface, so an FHRP is not needed to select a gateway between two standalone boxes.

pertanyaan:
Sebuah access switch menggunakan Port-Channel10 yang terdiri dari Te1/1/1 dan Te1/1/2 ke simplified distribution pair. Output disederhanakan sebelum kegagalan:
[output]
Group  Port-channel  Protocol  Ports
10     Po10(SU)      LACP      Te1/1/1(P) Te1/1/2(P)
[/output]
Jika Te1/1/1 gagal tetapi Te1/1/2 tetap valid dan tidak ada minimum-links requirement yang dilanggar, apa hasil yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Po10 harus down karena satu member hilang
opsi_b: STP harus menunggu link blocking menjadi forwarding
opsi_c: HSRP harus melakukan state transition sebelum Po10 bekerja
opsi_d: Po10 tetap up dan trafik menggunakan member yang masih aktif
pembahasan: EtherChannel menyediakan resiliency pada level bundle; kehilangan satu member tidak harus menjatuhkan Port-Channel selama member lain masih memenuhi syarat. Karena link yang tersisa sudah bagian dari logical bundle, failover tidak bergantung pada STP untuk membuka jalur yang sebelumnya blocking.

pertanyaan:
An access switch uses Port-Channel10 with Te1/1/1 and Te1/1/2 toward a simplified distribution pair. Before a failure, the simplified output is:
[output]
Group  Port-channel  Protocol  Ports
10     Po10(SU)      LACP      Te1/1/1(P) Te1/1/2(P)
[/output]
If Te1/1/1 fails but Te1/1/2 remains valid and no minimum-links requirement is violated, what is the most accurate result?
opsi_a: Po10 must go down because one member is lost
opsi_b: STP must wait for a blocking link to become forwarding
opsi_c: HSRP must transition states before Po10 can work
opsi_d: Po10 remains up and traffic uses the surviving member
pembahasan: EtherChannel provides resiliency at the bundle level; losing one member does not have to bring down the Port-Channel as long as another valid member remains. Because the surviving link is already part of the logical bundle, failover does not depend on STP unblocking a previously blocked path.

pertanyaan: VLAN 30 harus tersedia pada dua access switch berbeda. Distribution menggunakan dua chassis yang bekerja sebagai satu logical switch, dan masing-masing access switch dual-homed melalui EtherChannel. Mengapa VLAN 30 dapat span kedua access switch tanpa membuat salah satu uplink normalnya diblokir STP?
opsi_a: Karena VLAN 30 diubah menjadi dua VLAN terpisah
opsi_b: Karena access switch tidak menjalankan STP sama sekali
opsi_c: Karena dari perspektif Layer 2, setiap access switch memiliki satu logical path menuju satu logical distribution bridge
opsi_d: Karena HSRP menghapus redundant Layer 2 path
pembahasan: Logical distribution pair tampil sebagai satu bridge, sedangkan setiap access switch terhubung melalui satu logical Port-Channel. Dengan topology logis hub-and-spoke ini, VLAN dapat span beberapa access switch tanpa redundant independent distribution paths yang memaksa STP memblokir uplink normal.

pertanyaan: VLAN 30 must be available on two different access switches. The distribution layer uses two chassis operating as one logical switch, and each access switch is dual-homed through EtherChannel. Why can VLAN 30 span both access switches without normally causing one uplink to be blocked by STP?
opsi_a: Because VLAN 30 is converted into two separate VLANs
opsi_b: Because the access switches do not run STP at all
opsi_c: Because from the Layer 2 perspective, each access switch has one logical path to one logical distribution bridge
opsi_d: Because HSRP removes the redundant Layer 2 path
pembahasan: The logical distribution pair appears as one bridge, while each access switch connects through one logical Port-Channel. With this logical hub-and-spoke topology, a VLAN can span multiple access switches without independent redundant distribution paths that force STP to block a normal uplink.

pertanyaan: Apa manfaat tambahan topology logis hub-and-spoke pada simplified distribution design selain mengurangi STP-blocked links?
opsi_a: Membuat setiap access switch menjadi multicast RP
opsi_b: Menyederhanakan design/troubleshooting dan memungkinkan satu logical designated router melayani multicast menuju VLAN access
opsi_c: Menghilangkan kebutuhan routing di seluruh campus
opsi_d: Membuat semua flow EtherChannel selalu menggunakan seluruh member secara bersamaan
pembahasan: Single logical distribution membuat topology access-to-distribution lebih sederhana untuk dipahami dan di-troubleshoot. Untuk multicast, terdapat satu logical Layer 3 designated router menuju VLAN access, sehingga operasi multicast di distribution juga lebih sederhana.

pertanyaan: What is an additional benefit of the logical hub-and-spoke topology in a simplified distribution design besides reducing STP-blocked links?
opsi_a: It makes every access switch a multicast RP
opsi_b: It simplifies design and troubleshooting and allows one logical designated router to serve multicast toward an access VLAN
opsi_c: It removes the need for routing throughout the campus
opsi_d: It makes every EtherChannel flow use all member links simultaneously
pembahasan: A single logical distribution system makes the access-to-distribution topology easier to understand and troubleshoot. For multicast, there is one logical Layer 3 designated router toward the access VLAN, which also simplifies multicast operation at the distribution layer.

pertanyaan: Dalam SD-Access, pasangan definisi underlay dan overlay yang paling tepat adalah?
opsi_a: Underlay adalah physical Layer 3 transport antar-fabric node, sedangkan overlay adalah virtual network yang berjalan di atas transport tersebut
opsi_b: Underlay adalah kumpulan user VLAN, sedangkan overlay hanya jaringan management
opsi_c: Underlay adalah TrustSec policy, sedangkan overlay adalah STP domain
opsi_d: Underlay hanya untuk wireless, sedangkan overlay hanya untuk wired
pembahasan: Underlay menyediakan IP reachability dan jalur transport antarperangkat fabric menggunakan fondasi Layer 3. Overlay membangun konektivitas virtual dan segmentasi di atas underlay sehingga logical topology tidak harus sama dengan physical topology.

pertanyaan: In SD-Access, which definition of underlay and overlay is most accurate?
opsi_a: The underlay is the physical Layer 3 transport between fabric nodes, while the overlay is the virtual network running on top of that transport
opsi_b: The underlay is the set of user VLANs, while the overlay is only the management network
opsi_c: The underlay is the TrustSec policy, while the overlay is the STP domain
opsi_d: The underlay is only for wireless, while the overlay is only for wired
pembahasan: The underlay provides IP reachability and transport paths between fabric devices using a Layer 3 foundation. The overlay builds virtual connectivity and segmentation on top of the underlay, so the logical topology does not have to match the physical topology.

pertanyaan: Apa ide utama SD-Access ketika diterapkan pada campus yang sudah menggunakan Layer 3 routed access?
opsi_a: Mengganti seluruh routed links menjadi Layer 2 trunks
opsi_b: Memperluas STP sampai core
opsi_c: Menghapus physical network dan hanya menggunakan virtual links
opsi_d: Menambahkan fabric overlay di atas Layer 3 underlay untuk memberi fleksibilitas logical connectivity dan segmentation
pembahasan: SD-Access mempertahankan fondasi routed Layer 3 sebagai underlay lalu menambahkan fabric overlay di atasnya. Pendekatan ini mempertahankan keuntungan routed access sekaligus mengatasi keterbatasan ketika logical connectivity atau segmentasi perlu menjangkau lokasi fisik yang berbeda.

pertanyaan: What is the main idea of SD-Access when applied to a campus that already uses Layer 3 routed access?
opsi_a: Replace all routed links with Layer 2 trunks
opsi_b: Extend STP all the way to the core
opsi_c: Remove the physical network and use only virtual links
opsi_d: Add a fabric overlay on top of the Layer 3 underlay to provide flexible logical connectivity and segmentation
pembahasan: SD-Access keeps the routed Layer 3 foundation as the underlay and adds a fabric overlay on top. This preserves the advantages of routed access while addressing limitations when logical connectivity or segmentation must span different physical locations.

pertanyaan: Satu physical SD-Access fabric harus membawa jaringan EMPLOYEE, GUEST, dan IOT yang terisolasi satu sama lain. Konsep mana yang memungkinkan hal tersebut?
opsi_a: Membuat tiga physical core terpisah
opsi_b: Menggunakan satu STP instance untuk seluruh endpoint
opsi_c: Menjalankan beberapa Virtual Networks pada underlay yang sama
opsi_d: Menggunakan satu HSRP group untuk semua endpoint
pembahasan: SD-Access memungkinkan beberapa Virtual Networks berjalan di atas physical underlay yang sama. Setiap VN dapat mempertahankan logical isolation tanpa memerlukan physical network terpisah untuk setiap kelompok.

pertanyaan: One physical SD-Access fabric must carry EMPLOYEE, GUEST, and IOT networks that remain isolated from one another. Which concept enables this?
opsi_a: Building three separate physical cores
opsi_b: Using one STP instance for all endpoints
opsi_c: Running multiple Virtual Networks over the same underlay
opsi_d: Using one HSRP group for all endpoints
pembahasan: SD-Access allows multiple Virtual Networks to operate over the same physical underlay. Each VN can maintain logical isolation without requiring a separate physical network for every group.

pertanyaan: Sebuah organisasi ingin policy yang mengizinkan kelompok Finance mengakses Finance Server tetapi menolak Guest, tanpa menjadikan IP address sebagai satu-satunya dasar policy. Mekanisme SD-Access mana yang paling sesuai?
opsi_a: Cisco TrustSec dengan Scalable Group Tag dan group-based policy
opsi_b: STP port cost
opsi_c: HSRP virtual MAC
opsi_d: EtherChannel hashing
pembahasan: Cisco TrustSec menggunakan SGT untuk merepresentasikan identitas atau group membership dan memungkinkan policy diterapkan berdasarkan hubungan antarkelompok. Ini berbeda dari ACL tradisional yang terutama bergantung pada alamat dan subnet.

pertanyaan: An organization wants a policy that permits the Finance group to access Finance Server while denying Guest, without using IP addresses as the only policy basis. Which SD-Access mechanism is most appropriate?
opsi_a: Cisco TrustSec with Scalable Group Tags and group-based policy
opsi_b: STP port cost
opsi_c: HSRP virtual MAC
opsi_d: EtherChannel hashing
pembahasan: Cisco TrustSec uses SGTs to represent identity or group membership and allows policy to be applied based on relationships between groups. This differs from traditional ACL approaches that primarily depend on addresses and subnets.

pertanyaan: Mengapa routed access biasa dapat menjadi kurang fleksibel untuk aplikasi yang membutuhkan Layer 2 adjacency di beberapa wiring closet?
opsi_a: Routed access tidak mendukung VLAN pada access ports
opsi_b: Layer 2 domains biasanya dibatasi pada satu access closet, sedangkan memperluas logical connectivity ke closet lain membutuhkan desain lain seperti fabric overlay
opsi_c: Routed access selalu memblokir kedua uplink dengan STP
opsi_d: Routed access mengharuskan HSRP pada setiap endpoint
pembahasan: Routed access mengecilkan Layer 2 domain dan menghilangkan banyak ketergantungan pada STP, tetapi konsekuensinya Layer 2 adjacency biasanya bersifat lokal. Fabric overlay dapat menyediakan logical connectivity yang lebih fleksibel tanpa memperpanjang physical Layer 2 topology secara tradisional.

pertanyaan: Why can conventional routed access be less flexible for applications that require Layer 2 adjacency across multiple wiring closets?
opsi_a: Routed access does not support VLANs on access ports
opsi_b: Layer 2 domains are typically confined to one access closet, while extending logical connectivity to another closet requires another design such as a fabric overlay
opsi_c: Routed access always blocks both uplinks with STP
opsi_d: Routed access requires HSRP on every endpoint
pembahasan: Routed access reduces the Layer 2 domain and removes much of the dependence on STP, but the trade-off is that Layer 2 adjacency is typically local. A fabric overlay can provide more flexible logical connectivity without traditionally extending the physical Layer 2 topology.

pertanyaan: Sebuah campus membutuhkan Layer 3 underlay yang stabil, network virtualization untuk beberapa tenant internal, serta policy berdasarkan identity/group membership yang tetap konsisten saat user berpindah lokasi. Model mana yang paling sesuai?
opsi_a: Traditional looped distribution
opsi_b: Traditional loop-free distribution
opsi_c: Software-Defined Access
opsi_d: Simplified distribution tanpa fabric
pembahasan: Kebutuhan network virtualization dan identity/group-based policy paling langsung dipenuhi oleh SD-Access melalui fabric overlay dan integrasi TrustSec. Traditional maupun simplified distribution dapat menyediakan resiliency Layer 2, tetapi tidak secara inheren menyediakan fabric virtualization dan policy berbasis SGT.

pertanyaan: A campus requires a stable Layer 3 underlay, network virtualization for several internal tenants, and policy based on identity or group membership that remains consistent as users move locations. Which model is the best fit?
opsi_a: Traditional looped distribution
opsi_b: Traditional loop-free distribution
opsi_c: Software-Defined Access
opsi_d: Simplified distribution without a fabric
pembahasan: The requirements for network virtualization and identity/group-based policy are most directly addressed by SD-Access through its fabric overlay and TrustSec integration. Traditional and simplified distribution can provide Layer 2 resiliency, but they do not inherently provide fabric virtualization and SGT-based policy.

pertanyaan: Sebuah distribution block memiliki banyak user subnets dan core tidak perlu mengetahui setiap subnet secara terpisah. Perubahan desain apa yang paling membantu mengurangi routing table dan routing protocol overhead di core?
opsi_a: Perpanjang semua VLAN ke core
opsi_b: Jadikan semua access uplink sebagai Layer 2 trunk ke core
opsi_c: Nonaktifkan dynamic routing di distribution
opsi_d: Gunakan hierarchical IP addressing dan lakukan route summarization pada boundary distribution-to-core
pembahasan: Distribution layer merupakan titik logis yang baik untuk merangkum routing information sebelum masuk ke core. Summarization mengurangi jumlah route yang harus diproses core dan dapat membatasi dampak perubahan route detail di dalam distribution block.

pertanyaan: A distribution block contains many user subnets, and the core does not need to know each subnet individually. Which design change best reduces the routing table and routing protocol overhead in the core?
opsi_a: Extend all VLANs to the core
opsi_b: Make every access uplink a Layer 2 trunk to the core
opsi_c: Disable dynamic routing at the distribution layer
opsi_d: Use hierarchical IP addressing and perform route summarization at the distribution-to-core boundary
pembahasan: The distribution layer is a logical place to summarize routing information before it enters the core. Summarization reduces the number of routes the core must process and can limit the effect of detailed route changes inside the distribution block.

pertanyaan: Pada StackWise Virtual pair yang digunakan sebagai simplified distribution, bagaimana hubungan control plane dan data plane yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Pair tampil sebagai satu logical switch; satu switch berperan active untuk control plane dan peer standby, sementara kedua chassis dapat aktif melakukan data forwarding
opsi_b: Kedua chassis selalu memiliki control plane independen seperti traditional standalone distribution
opsi_c: Hanya active chassis yang boleh meneruskan data dan standby tidak pernah forwarding
opsi_d: StackWise Virtual hanya menggabungkan management IP tanpa memengaruhi STP
pembahasan: StackWise Virtual membuat dua chassis tampil sebagai satu logical network entity bagi perangkat tetangga dan STP. Control plane memiliki active/standby role, tetapi dari sisi data plane kedua chassis dapat meneruskan trafik, sehingga resiliency tidak sama dengan dua standalone distribution switches.

pertanyaan: In a StackWise Virtual pair used for simplified distribution, which statement best describes the control-plane and data-plane relationship?
opsi_a: The pair appears as one logical switch; one switch is active for the control plane and the peer is standby, while both chassis can actively forward data
opsi_b: Both chassis always have independent control planes like traditional standalone distribution
opsi_c: Only the active chassis can forward data and the standby never forwards
opsi_d: StackWise Virtual only combines the management IP and has no effect on STP
pembahasan: StackWise Virtual makes two chassis appear as one logical network entity to neighboring devices and to STP. The control plane uses active/standby roles, but both chassis can forward traffic in the data plane, so its resiliency model differs from two standalone distribution switches.

pertanyaan: Dalam desain StackWise Virtual, apa fungsi StackWise Virtual Link (SVL) dan praktik resiliency yang tepat?
opsi_a: SVL hanya membawa user VLAN dan tidak membawa control traffic
opsi_b: SVL adalah FHRP link sehingga harus menggunakan HSRP
opsi_c: SVL membawa signaling/control dan dapat membawa data antar-peer; menggunakan lebih dari satu physical member meningkatkan resiliency
opsi_d: SVL menggantikan semua access uplinks sehingga access switch tidak lagi memerlukan koneksi ke distribution
pembahasan: SVL mengikat dua peer StackWise Virtual menjadi satu logical system dan membawa informasi control serta trafik yang perlu melintasi peer. Menggunakan beberapa physical members pada SVL meningkatkan link-level resiliency jika salah satu member gagal.

pertanyaan: In a StackWise Virtual design, what is the purpose of the StackWise Virtual Link (SVL), and what is the appropriate resiliency practice?
opsi_a: The SVL carries only user VLANs and no control traffic
opsi_b: The SVL is an FHRP link and therefore must use HSRP
opsi_c: The SVL carries signaling/control information and can carry data between peers; using more than one physical member improves resiliency
opsi_d: The SVL replaces all access uplinks, so access switches no longer need distribution connections
pembahasan: The SVL binds the two StackWise Virtual peers into one logical system and carries control information as well as traffic that must cross between peers. Using multiple physical members in the SVL improves link-level resiliency if one member fails.

pertanyaan: Sebuah access switch memiliki EtherChannel berisi empat link 10 Gbps menuju simplified distribution. Seorang engineer menyatakan satu TCP flow besar pasti dapat menggunakan 40 Gbps penuh. Evaluasi yang paling tepat adalah?
opsi_a: Benar, setiap packet dari satu flow selalu dibagi round-robin ke semua member
opsi_b: Tidak tepat; EtherChannel umumnya menggunakan hashing sehingga satu flow biasanya dipetakan ke satu member, sedangkan banyak flow dapat tersebar ke beberapa member
opsi_c: Benar hanya jika STP dimatikan
opsi_d: Tidak tepat karena EtherChannel hanya menyediakan redundancy dan tidak pernah melakukan load sharing
pembahasan: EtherChannel menyediakan aggregate capacity dan load sharing dengan mendistribusikan flow berdasarkan hash. Satu flow biasanya tetap pada satu member untuk menjaga packet ordering, sehingga aggregate 40 Gbps lebih mencerminkan kapasitas banyak flow daripada bandwidth yang dijamin untuk satu flow.

pertanyaan: An access switch has an EtherChannel containing four 10-Gbps links toward a simplified distribution layer. An engineer claims that one large TCP flow will definitely use the full 40 Gbps. What is the best evaluation?
opsi_a: Correct, packets from one flow are always sent round-robin across all members
opsi_b: Not correct; EtherChannel generally uses hashing, so one flow is typically mapped to one member while multiple flows can be spread across multiple members
opsi_c: Correct only if STP is disabled
opsi_d: Not correct because EtherChannel provides redundancy only and never performs load sharing
pembahasan: EtherChannel provides aggregate capacity and load sharing by distributing flows according to a hash. A single flow typically stays on one member to preserve packet ordering, so 40 Gbps is better understood as aggregate capacity for many flows rather than guaranteed bandwidth for one flow.

pertanyaan:
Dua switch Cisco seharusnya membentuk LACP EtherChannel. Konfigurasi relevan adalah:
[cli]
SW1:
interface range Gi1/0/47-48
 channel-group 10 mode passive

SW2:
interface range Gi1/0/47-48
 channel-group 10 mode passive
[/cli]
Tidak ada Port-Channel yang terbentuk. Perubahan minimum yang paling tepat adalah?
opsi_a: Ubah kedua sisi menjadi mode on dan nonaktifkan STP
opsi_b: Tambahkan HSRP pada Port-Channel
opsi_c: Ubah kedua sisi menjadi PAgP desirable tanpa memeriksa dukungan
opsi_d: Ubah setidaknya satu sisi menjadi LACP active sehingga negotiation dapat dimulai
pembahasan: LACP passive menunggu LACP negotiation dari peer dan tidak memulainya. Jika kedua sisi passive, channel tidak terbentuk; mengubah setidaknya satu sisi menjadi active menyediakan initiator tanpa perlu meninggalkan dynamic negotiation.

pertanyaan:
Two Cisco switches are supposed to form an LACP EtherChannel. The relevant configuration is:
[cli]
SW1:
interface range Gi1/0/47-48
 channel-group 10 mode passive

SW2:
interface range Gi1/0/47-48
 channel-group 10 mode passive
[/cli]
No Port-Channel forms. What is the minimum appropriate change?
opsi_a: Change both sides to mode on and disable STP
opsi_b: Add HSRP to the Port-Channel
opsi_c: Change both sides to PAgP desirable without checking support
opsi_d: Change at least one side to LACP active so negotiation can begin
pembahasan: LACP passive waits for LACP negotiation from its peer and does not initiate it. If both sides are passive, the channel does not form; changing at least one side to active provides an initiator while keeping dynamic negotiation.

pertanyaan: Dalam SD-Access, dua Virtual Networks harus memiliki routing table terpisah walaupun menggunakan physical underlay yang sama. Implementasi logis yang paling sesuai adalah?
opsi_a: Provision setiap VN sebagai VRF instance yang terpisah
opsi_b: Gunakan satu global routing table lalu bedakan hanya dengan STP instance
opsi_c: Gunakan satu HSRP group untuk seluruh VN
opsi_d: Gunakan EtherChannel berbeda untuk setiap user group sebagai satu-satunya isolation mechanism
pembahasan: Pada SD-Access, user-defined overlay VNs dapat diprovisikan sebagai VRF instances sehingga masing-masing memiliki routing table terpisah. Physical underlay tetap dapat dipakai bersama karena isolation berada pada layer virtualisasi, bukan harus melalui physical separation.

pertanyaan: In SD-Access, two Virtual Networks must have separate routing tables even though they use the same physical underlay. What is the most appropriate logical implementation?
opsi_a: Provision each VN as a separate VRF instance
opsi_b: Use one global routing table and differentiate only with STP instances
opsi_c: Use one HSRP group for all VNs
opsi_d: Use a different EtherChannel for each user group as the only isolation mechanism
pembahasan: In SD-Access, user-defined overlay VNs can be provisioned as VRF instances so that each has a separate routing table. The physical underlay can still be shared because the isolation is provided by virtualization rather than requiring physical separation.

pertanyaan: Sebuah kampus masih membutuhkan Layer 2 adjacency untuk aplikasi lama di beberapa access closets. Tim ingin seluruh dual-homed uplink aktif, mengurangi STP-blocked links, dan menghilangkan kebutuhan HSRP/VRRP antar dua distribution chassis. Mereka belum membutuhkan identity-based policy atau fabric automation. Desain mana yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Traditional looped distribution dengan standalone switches
opsi_b: Simplified distribution dengan distribution pair sebagai satu logical switch dan EtherChannel ke access
opsi_c: Software-Defined Access wajib karena setiap kebutuhan Layer 2 harus menggunakan VXLAN
opsi_d: Traditional loop-free dengan memaksa VLAN hanya pada satu closet
pembahasan: Simplified distribution secara langsung memenuhi kebutuhan Layer 2 spanning access closets sambil menjaga dual-homed uplinks aktif melalui EtherChannel dan menghilangkan kebutuhan FHRP antar standalone distribution. SD-Access bisa memberikan kemampuan lebih luas, tetapi pada skenario ini fabric dan identity-based policy tidak menjadi requirement.

pertanyaan: A campus still requires Layer 2 adjacency for a legacy application across several access closets. The team wants all dual-homed uplinks active, fewer STP-blocked links, and no HSRP/VRRP requirement between two distribution chassis. Identity-based policy and fabric automation are not currently required. Which design is the best fit?
opsi_a: Traditional looped distribution with standalone switches
opsi_b: Simplified distribution with the distribution pair acting as one logical switch and EtherChannel to the access layer
opsi_c: Software-Defined Access is mandatory because every Layer 2 requirement must use VXLAN
opsi_d: Traditional loop-free design that forces the VLAN to remain in one closet
pembahasan: Simplified distribution directly meets the requirement for Layer 2 connectivity across access closets while keeping dual-homed uplinks active through EtherChannel and removing the need for FHRP between standalone distribution switches. SD-Access can provide broader capabilities, but fabric and identity-based policy are not requirements in this scenario.

pertanyaan: Manakah fungsi yang paling sesuai disimpan atau diproses menggunakan TCAM pada switch?
opsi_a: Dynamic ARP aging saja
opsi_b: Ethernet FCS saja
opsi_c: ACL dan klasifikasi QoS
opsi_d: Duplex negotiation saja
pembahasan: TCAM cocok untuk rule yang membutuhkan pencocokan beberapa field atau wildcard, seperti ACL dan QoS classification. MAC-to-port forwarding utama menggunakan CAM, sedangkan FCS dan duplex bukan fungsi tabel TCAM.

pertanyaan: Which function is most appropriately stored or processed using TCAM on a switch?
opsi_a: Dynamic ARP aging only
opsi_b: Ethernet FCS only
opsi_c: ACLs and QoS classification
opsi_d: Duplex negotiation only
pembahasan: TCAM is suited to rules requiring multi-field or wildcard matching, such as ACLs and QoS classification. Primary MAC-to-port forwarding uses CAM, while FCS and duplex are not TCAM table functions.

pertanyaan: Pada TCAM, apa arti nilai X dalam konsep ternary matching?
opsi_a: Bit tersebut tidak perlu cocok atau don't care
opsi_b: Traffic harus selalu di-deny
opsi_c: Bit tersebut harus bernilai 1
opsi_d: Lookup harus diteruskan ke CPU
pembahasan: TCAM menggunakan tiga kondisi logis: 0, 1, dan X. X berarti don't care, sehingga bit tersebut dapat diabaikan ketika rule dicocokkan.

pertanyaan: In TCAM ternary matching, what does the value X represent?
opsi_a: The bit does not need to match, or don't care
opsi_b: The traffic must always be denied
opsi_c: The bit must equal 1
opsi_d: The lookup must be sent to the CPU
pembahasan: TCAM uses three logical states: 0, 1, and X. X represents don't care, allowing that bit to be ignored when a rule is matched.

pertanyaan:
Sebuah multilayer switch memiliki konfigurasi berikut:
[cli]
interface Gi1/0/1
 ip access-group USER-IN in

interface Gi1/0/24
 ip access-group SERVER-OUT out
[/cli]
Paket masuk melalui Gi1/0/1 dan setelah routing akan keluar melalui Gi1/0/24. Dalam kondisi apa paket tersebut dapat diperiksa oleh dua ACL?
opsi_a: Hanya jika kedua ACL memiliki nama yang sama
opsi_b: Hanya jika destination MAC belum diketahui
opsi_c: Hanya jika kedua interface berada pada VLAN yang sama
opsi_d: Jika paket match jalur tersebut, USER-IN diperiksa saat ingress dan SERVER-OUT diperiksa pada egress
pembahasan: ACL tidak otomatis selalu diperiksa dua kali, tetapi paket dapat melewati inbound ACL dan outbound ACL jika keduanya memang terpasang pada jalurnya. Paket yang di-deny pada tahap ingress tidak akan mencapai pemeriksaan egress berikutnya.

pertanyaan:
A multilayer switch has the following configuration:
[cli]
interface Gi1/0/1
 ip access-group USER-IN in

interface Gi1/0/24
 ip access-group SERVER-OUT out
[/cli]
A packet enters Gi1/0/1 and, after routing, would exit Gi1/0/24. Under what condition can that packet be checked by two ACLs?
opsi_a: Only if both ACLs have the same name
opsi_b: Only if the destination MAC is unknown
opsi_c: Only if both interfaces belong to the same VLAN
opsi_d: If the packet follows that path, USER-IN is checked on ingress and SERVER-OUT is checked on egress
pembahasan: An ACL is not automatically checked twice, but a packet can traverse both an inbound and an outbound ACL when both are configured along its path. A packet denied at ingress will not proceed to the later egress check.

pertanyaan: Sebuah switch mengklasifikasikan traffic voice sebagai priority traffic menggunakan QoS. Ketika frame tersebut sudah lolos security ACL dan port keluarnya telah diketahui, apa peran QoS yang paling relevan berikutnya?
opsi_a: Mengubah destination MAC menjadi broadcast
opsi_b: Menentukan queue atau perlakuan forwarding yang sesuai bagi traffic tersebut
opsi_c: Memindahkan traffic ke VLAN lain tanpa routing
opsi_d: Menghapus entri CAM destination
pembahasan: QoS menjawab bagaimana traffic harus diteruskan, misalnya dengan memilih egress queue, memberi prioritas, atau menerapkan policing sesuai platform. QoS tidak mengubah batas VLAN maupun fungsi dasar CAM destination lookup.

pertanyaan: A switch classifies voice traffic as priority traffic using QoS. After the frame has passed the security ACL and its egress port is known, what is the most relevant next role of QoS?
opsi_a: Change the destination MAC into a broadcast address
opsi_b: Select the appropriate queue or forwarding treatment for that traffic
opsi_c: Move the traffic to another VLAN without routing
opsi_d: Delete the destination CAM entry
pembahasan: QoS determines how traffic should be forwarded, such as selecting an egress queue, assigning priority, or applying policing depending on the platform. QoS does not replace VLAN boundaries or the basic destination CAM lookup.

pertanyaan: Mengapa CAM dan TCAM dapat membantu switch melakukan forwarding pada kecepatan tinggi?
opsi_a: Karena semua frame harus terlebih dahulu diproses CPU
opsi_b: Karena switch menunda semua forwarding sampai queue penuh
opsi_c: Karena lookup penting dapat dilakukan oleh ASIC di hardware
opsi_d: Karena CAM hanya menyimpan satu MAC address pada satu waktu
pembahasan: Switch menggunakan ASIC dan hardware forwarding memory untuk melakukan lookup secara sangat cepat tanpa melibatkan CPU untuk setiap frame biasa. Inilah salah satu dasar kemampuan wire-speed forwarding pada switch modern.

pertanyaan: Why do CAM and TCAM help a switch perform forwarding at high speed?
opsi_a: Because every frame must first be processed by the CPU
opsi_b: Because the switch delays forwarding until a queue is full
opsi_c: Because important lookups can be performed by ASIC hardware
opsi_d: Because CAM stores only one MAC address at a time
pembahasan: Switches use ASICs and hardware forwarding memory to perform lookups very quickly without involving the CPU for every normal frame. This is one of the foundations of wire-speed forwarding in modern switches.

pertanyaan: Sebuah frame unicast VLAN 50 masuk melalui Gi1/0/1. Destination MAC tidak memiliki exact match pada CAM table VLAN 50. Apa tindakan Layer 2 default yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Flood frame ke port lain yang berpartisipasi dalam VLAN 50, kecuali ingress port
opsi_b: Route frame ke VLAN yang memiliki MAC tersebut
opsi_c: Buang frame karena CAM lookup gagal
opsi_d: Kirim hanya ke root bridge STP
pembahasan: Kegagalan menemukan destination MAC pada VLAN yang sesuai menghasilkan unknown unicast. Switch melakukan flooding dalam VLAN tersebut agar tujuan masih memiliki kemungkinan menerima frame.

pertanyaan: A VLAN 50 unicast frame enters Gi1/0/1. The destination MAC has no exact match in the VLAN 50 CAM table. What is the most appropriate default Layer 2 action?
opsi_a: Flood the frame to other ports participating in VLAN 50 except the ingress port
opsi_b: Route the frame into the VLAN containing that MAC
opsi_c: Drop the frame because the CAM lookup failed
opsi_d: Send the frame only toward the STP root bridge
pembahasan: Failure to find the destination MAC in the relevant VLAN creates an unknown unicast condition. The switch floods the frame within that VLAN so the destination still has an opportunity to receive it.

pertanyaan: Sebuah broadcast VLAN 10 harus melewati trunk menuju switch lain. Kapan trunk tersebut dapat membawa broadcast itu?
opsi_a: Hanya jika trunk berada di native VLAN 10
opsi_b: Jika VLAN 10 diizinkan dan aktif pada trunk tersebut
opsi_c: Hanya jika CAM table memiliki ffff.ffff.ffff
opsi_d: Broadcast tidak pernah melewati trunk
pembahasan: Broadcast tetap dapat melewati trunk selama trunk membawa VLAN yang sama. Frame tetap berada dalam broadcast domain VLAN 10 dan tidak berubah menjadi broadcast untuk VLAN lain.

pertanyaan: A VLAN 10 broadcast needs to cross a trunk to another switch. When can the trunk carry that broadcast?
opsi_a: Only if VLAN 10 is the native VLAN
opsi_b: If VLAN 10 is allowed and active on that trunk
opsi_c: Only if the CAM table contains ffff.ffff.ffff
opsi_d: A broadcast can never cross a trunk
pembahasan: A broadcast can cross a trunk as long as the trunk carries the same VLAN. The frame remains within the VLAN 10 broadcast domain and does not become a broadcast for other VLANs.

pertanyaan:
Perhatikan potongan ilustrasi berikut:
[output]
GigabitEthernet1/0/10 is up, line protocol is up
  12 input errors, 12 CRC, 0 runts, 0 giants
[/output]
Pernyataan mana yang paling tepat berdasarkan pembahasan Layer 2 switch?
opsi_a: CRC error menunjukkan destination MAC tidak ada di CAM
opsi_b: CRC error berarti frame harus di-flood
opsi_c: CRC error menunjukkan VLAN tujuan berbeda
opsi_d: Frame dengan kesalahan FCS/CRC tidak dianggap frame yang baik dan dapat dibuang oleh switch
pembahasan: CRC merupakan indikasi bahwa integritas frame bermasalah. Switch normalnya tidak meneruskan frame Ethernet yang gagal pemeriksaan FCS sebagai frame valid.

pertanyaan:
Consider the following simplified output:
[output]
GigabitEthernet1/0/10 is up, line protocol is up
  12 input errors, 12 CRC, 0 runts, 0 giants
[/output]
Which statement is most accurate based on Layer 2 switch operation?
opsi_a: A CRC error means the destination MAC is absent from CAM
opsi_b: A CRC error means the frame must be flooded
opsi_c: A CRC error indicates that the destination VLAN is different
opsi_d: A frame with an FCS/CRC error is not considered a good frame and can be discarded by the switch
pembahasan: CRC errors indicate a problem with frame integrity. A normal switch does not forward an Ethernet frame that fails FCS validation as a valid frame.

pertanyaan: Pengembangan: Sebuah switch memiliki IGMP snooping aktif dan telah mempelajari port anggota multicast group tertentu. Bagaimana forwarding multicast biasanya berbeda dibanding flooding multicast sederhana?
opsi_a: Switch selalu mengubah multicast menjadi unicast
opsi_b: Switch dapat membatasi forwarding multicast ke port yang relevan dengan group tersebut
opsi_c: Switch harus meneruskan multicast ke semua VLAN
opsi_d: IGMP snooping menonaktifkan CAM table
pembahasan: Tanpa informasi membership yang relevan, multicast Layer 2 dapat diperlakukan seperti flooding dalam VLAN. Dengan IGMP snooping, switch dapat memanfaatkan informasi keanggotaan untuk membatasi traffic multicast ke port yang memang membutuhkan group tersebut.

pertanyaan: Development: A switch has IGMP snooping enabled and has learned the member ports for a particular multicast group. How does multicast forwarding typically differ from simple multicast flooding?
opsi_a: The switch always converts multicast into unicast
opsi_b: The switch can limit multicast forwarding to ports relevant to that group
opsi_c: The switch must forward multicast into every VLAN
opsi_d: IGMP snooping disables the CAM table
pembahasan: Without relevant membership information, Layer 2 multicast may be treated as flooded traffic within the VLAN. With IGMP snooping, the switch can use membership information to restrict multicast traffic to ports that require that group.

pertanyaan: Pengembangan: Sebuah dynamic MAC entry untuk host B telah terhapus karena aging. Host A kemudian mengirim unicast ke MAC host B sebelum switch mempelajarinya kembali. Apa yang paling mungkin terjadi?
opsi_a: Frame langsung dikirim ke port lama walaupun entri sudah hilang
opsi_b: Frame diperlakukan sebagai unknown unicast dan di-flood dalam VLAN terkait
opsi_c: Frame otomatis diroute melalui default gateway
opsi_d: Switch menolak mempelajari MAC B lagi
pembahasan: Setelah dynamic entry hilang, switch tidak lagi mengetahui lokasi destination MAC tersebut. Frame berikutnya menjadi unknown unicast sampai switch memperoleh informasi MAC B kembali dari traffic yang dipelajari.

pertanyaan: Development: A dynamic MAC entry for host B has aged out. Host A then sends a unicast frame to host B's MAC before the switch learns it again. What is most likely to happen?
opsi_a: The frame is sent directly to the old port even though the entry is gone
opsi_b: The frame is treated as an unknown unicast and flooded within the relevant VLAN
opsi_c: The frame is automatically routed through the default gateway
opsi_d: The switch refuses to learn MAC B again
pembahasan: After the dynamic entry disappears, the switch no longer knows the destination MAC location. The next frame becomes an unknown unicast until the switch learns MAC B again from traffic.

pertanyaan: Pengembangan: Sebuah static MAC entry untuk BBBB.BBBB.BBBB VLAN 10 dikonfigurasi menuju Gi1/0/7. Sebuah frame VLAN 10 menuju MAC tersebut masuk melalui port lain. Apa keuntungan forwarding utama dari static entry tersebut?
opsi_a: Switch dapat langsung meneruskan frame ke Gi1/0/7 tanpa menunggu dynamic learning destination
opsi_b: Frame harus di-flood karena static MAC tidak digunakan untuk forwarding
opsi_c: Frame otomatis berpindah ke Layer 3
opsi_d: Switch akan menghapus static entry setelah aging timer habis
pembahasan: Static MAC entry memberikan informasi forwarding yang sudah diketahui untuk destination tersebut. Berbeda dari dynamic entry, static entry tidak bergantung pada proses learning normal untuk menentukan port tujuannya.

pertanyaan: Development: A static MAC entry for BBBB.BBBB.BBBB in VLAN 10 is configured toward Gi1/0/7. A VLAN 10 frame for that MAC enters another port. What is the primary forwarding benefit of the static entry?
opsi_a: The switch can forward the frame directly to Gi1/0/7 without waiting to dynamically learn the destination
opsi_b: The frame must be flooded because static MAC entries are not used for forwarding
opsi_c: The frame automatically moves to Layer 3 processing
opsi_d: The switch removes the static entry when the normal aging timer expires
pembahasan: A static MAC entry provides predetermined forwarding information for that destination. Unlike a dynamic entry, it does not depend on normal source-learning behavior to identify the destination port.

pertanyaan:
Pengembangan: Administrator ingin melihat MAC address table khusus VLAN 10 pada switch Cisco. Command mana yang paling tepat?
[cli]
show mac address-table vlan 10
[/cli]
opsi_a: show vlan destination-mac 10
opsi_b: show interfaces vlan mac 10
opsi_c: show mac address-table vlan 10
opsi_d: show arp vlan 10
pembahasan: Command tersebut memfilter tampilan MAC address table berdasarkan VLAN 10 sehingga administrator dapat melihat MAC dan port yang dipelajari pada VLAN itu. ARP table berbeda karena memetakan IP ke MAC, bukan MAC ke switch port.

pertanyaan:
Development: An administrator wants to display the MAC address table specifically for VLAN 10 on a Cisco switch. Which command is most appropriate?
[cli]
show mac address-table vlan 10
[/cli]
opsi_a: show vlan destination-mac 10
opsi_b: show interfaces vlan mac 10
opsi_c: show mac address-table vlan 10
opsi_d: show arp vlan 10
pembahasan: This command filters the MAC address table display for VLAN 10 so the administrator can see MAC addresses and learned ports in that VLAN. The ARP table is different because it maps IP addresses to MAC addresses rather than MAC addresses to switch ports.

pertanyaan: Pengembangan: Switch berulang kali mempelajari MAC AAAA.AAAA.AAAA berpindah cepat antara Gi1/0/10 dan Gi1/0/20 dalam VLAN yang sama. Apa interpretasi troubleshooting yang paling masuk akal?
opsi_a: Ini selalu normal karena CAM tidak menyimpan port
opsi_b: Hal tersebut membuktikan destination host berada di VLAN berbeda
opsi_c: Switch harus melakukan routing untuk MAC itu
opsi_d: Kemungkinan terjadi MAC flapping akibat host berpindah atau adanya jalur Layer 2 yang tidak semestinya seperti loop
pembahasan: Perubahan lokasi source MAC secara cepat membuat switch terus memperbarui port untuk MAC yang sama dan dikenal sebagai MAC flapping. Kondisi ini dapat disebabkan perangkat yang benar-benar berpindah, tetapi dalam troubleshooting sering menjadi petunjuk loop atau forwarding Layer 2 yang tidak normal.

pertanyaan: Development: A switch repeatedly learns MAC AAAA.AAAA.AAAA moving rapidly between Gi1/0/10 and Gi1/0/20 in the same VLAN. What is the most reasonable troubleshooting interpretation?
opsi_a: This is always normal because CAM does not store ports
opsi_b: It proves that the destination host is in a different VLAN
opsi_c: The switch must route traffic for that MAC
opsi_d: MAC flapping may be occurring because the host is moving or because an unintended Layer 2 path such as a loop exists
pembahasan: Rapid changes in the learned location of the same source MAC cause the switch to keep updating its port mapping and are commonly described as MAC flapping. A genuinely moving endpoint can cause this, but during troubleshooting it can also indicate a Layer 2 loop or abnormal forwarding path.

pertanyaan: Pengembangan: Tiga ingress port masing-masing dapat mengirim traffic 1 Gbps menuju satu egress port 1 Gbps pada saat yang sama. Apa kondisi yang paling mungkin jika traffic agregat benar-benar melebihi kapasitas port keluar?
opsi_a: Switch memperbesar kecepatan fisik egress port secara otomatis
opsi_b: Frame dapat mengantre pada egress queue dan akhirnya mengalami drop jika queue kehabisan ruang
opsi_c: CAM mengubah destination MAC agar traffic tersebar
opsi_d: Semua frame otomatis dipindahkan ke VLAN lain
pembahasan: Ketika banyak sumber mengarah ke satu egress yang lebih lambat daripada traffic agregat, congestion dapat terjadi pada output. Egress queue menampung frame sementara, tetapi jika queue penuh sebagian frame dapat mengalami output drop.

pertanyaan: Development: Three ingress ports can each send 1 Gbps of traffic toward a single 1 Gbps egress port at the same time. What is most likely if the aggregate traffic actually exceeds the output port capacity?
opsi_a: The switch automatically increases the physical speed of the egress port
opsi_b: Frames can queue in the egress queue and eventually be dropped if the queue runs out of space
opsi_c: CAM rewrites destination MAC addresses to distribute the traffic
opsi_d: All frames are automatically moved to another VLAN
pembahasan: When multiple sources send toward an egress whose capacity is lower than the aggregate incoming rate, output congestion can occur. The egress queue temporarily stores frames, but some frames can be dropped if the queue becomes full.

pertanyaan:
Pengembangan: Sebuah switch memiliki konfigurasi berikut:
[cli]
interface Gi1/0/1
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 10

interface Gi1/0/2
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 10

interface Gi1/0/3
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 20

interface Gi1/0/24
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20
[/cli]
Unknown unicast VLAN 10 masuk melalui Gi1/0/1. Destination MAC belum terdapat pada CAM table VLAN 10. Port mana yang normalnya menerima flooding tersebut?
opsi_b: Gi1/0/2 dan Gi1/0/3 saja
opsi_c: Gi1/0/3 dan Gi1/0/24 saja
pembahasan: Unknown unicast hanya di-flood dalam VLAN asal, sehingga Gi1/0/2 dan trunk Gi1/0/24 yang membawa VLAN 10 dapat menerima frame. Gi1/0/1 merupakan ingress port dan Gi1/0/3 hanya berada di VLAN 20, sehingga keduanya tidak menerima flooding tersebut.

pertanyaan:
Development: A switch has the following configuration:
[cli]
interface Gi1/0/1
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 10

interface Gi1/0/2
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 10

interface Gi1/0/3
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 20

interface Gi1/0/24
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20
[/cli]
An unknown unicast in VLAN 10 enters Gi1/0/1. The destination MAC is not present in the VLAN 10 CAM table. Which ports normally receive the flooded frame?
opsi_b: Gi1/0/2 and Gi1/0/3 only
opsi_c: Gi1/0/3 and Gi1/0/24 only
pembahasan: An unknown unicast is flooded only within its source VLAN, so Gi1/0/2 and trunk Gi1/0/24, which carries VLAN 10, can receive the frame. Gi1/0/1 is the ingress port and Gi1/0/3 belongs only to VLAN 20, so neither receives the flood.

pertanyaan: Pada perangkat Layer 3, apa fungsi utama control plane?
opsi_a: Meneruskan setiap paket pengguna berdasarkan destination IP
opsi_b: Menjalankan routing protocol, mempelajari jaringan, dan membentuk keputusan routing
opsi_c: Mengubah seluruh paket IP menjadi frame Ethernet
opsi_d: Hanya menghitung statistik interface
pembahasan: Control plane menjalankan fungsi seperti routing protocol dan membentuk keputusan yang kemudian dapat dimasukkan ke RIB. Forwarding paket pengguna normal terutama dilakukan oleh data plane, sedangkan statistik interface bukan fungsi utama control plane.

pertanyaan: On a Layer 3 device, what is the primary function of the control plane?
opsi_a: Forward every user packet based on its destination IP
opsi_b: Run routing protocols, learn the network, and build routing decisions
opsi_c: Convert every IP packet into an Ethernet frame
opsi_d: Only calculate interface statistics
pembahasan: The control plane runs functions such as routing protocols and builds routing decisions that can be installed in the RIB. Normal user-packet forwarding is primarily handled by the data plane, while interface statistics are not the main purpose of the control plane.

pertanyaan: Apa fungsi utama data plane pada perangkat Layer 3?
opsi_a: Membentuk neighbor BGP
opsi_b: Menghitung SPF OSPF
opsi_c: Memilih router ID untuk routing protocol
opsi_d: Meneruskan paket berdasarkan forwarding table yang telah diprogram
pembahasan: Data plane menggunakan informasi forwarding yang sudah tersedia untuk memproses dan meneruskan paket. Pembentukan neighbor, perhitungan routing, dan pemilihan parameter routing protocol merupakan fungsi control plane.

pertanyaan: What is the primary function of the data plane on a Layer 3 device?
opsi_a: Establish BGP neighbors
opsi_b: Run the OSPF SPF calculation
opsi_c: Select the router ID for a routing protocol
opsi_d: Forward packets based on the programmed forwarding table
pembahasan: The data plane uses already-installed forwarding information to process and forward packets. Neighbor establishment, routing calculations, and routing-protocol parameter selection belong to the control plane.

pertanyaan: Urutan mana yang paling tepat menggambarkan bagaimana informasi routing akhirnya digunakan untuk forwarding paket?
opsi_a: Routing Protocol ? IP Routing Table/RIB ? Forwarding Table/FIB
opsi_b: FIB ? Routing Protocol ? RIB
opsi_c: RIB ? FIB ? Routing Protocol
opsi_d: Forwarding Table ? RIB ? Routing Protocol
pembahasan: Routing protocol pada control plane mempelajari dan memilih informasi routing, lalu rute terbaik masuk ke RIB. Informasi yang diperlukan untuk forwarding kemudian diprogram ke FIB agar data plane dapat meneruskan paket.

pertanyaan: Which sequence best describes how routing information eventually becomes usable for packet forwarding?
opsi_a: Routing Protocol ? IP Routing Table/RIB ? Forwarding Table/FIB
opsi_b: FIB ? Routing Protocol ? RIB
opsi_c: RIB ? FIB ? Routing Protocol
opsi_d: Forwarding Table ? RIB ? Routing Protocol
pembahasan: A routing protocol in the control plane learns and selects routing information, and the selected route is placed in the RIB. The required forwarding information is then programmed into the FIB so the data plane can forward packets.

pertanyaan: Sebuah OSPF Hello dari router tetangga masuk melalui interface Ethernet. Pada arsitektur yang dibahas, bagaimana paket tersebut diproses?
opsi_a: Langsung diteruskan ke interface lain sebagai trafik transit
opsi_b: Langsung masuk ke proses OSPF tanpa melalui jalur data plane sama sekali
opsi_c: Masuk melalui data plane, dikenali sebagai paket yang perlu diproses lokal, lalu diserahkan ke control plane
opsi_d: Selalu dibuang karena OSPF tidak termasuk trafik pengguna
pembahasan: Paket dari jaringan tetap masuk melalui jalur ingress/data plane. Karena OSPF Hello ditujukan untuk fungsi routing perangkat tersebut, paket kemudian diproses oleh proses OSPF pada control plane, bukan diteruskan sebagai trafik transit.

pertanyaan: An OSPF Hello from a neighboring router enters an Ethernet interface. In the architecture discussed, how is the packet handled?
opsi_a: It is immediately forwarded out another interface as transit traffic
opsi_b: It enters the OSPF process directly without passing through the data-plane path at all
opsi_c: It enters through the data plane, is recognized as requiring local processing, and is then delivered to the control plane
opsi_d: It is always dropped because OSPF is not user traffic
pembahasan: A packet arriving from the network still enters through the ingress/data-plane path. Because the OSPF Hello is intended for the device's routing function, it is then processed by the OSPF process in the control plane rather than forwarded as transit traffic.

pertanyaan: PC1 melakukan ping ke server yang berada di belakang sebuah router. Destination IP paket ICMP bukan salah satu IP milik router. Komponen mana yang normalnya meneruskan paket tersebut melalui router?
opsi_a: Proses OSPF pada CPU
opsi_b: Data plane menggunakan FIB
opsi_c: Proses SSH
opsi_d: Routing protocol yang pertama kali mempelajari prefix server
pembahasan: Paket tersebut merupakan trafik transit, sehingga data plane melakukan lookup forwarding dan meneruskannya. Walaupun rutenya mungkin dipelajari melalui OSPF atau BGP, routing protocol tidak memproses setiap paket pengguna yang memakai rute tersebut.

pertanyaan: PC1 pings a server located behind a router. The ICMP packet's destination IP is not one of the router's own addresses. Which component normally forwards that packet through the router?
opsi_a: The OSPF process on the CPU
opsi_b: The data plane using the FIB
opsi_c: The SSH process
opsi_d: The routing protocol that originally learned the server prefix
pembahasan: The packet is transit traffic, so the data plane performs the forwarding lookup and forwards it. Even if the route was learned through OSPF or BGP, the routing protocol does not process every user packet that uses that route.

pertanyaan: PC dengan alamat 192.168.10.10 melakukan ping ke interface router 192.168.10.1. Jalur pemrosesan mana yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Paket masuk melalui data plane, dikenali sebagai tujuan lokal, lalu diproses control plane untuk menghasilkan ICMP Echo Reply
opsi_b: Paket hanya diproses data plane dan tidak pernah melibatkan CPU
opsi_c: Paket diteruskan ke next hop berdasarkan default route
opsi_d: Paket dibuang karena router tidak boleh menjadi tujuan ICMP
pembahasan: Karena destination IP merupakan alamat milik router sendiri, paket bukan trafik transit. Data plane menerima paket dan mengenalinya sebagai local delivery, kemudian fungsi pada CPU/control plane menangani ICMP Echo Request dan menghasilkan reply.

pertanyaan: A PC at 192.168.10.10 pings the router interface 192.168.10.1. Which processing path is most accurate?
opsi_a: The packet enters through the data plane, is recognized as locally destined, and is then processed by the control plane to generate an ICMP Echo Reply
opsi_b: The packet is handled only by the data plane and never involves the CPU
opsi_c: The packet is forwarded to a next hop using the default route
opsi_d: The packet is dropped because a router cannot be an ICMP destination
pembahasan: Because the destination IP belongs to the router itself, the packet is not transit traffic. The data plane receives it and recognizes it as local delivery, after which CPU/control-plane functions process the ICMP Echo Request and generate the reply.

pertanyaan: Administrator melakukan SSH ke IP router pada TCP port 22. Pernyataan mana yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: SSH merupakan trafik transit sehingga cukup diproses oleh FIB
opsi_b: Paket SSH dilewatkan ke router berikutnya sebelum diproses
opsi_c: Routing protocol harus mempelajari route ke alamat router sendiri terlebih dahulu
opsi_d: Paket masuk melalui data plane lalu diserahkan untuk pemrosesan lokal oleh CPU/control plane
pembahasan: SSH yang destination IP-nya adalah router merupakan trafik yang ditujukan kepada perangkat itu sendiri. Data plane menerima paket dari interface, kemudian paket local-delivery tersebut diserahkan kepada layanan SSH yang berjalan melalui CPU/control-plane processing.

pertanyaan: An administrator starts an SSH session to a router's IP address on TCP port 22. Which statement is most accurate?
opsi_a: SSH is transit traffic and therefore only requires a FIB lookup
opsi_b: The SSH packet is sent to the next router before being processed
opsi_c: A routing protocol must first learn a route to the router's own address
opsi_d: The packet enters through the data plane and is then delivered for local CPU/control-plane processing
pembahasan: SSH whose destination IP is the router itself is traffic addressed to the device. The data plane receives the packet from the interface, and the locally destined packet is then delivered to the SSH service through CPU/control-plane processing.

pertanyaan: R1 dan R2 merupakan BGP neighbor. Sebuah BGP KEEPALIVE dari R2 ditujukan ke IP peering milik R1. Siapa yang akhirnya harus memproses isi pesan BGP tersebut pada R1?
opsi_a: ASIC saja tanpa keterlibatan proses BGP
opsi_b: Proses OSPF
opsi_c: Proses BGP pada control plane
opsi_d: Switching fabric sebagai trafik transit
pembahasan: BGP KEEPALIVE ditujukan kepada sesi BGP milik router sehingga akhirnya diproses oleh proses BGP di control plane. Data plane tetap menjadi bagian dari jalur masuk paket, tetapi tidak menggantikan fungsi proses BGP dalam memahami pesan tersebut.

pertanyaan: R1 and R2 are BGP neighbors. A BGP KEEPALIVE from R2 is addressed to R1's peering IP. Which component ultimately processes the BGP message on R1?
opsi_a: Only the ASIC with no involvement from the BGP process
opsi_b: The OSPF process
opsi_c: The BGP process in the control plane
opsi_d: The switching fabric as transit traffic
pembahasan: The BGP KEEPALIVE is addressed to the router's BGP session, so it is ultimately processed by the BGP process in the control plane. The data plane is still part of the packet's ingress path, but it does not replace the BGP process that interprets the message.

pertanyaan: Host mengirim ARP Request: "Who has 192.168.10.1?" dan 192.168.10.1 adalah IP interface router pada LAN tersebut. Apa yang paling tepat terjadi?
opsi_a: Router memproses permintaan tersebut sebagai permintaan untuk alamat lokal dan dapat menghasilkan ARP Reply
opsi_b: Router melakukan route lookup untuk mencari network 192.168.10.0/24 lalu meneruskan ARP ke router lain
opsi_c: ARP hanya dapat diproses oleh routing protocol
opsi_d: ARP Request selalu dibuang oleh perangkat Layer 3
pembahasan: Target IP ARP adalah alamat milik router, sehingga perangkat perlu menanggapi permintaan tersebut sebagai alamat lokal. Ini berbeda dari trafik IP transit yang cukup diteruskan menggunakan FIB.

pertanyaan: A host sends an ARP Request saying, "Who has 192.168.10.1?" and 192.168.10.1 is the router's interface IP on that LAN. What is the most accurate result?
opsi_a: The router processes the request as being for a local address and can generate an ARP Reply
opsi_b: The router performs a route lookup for 192.168.10.0/24 and forwards the ARP to another router
opsi_c: ARP can only be processed by a routing protocol
opsi_d: An ARP Request is always dropped by a Layer 3 device
pembahasan: The ARP target IP belongs to the router, so the device must handle the request as being for a local address. This differs from ordinary transit IP traffic, which can simply be forwarded using the FIB.

pertanyaan: Sebuah paket IP masuk ke router dengan TTL 1 dan masih harus melewati router tersebut untuk mencapai destination. Apa yang paling tepat terjadi?
opsi_a: Router meneruskan paket tanpa mengubah TTL
opsi_b: TTL menjadi 0 sehingga paket tidak diteruskan dan memerlukan penanganan exception seperti pembuatan ICMP Time Exceeded
opsi_c: Router mengubah TTL kembali menjadi 255
opsi_d: OSPF secara langsung meneruskan paket tersebut ke destination
pembahasan: Router mengurangi TTL ketika meneruskan paket. Jika TTL menjadi 0, paket tidak boleh diteruskan secara normal dan kondisi tersebut memerlukan exception processing, yang umumnya menghasilkan ICMP Time Exceeded; detail implementasi hardware dapat berbeda antarplatform.

pertanyaan: An IP packet enters a router with TTL 1 and still needs to cross that router to reach its destination. What most accurately occurs?
opsi_a: The router forwards the packet without changing the TTL
opsi_b: The TTL becomes 0, so the packet is not forwarded and requires exception handling such as generating ICMP Time Exceeded
opsi_c: The router changes the TTL back to 255
opsi_d: OSPF directly forwards the packet to the destination
pembahasan: A router decrements the TTL when forwarding a packet. If the TTL reaches 0, the packet cannot be forwarded normally and requires exception processing, which commonly results in ICMP Time Exceeded; the exact hardware implementation can vary by platform.

pertanyaan: R1 memiliki rute ke 10.10.10.0/24 melalui next hop 192.168.12.2, tetapi MAC address untuk 192.168.1belum diketahui. Apa masalah utama data plane saat itu?
opsi_a: Routing protocol harus menghapus prefix 10.10.10.0/24
opsi_b: R1 harus mengganti next hop menjadi dirinya sendiri
opsi_c: FIB tidak boleh berisi route apa pun sampai OSPF restart
opsi_d: Informasi Layer 3 tersedia, tetapi adjacency Layer 2 ke next hop belum lengkap sehingga perlu neighbor/ARP resolution
pembahasan: Router dapat mengetahui keputusan routing Layer 3 tetapi tetap membutuhkan informasi Layer 2 untuk membentuk frame pada media Ethernet. Sampai MAC next hop diketahui, adjacency dapat berada dalam kondisi incomplete dan perangkat perlu melakukan ARP resolution.

pertanyaan: R1 has a route to 10.10.10.0/24 through next hop 192.168.12.2, but the MAC address for 192.168.1is not yet known. What is the main data-plane issue?
opsi_a: The routing protocol must remove 10.10.10.0/24
opsi_b: R1 must change the next hop to itself
opsi_c: The FIB cannot contain any routes until OSPF restarts
opsi_d: The Layer 3 decision exists, but the Layer 2 adjacency to the next hop is incomplete and requires neighbor/ARP resolution
pembahasan: A router may know the Layer 3 routing decision but still needs Layer 2 information to construct a frame on Ethernet media. Until the next-hop MAC is known, the adjacency can remain incomplete and the device must perform ARP resolution.

pertanyaan: R1 perlu mengirim OSPF Hello yang dibuat oleh proses OSPF lokal. Jalur mana yang paling tepat untuk paket yang keluar dari perangkat?
opsi_a: Data plane membuat seluruh informasi OSPF tanpa control plane
opsi_b: OSPF Hello hanya berada di CPU dan tidak melewati interface
opsi_c: Control plane membuat paket OSPF, lalu data plane menangani pengiriman paket melalui interface yang sesuai
opsi_d: Paket harus masuk dari interface terlebih dahulu sebelum dapat dikirim keluar
pembahasan: OSPF Hello dibuat oleh proses OSPF pada control plane. Untuk benar-benar dikirim ke media jaringan, paket tersebut kemudian menggunakan jalur forwarding/output pada data plane dan interface perangkat.

pertanyaan: R1 needs to transmit an OSPF Hello generated by its local OSPF process. Which path is most accurate for the outgoing packet?
opsi_a: The data plane creates all OSPF information without the control plane
opsi_b: The OSPF Hello remains only on the CPU and never crosses an interface
opsi_c: The control plane creates the OSPF packet, and the data plane handles transmission through the appropriate interface
opsi_d: The packet must first arrive from an interface before it can be sent out
pembahasan: The OSPF Hello is generated by the OSPF process in the control plane. To actually place the packet onto the network medium, it then uses the device's data-plane/output forwarding path and interface.

pertanyaan: Materi menyatakan control plane dan data plane pada perangkat Layer 3 bersifat "relatively independent". Apa maknanya?
opsi_a: Keduanya sama sekali tidak pernah bertukar informasi
opsi_b: Control plane dan data plane memiliki fungsi berbeda; control plane dapat memprogram informasi forwarding sementara data plane menjalankan forwarding secara terpisah
opsi_c: Data plane tidak membutuhkan informasi yang berasal dari control plane
opsi_d: Control plane selalu harus memproses setiap paket yang melewati perangkat
pembahasan: Relatively independent berarti fungsi pengambilan keputusan dan fungsi forwarding dipisahkan, bukan berarti keduanya tidak berhubungan. Control plane memberikan informasi yang diperlukan kepada data plane, sedangkan data plane dapat meneruskan paket menggunakan state yang sudah diprogram.

pertanyaan: The material states that the control plane and data plane on a Layer 3 device are "relatively independent." What does this mean?
opsi_a: They never exchange any information at all
opsi_b: The control plane and data plane perform different functions; the control plane can program forwarding information while the data plane performs forwarding separately
opsi_c: The data plane does not need any information originating from the control plane
opsi_d: The control plane must always process every packet crossing the device
pembahasan: Relatively independent means the decision-making and forwarding functions are separated, not that they are unrelated. The control plane supplies required information to the data plane, while the data plane can forward packets using already-programmed state.

pertanyaan:
Perhatikan potongan output ilustratif berikut.
[output]
R1# show interfaces GigabitEthernet0/0
  5 minute input rate 850000000 bits/sec
  5 minute output rate 120000000 bits/sec
  125 input errors
[/output]
Dari sudut hubungan control plane dan data plane, pernyataan mana yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Routing protocol menghitung setiap bit yang melewati interface
opsi_b: Nilai tersebut membuktikan seluruh paket dikirim ke CPU
opsi_c: FIB tidak terlibat dalam trafik interface
opsi_d: Statistik aktivitas interface/data plane dapat dikumpulkan dan disajikan kepada route processor/control plane
pembahasan: Counter dan rate menggambarkan aktivitas yang terjadi pada jalur forwarding/interface. Data plane atau interface module mengumpulkan informasi tersebut, kemudian sistem control-plane/management dapat menampilkannya melalui command seperti show interfaces.

pertanyaan:
Consider the following simplified illustrative output.
[output]
R1# show interfaces GigabitEthernet0/0
  5 minute input rate 850000000 bits/sec
  5 minute output rate 120000000 bits/sec
  125 input errors
[/output]
From the perspective of control-plane and data-plane interaction, which statement is most accurate?
opsi_a: The routing protocol calculates every bit crossing the interface
opsi_b: The values prove that all packets are sent to the CPU
opsi_c: The FIB is not involved in interface traffic
