opsi_d: Interface/data-plane activity statistics can be collected and presented to the route processor/control plane
pembahasan: The counters and rates describe activity occurring on the interface and forwarding path. The data plane or interface module can collect this information, while control-plane/management functions expose it through commands such as show interfaces.

pertanyaan: Pada distributed architecture yang dijelaskan dalam materi, pembagian fungsi mana yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Routing protocol berjalan pada route processor, sedangkan sebagian besar packet forwarding dilakukan oleh interface module/switching fabric
opsi_b: Routing protocol hanya berjalan pada ASIC interface, sedangkan seluruh forwarding dilakukan CPU
opsi_c: Control plane berada pada kabel Ethernet dan data plane berada pada routing protocol
opsi_d: Route processor hanya digunakan untuk menyimpan counter fisik interface
pembahasan: Materi menjelaskan bahwa kode control plane seperti routing protocol berjalan pada route processor. Sebagian besar aktivitas forwarding dilakukan oleh interface module, microcode, ASIC, atau switching fabric sehingga CPU pusat tidak harus memproses setiap paket transit.

pertanyaan: In the distributed architecture described in the material, which division of responsibilities is most accurate?
opsi_a: Routing protocols run on the route processor, while most packet forwarding is handled by interface modules or the switching fabric
opsi_b: Routing protocols run only on interface ASICs, while all forwarding is performed by the CPU
opsi_c: The control plane resides on the Ethernet cable and the data plane resides in the routing protocol
opsi_d: The route processor is used only to store physical interface counters
pembahasan: The material explains that control-plane code such as routing protocols runs on the route processor. Most forwarding activity is handled by interface modules, microcode, ASICs, or the switching fabric so the central CPU does not have to process every transit packet.

pertanyaan: R1 menggunakan OSPF. Link yang sebelumnya menjadi best path menuju 10.20.0.0/16 gagal dan tersedia jalur alternatif. Urutan reaksi yang paling tepat adalah?
opsi_a: Data plane menjalankan SPF lalu mengubah database OSPF
opsi_b: ASIC mengirim BGP UPDATE lalu RIB dibuat ulang
opsi_c: Control plane mendeteksi perubahan dan menghitung keputusan baru, RIB/FIB diperbarui, lalu data plane menggunakan forwarding entry yang baru
opsi_d: Setiap paket pengguna menghitung sendiri jalur alternatif tanpa perubahan forwarding table
pembahasan: Perubahan topologi diproses oleh fungsi routing pada control plane, yang menentukan route terbaik baru. Hasilnya memperbarui state routing dan forwarding, lalu data plane meneruskan paket menggunakan entry baru tersebut.

pertanyaan: R1 uses OSPF. The link that previously provided the best path to 10.20.0.0/16 fails, and an alternate path is available. Which reaction sequence is most accurate?
opsi_a: The data plane runs SPF and then modifies the OSPF database
opsi_b: The ASIC sends a BGP UPDATE and then rebuilds the RIB
opsi_c: The control plane detects the change and computes a new decision, the RIB/FIB are updated, and the data plane then uses the new forwarding entry
opsi_d: Each user packet independently calculates an alternate path without any forwarding-table change
pembahasan: The topology change is processed by routing functions in the control plane, which determine the new best route. The result updates routing and forwarding state, after which the data plane forwards packets using the new entry.

pertanyaan: R1 mempelajari prefix 203.0.113.0/24 melalui BGP. Setelah route tersebut terpasang untuk forwarding, sebuah paket pengguna menuju 203.0.113.10 masuk ke R1. Pernyataan mana yang benar?
opsi_a: Proses BGP harus membaca payload setiap paket tersebut
opsi_b: R1 mengirim BGP UPDATE baru setiap kali ada paket menuju prefix itu
opsi_c: Paket selalu dipunt ke CPU karena rutenya berasal dari BGP
opsi_d: BGP menentukan informasi route, tetapi forwarding paket transit normal dilakukan data plane menggunakan FIB
pembahasan: BGP merupakan control-plane protocol yang mempelajari dan memilih jalur. Setelah informasi forwarding diprogram, paket pengguna yang menggunakan prefix tersebut dapat diteruskan oleh data plane tanpa meminta proses BGP memproses setiap paket.

pertanyaan: R1 learns 203.0.113.0/24 through BGP. After the route is installed for forwarding, a user packet destined for 203.0.113.10 enters R1. Which statement is correct?
opsi_a: The BGP process must inspect the payload of every such packet
opsi_b: R1 sends a new BGP UPDATE every time a packet is sent to that prefix
opsi_c: The packet is always punted to the CPU because the route came from BGP
opsi_d: BGP determines routing information, but normal transit-packet forwarding is performed by the data plane using the FIB
pembahasan: BGP is a control-plane protocol that learns and selects paths. Once forwarding information has been programmed, user packets using that prefix can be forwarded by the data plane without requiring the BGP process to handle each packet.

pertanyaan: Dua paket masuk ke R1 melalui Gi0/0 pada waktu hampir bersamaan. Paket pertama adalah OSPF Hello yang ditujukan kepada R1. Paket kedua adalah TCP dari PC menuju server di belakang R1 dan memiliki route valid di FIB. Bagaimana keduanya seharusnya diperlakukan?
opsi_a: OSPF Hello diserahkan ke control plane, sedangkan paket TCP transit diteruskan data plane
opsi_b: Keduanya harus diproses penuh oleh proses OSPF
opsi_c: Keduanya hanya dapat diproses oleh CPU karena masuk melalui interface yang sama
opsi_d: OSPF Hello diteruskan sebagai transit, sedangkan paket TCP dikirim ke control plane
pembahasan: Jenis pemrosesan ditentukan oleh tujuan dan sifat paket, bukan hanya oleh interface masuknya. OSPF Hello untuk router membutuhkan local/control-plane processing, sedangkan paket TCP transit dengan forwarding entry valid dapat tetap ditangani data plane.

pertanyaan: Two packets enter R1 through Gi0/0 at nearly the same time. The first is an OSPF Hello addressed to R1. The second is TCP traffic from a PC to a server behind R1 and has a valid FIB route. How should they be handled?
opsi_a: The OSPF Hello is delivered to the control plane, while the transit TCP packet is forwarded by the data plane
opsi_b: Both must be fully processed by the OSPF process
opsi_c: Both can only be processed by the CPU because they entered the same interface
opsi_d: The OSPF Hello is forwarded as transit traffic, while the TCP packet is sent to the control plane
pembahasan: The required processing depends on the packet's purpose and destination, not merely on the ingress interface. The OSPF Hello for the router requires local/control-plane processing, while the transit TCP packet with a valid forwarding entry can remain in the data plane.

pertanyaan: Sebuah router menerima sangat banyak paket yang sengaja ditujukan ke IP perangkat sendiri sehingga CPU mulai sibuk. Mekanisme apa yang paling relevan untuk melindungi resource control plane?
opsi_a: Menonaktifkan FIB
opsi_b: Memindahkan seluruh routing protocol ke data plane
opsi_c: Control Plane Policing (CoPP) atau mekanisme rate-limiting control-plane yang sesuai
opsi_d: Menghapus seluruh static route
pembahasan: Trafik yang ditujukan atau dipunt ke CPU dapat menghabiskan resource control plane jika jumlahnya berlebihan. CoPP digunakan untuk mengklasifikasikan dan membatasi jenis trafik menuju control plane; menghapus FIB atau route tidak merupakan solusi umum untuk masalah tersebut.

pertanyaan: A router receives a very high rate of packets intentionally addressed to the device itself, causing the CPU to become busy. Which mechanism is most relevant for protecting control-plane resources?
opsi_a: Disable the FIB
opsi_b: Move all routing protocols into the data plane
opsi_c: Control Plane Policing (CoPP) or an appropriate control-plane rate-limiting mechanism
opsi_d: Remove all static routes
pembahasan: Traffic addressed or punted to the CPU can consume control-plane resources when sent at excessive rates. CoPP is used to classify and limit traffic toward the control plane; removing the FIB or routes is not a general solution to this problem.

pertanyaan: Seorang engineer ingin membandingkan keputusan routing pada RIB dengan entry forwarding untuk destination 10.10.10.5 pada Cisco IOS XE. Pasangan command mana yang paling relevan?
opsi_a:
[cli]
show arp
show running-config
[/cli]
opsi_b:
[cli]
show ip route 10.10.10.0
show ip cef 10.10.10.5
[/cli]
opsi_c:
[cli]
show clock
show users
[/cli]
opsi_d:
[cli]
show spanning-tree
show vlan brief
[/cli]
pembahasan: show ip route digunakan untuk memeriksa keputusan routing di RIB, sedangkan show ip cef dapat digunakan untuk melihat informasi forwarding CEF/FIB menuju destination. Command lain pada opsi tidak membandingkan routing table dengan data-plane forwarding state.

pertanyaan: An engineer wants to compare the routing decision in the RIB with the forwarding entry for destination 10.10.10.5 on Cisco IOS XE. Which command pair is most relevant?
opsi_a:
[cli]
show arp
show running-config
[/cli]
opsi_b:
[cli]
show ip route 10.10.10.0
show ip cef 10.10.10.5
[/cli]
opsi_c:
[cli]
show clock
show users
[/cli]
opsi_d:
[cli]
show spanning-tree
show vlan brief
[/cli]
pembahasan: show ip route is used to inspect the routing decision in the RIB, while show ip cef can be used to inspect CEF/FIB forwarding information toward the destination. The other command pairs do not compare the routing table with data-plane forwarding state.

pertanyaan:
Perhatikan potongan output ilustratif berikut.
[output]
R1# show ip route 10.10.10.0
Routing entry for 10.10.10.0/24
  Known via "ospf 1"
  * 192.0.2.2, via GigabitEthernet0/1

R1# show ip cef 10.10.10.5
10.10.10.0/24
  nexthop 192.0.GigabitEthernet0/1
[/output]
Kesimpulan mana yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Control plane memiliki route menuju prefix tersebut dan data plane juga memiliki informasi forwarding melalui 192.0.di Gi0/1
opsi_b: OSPF akan memproses setiap paket menuju 10.10.10.5
opsi_c: CEF menunjukkan bahwa prefix tidak ada di routing table
opsi_d: Paket menuju 10.10.10.5 pasti dipunt ke CPU
pembahasan: Output pertama menunjukkan keputusan route pada RIB, sedangkan output kedua menunjukkan forwarding entry yang konsisten pada CEF/FIB. Ini mendukung pemisahan fungsi: OSPF membantu membentuk route, sedangkan data plane menggunakan informasi forwarding untuk paket transit.

pertanyaan:
Consider the following simplified illustrative output.
[output]
R1# show ip route 10.10.10.0
Routing entry for 10.10.10.0/24
  Known via "ospf 1"
  * 192.0.2.2, via GigabitEthernet0/1

R1# show ip cef 10.10.10.5
10.10.10.0/24
  nexthop 192.0.GigabitEthernet0/1
[/output]
Which conclusion is most accurate?
opsi_a: The control plane has a route to the prefix and the data plane also has forwarding information through 192.0.on Gi0/1
opsi_b: OSPF will process every packet destined for 10.10.10.5
opsi_c: CEF shows that the prefix is absent from the routing table
opsi_d: Packets to 10.10.10.5 must be punted to the CPU
pembahasan: The first output shows the route decision in the RIB, while the second shows a consistent forwarding entry in CEF/FIB. This demonstrates the functional separation: OSPF helps build the route, while the data plane uses forwarding information for transit packets.

pertanyaan:
Sebuah router hardware menunjukkan trafik transit sangat tinggi pada interface, tetapi CPU control-plane tetap rendah.
[output]
R1# show interfaces GigabitEthernet0/0
  5 minute input rate 900000000 bits/sec

R1# show processes cpu
  CPU utilization for five seconds: 8%
[/output]
Dengan asumsi tidak ada masalah lain, apa penjelasan terbaik?
opsi_a: Setiap paket sedang diproses CPU tetapi nilai CPU tidak dapat dipercaya
opsi_b: Routing protocol berhenti bekerja sehingga paket tidak lagi dirouting
opsi_c: Trafik sebenarnya tidak melewati router
opsi_d: Banyak trafik transit dapat diteruskan oleh hardware/data plane tanpa CPU memproses setiap paket satu per satu
pembahasan: Pada arsitektur terdistribusi, forwarding hardware dapat menangani volume besar trafik transit menggunakan FIB dan adjacency yang sudah diprogram. Karena itu throughput data plane yang tinggi tidak selalu berarti CPU control-plane juga harus tinggi.

pertanyaan:
A hardware router shows very high transit traffic on an interface while control-plane CPU utilization remains low.
[output]
R1# show interfaces GigabitEthernet0/0
  5 minute input rate 900000000 bits/sec

R1# show processes cpu
  CPU utilization for five seconds: 8%
[/output]
Assuming no other issue exists, what is the best explanation?
opsi_a: Every packet is being CPU processed, but the CPU value cannot be trusted
opsi_b: The routing protocol has stopped, so packets are no longer being routed
opsi_c: The traffic is not actually crossing the router
opsi_d: Large amounts of transit traffic can be forwarded by hardware/data plane without the CPU processing every packet individually
pembahasan: In a distributed architecture, forwarding hardware can process large volumes of transit traffic using already-programmed FIB and adjacency information. Therefore, high data-plane throughput does not necessarily imply high control-plane CPU utilization.

pertanyaan: Saat menjalankan traceroute, R1 mengirim ICMP Time Exceeded kembali ke sumber untuk salah satu probe. Kondisi apa yang paling mungkin menyebabkan respons tersebut?
opsi_a: R1 menerima BGP KEEPALIVE
opsi_b: TTL probe berkurang menjadi 0 ketika diproses oleh R1
opsi_c: R1 tidak mempunyai MAC address miliknya sendiri
opsi_d: OSPF Hello timer pada R1 habis
pembahasan: Traceroute memanfaatkan TTL yang dibuat habis pada hop-hop tertentu sehingga router menghasilkan ICMP Time Exceeded. Ini merupakan contoh paket transit yang mengalami kondisi exception dan membutuhkan penanganan berbeda dari forwarding normal.

pertanyaan: During traceroute, R1 sends an ICMP Time Exceeded message back to the source for one of the probes. Which condition most likely caused that response?
opsi_a: R1 received a BGP KEEPALIVE
opsi_b: The probe's TTL was decremented to 0 while being processed by R1
opsi_c: R1 does not know its own MAC address
opsi_d: R1's OSPF Hello timer expired
pembahasan: Traceroute uses TTL values that expire at specific hops, causing the router to generate ICMP Time Exceeded. This is an example of a transit packet encountering an exception condition that requires handling different from normal forwarding.

pertanyaan:
Perhatikan output CEF ilustratif untuk IP interface lokal router.
[output]
R1# show ip cef 192.168.10.1
192.168.10.1/32
  receive
[/output]
Apa arti paling tepat dari keyword receive dalam konteks ini?
opsi_a: Semua paket untuk 192.168.10.1 diteruskan ke default gateway
opsi_b: Prefix tersebut belum memiliki route
opsi_c: Paket menuju alamat tersebut adalah local delivery dan perlu diterima oleh perangkat, bukan diteruskan sebagai trafik transit
opsi_d: Interface 192.168.10.1 hanya menerima broadcast
pembahasan: Receive menunjukkan bahwa destination adalah alamat lokal perangkat sehingga paket tidak diteruskan ke next hop biasa. Paket yang memerlukan pemrosesan oleh protokol atau layanan lokal dapat diarahkan dari jalur data-plane menuju pemrosesan lokal/CPU.

pertanyaan:
Consider the following illustrative CEF output for a router's local interface IP.
[output]
R1# show ip cef 192.168.10.1
192.168.10.1/32
  receive
[/output]
What does the receive keyword most accurately indicate in this context?
opsi_a: All packets for 192.168.10.1 are forwarded to the default gateway
opsi_b: The prefix has no route
opsi_c: Packets to that address are for local delivery and must be received by the device rather than forwarded as transit traffic
opsi_d: The 192.168.10.1 interface can only receive broadcasts
pembahasan: Receive indicates that the destination is a local address on the device, so the packet is not forwarded to a normal next hop. Packets requiring local protocol or service processing can be directed from the data-plane path toward local CPU processing.

pertanyaan:
R1 memiliki interface Gi0/0 dengan IP 192.168.10.1. ACL inbound berikut diterapkan.
[cli]
ip access-list extended MGMT-IN
 deny tcp any host 192.168.10.1 eq 22
 permit ip any any
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 ip access-group MGMT-IN in
[/cli]
Host 192.168.10.10 mencoba SSH ke 192.168.10.1 melalui Gi0/0. Apa yang paling tepat terjadi?
opsi_a: Paket pasti mencapai proses SSH karena destination adalah control plane
opsi_b: ACL hanya dapat memfilter paket transit dan tidak dapat memengaruhi trafik ke router
opsi_c: SSH akan diterima lalu dibuang oleh BGP
opsi_d: Paket dapat dibuang pada jalur ingress sebelum mencapai layanan SSH/control-plane processing
pembahasan: ACL ingress dapat memfilter paket sebelum trafik tersebut mencapai layanan lokal yang dituju. Jadi fakta bahwa destination adalah router tidak berarti paket otomatis melewati semua fungsi data-plane filtering.

pertanyaan:
R1 has Gi0/0 configured with IP address 192.168.10.1. The following inbound ACL is applied.
[cli]
ip access-list extended MGMT-IN
 deny tcp any host 192.168.10.1 eq 22
 permit ip any any
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 ip access-group MGMT-IN in
[/cli]
Host 192.168.10.10 attempts to SSH to 192.168.10.1 through Gi0/0. What most accurately happens?
opsi_a: The packet must reach the SSH process because the destination is the control plane
opsi_b: An ACL can only filter transit packets and cannot affect traffic to the router
opsi_c: SSH is accepted and then dropped by BGP
opsi_d: The packet can be dropped on the ingress path before it reaches the SSH service/control-plane processing
pembahasan: An ingress ACL can filter the packet before the traffic reaches the intended local service. Therefore, the fact that the destination is the router does not mean the packet automatically bypasses all data-plane filtering functions.

pertanyaan: Sebuah policy CoPP membatasi trafik tertentu yang menuju CPU, tetapi trafik pengguna biasa yang melewati router memiliki FIB entry valid. Pernyataan mana yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: CoPP menggantikan seluruh fungsi FIB
opsi_b: CoPP terutama melindungi control plane; forwarding transit normal tetap dapat dilakukan oleh data plane sesuai policy lain yang berlaku
opsi_c: Semua trafik transit otomatis harus dipunt ke CPU terlebih dahulu
opsi_d: CoPP membuat routing protocol tidak lagi diperlukan
pembahasan: CoPP ditujukan untuk melindungi resource control plane dari trafik yang menuju atau dipunt ke CPU. Ia tidak menggantikan FIB atau mengharuskan seluruh trafik transit berpindah ke control-plane processing.

pertanyaan: A CoPP policy limits certain traffic destined for the CPU, while ordinary user transit traffic has valid FIB entries. Which statement is most accurate?
opsi_a: CoPP replaces all FIB functions
opsi_b: CoPP primarily protects the control plane; normal transit forwarding can still be performed by the data plane subject to other applicable policies
opsi_c: All transit traffic must automatically be punted to the CPU first
opsi_d: CoPP makes routing protocols unnecessary
pembahasan: CoPP is intended to protect control-plane resources from traffic destined or punted to the CPU. It does not replace the FIB or require all transit traffic to move into control-plane processing.

pertanyaan: Pada sebuah switch Layer 3 berbasis hardware, CPU route processor menjadi sangat tinggi karena banyak control-plane traffic. FIB dan adjacency untuk trafik transit sudah terprogram dan tidak berubah. Apa dampak yang paling masuk akal?
opsi_a: Semua forwarding pasti langsung berhenti karena setiap paket harus diproses CPU
opsi_b: FIB otomatis dihapus segera ketika CPU tinggi
opsi_c: Forwarding hardware yang sudah terprogram dapat tetap bekerja, tetapi routing protocol, management, atau convergence dapat terganggu
opsi_d: CPU tinggi hanya dapat disebabkan oleh kerusakan kabel
pembahasan: Pemisahan control plane dan data plane memungkinkan forwarding hardware terus menggunakan state yang sudah ada pada banyak platform. Namun CPU yang kewalahan dapat mengganggu pembentukan adjacency, update routing, management, atau respons terhadap perubahan jaringan, sehingga independensinya tetap bersifat relatif.

pertanyaan: On a hardware-based Layer 3 switch, the route-processor CPU becomes very busy due to a large amount of control-plane traffic. The FIB and adjacencies for transit traffic are already programmed and unchanged. What is the most reasonable effect?
opsi_a: All forwarding must immediately stop because every packet requires CPU processing
opsi_b: The FIB is automatically deleted as soon as CPU utilization becomes high
opsi_c: Already-programmed hardware forwarding may continue, while routing protocols, management, or convergence may be impaired
opsi_d: High CPU utilization can only be caused by a bad cable
pembahasan: The separation of control and data planes allows forwarding hardware on many platforms to continue using existing state. However, an overloaded CPU can impair adjacency formation, routing updates, management, or reaction to network changes, so the independence is only relative.

pertanyaan: Pada sebuah perangkat dengan distributed forwarding, sebuah proses routing mengalami restart singkat. Entry forwarding lama masih berada di hardware untuk sesaat sebelum control plane selesai membangun ulang state. Pernyataan mana yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Forwarding yang menggunakan state lama dapat tetap berlangsung sementara, tetapi perubahan topology baru mungkin tidak dapat diproses dengan benar sampai control plane pulih
opsi_b: Semua paket langsung harus dikirim melalui proses routing yang sedang restart
opsi_c: Data plane secara otomatis menjalankan OSPF sendiri selama CPU restart
opsi_d: RIB dan FIB selalu merupakan tabel yang identik dan tidak pernah memiliki perbedaan waktu pembaruan
pembahasan: Pemisahan plane memungkinkan data plane memakai informasi forwarding yang sudah diprogram untuk sementara. Namun control plane tetap dibutuhkan untuk mempelajari perubahan dan memperbarui state, sehingga kondisi tersebut tidak berarti data plane sepenuhnya independen.

pertanyaan: On a device with distributed forwarding, a routing process briefly restarts. The old forwarding entries remain in hardware for a short period before the control plane finishes rebuilding state. Which statement is most accurate?
opsi_a: Forwarding using the existing state may temporarily continue, but new topology changes may not be handled correctly until the control plane recovers
opsi_b: All packets must immediately be sent through the routing process while it is restarting
opsi_c: The data plane automatically runs OSPF by itself while the CPU restarts
opsi_d: The RIB and FIB are always identical tables and can never differ in update timing
pembahasan: Plane separation can allow the data plane to use already-programmed forwarding information temporarily. The control plane is still required to learn changes and update state, so this does not make the data plane completely independent.

pertanyaan:
Perhatikan output ilustratif berikut.
[output]
R1# show ip route 10.50.0.0
Routing entry for 10.50.0.0/24
  * 192.168.12.2, via GigabitEthernet0/1

R1# show adjacency GigabitEthernet0/1 192.168.1detail
Protocol Interface                 Address
IP       GigabitEthernet0/1        192.168.12.2
                                 incomplete
[/output]
Apa diagnosis paling tepat?
opsi_a: R1 sama sekali tidak mengetahui route Layer 3 ke 10.50.0.0/24
opsi_b: Keputusan routing tersedia, tetapi informasi Layer 2 untuk next hop belum selesai sehingga forwarding dapat terganggu sampai adjacency terselesaikan
opsi_c: OSPF pasti salah memilih router ID
opsi_d: Destination 10.50.0.0/24 merupakan local address milik R1
pembahasan: Output routing menunjukkan keputusan Layer 3 menuju prefix tersebut sudah ada. Namun adjacency next hop masih incomplete, sehingga perangkat belum memiliki seluruh informasi encapsulation Layer 2 yang dibutuhkan untuk forwarding normal melalui Ethernet.

pertanyaan:
Consider the following simplified illustrative output.
[output]
R1# show ip route 10.50.0.0
Routing entry for 10.50.0.0/24
  * 192.168.12.2, via GigabitEthernet0/1

R1# show adjacency GigabitEthernet0/1 192.168.1detail
Protocol Interface                 Address
IP       GigabitEthernet0/1        192.168.12.2
                                 incomplete
[/output]
What is the most accurate diagnosis?
opsi_a: R1 has no Layer 3 route to 10.50.0.0/24 at all
opsi_b: The routing decision exists, but Layer 2 information for the next hop is incomplete, so forwarding may be affected until the adjacency is resolved
opsi_c: OSPF must have selected the wrong router ID
opsi_d: 10.50.0.0/24 is a local address owned by R1
pembahasan: The routing output shows that a Layer 3 decision to the prefix already exists. However, the next-hop adjacency is incomplete, so the device does not yet have all Layer 2 encapsulation information required for normal Ethernet forwarding.

pertanyaan: Seorang engineer melihat route ke 172.16.50.0/24 pada show ip route, tetapi ingin memastikan apa yang benar-benar digunakan data plane untuk packet menuju 172.16.50.10 dan apakah next-hop adjacency tersedia. Langkah verifikasi mana yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Hanya memeriksa running-config routing protocol karena itu pasti sama dengan forwarding state
opsi_b: Menghapus routing process lalu mengujinya kembali
opsi_c: Hanya menjalankan ping ke IP interface lokal router
opsi_d: Memeriksa CEF/FIB untuk 172.16.50.10 dan, jika diperlukan, adjacency/neighbor resolution untuk next hop
pembahasan: Keberadaan route pada RIB belum menjawab seluruh pertanyaan tentang forwarding state yang digunakan data plane. Memeriksa CEF/FIB dan informasi adjacency memungkinkan engineer membedakan keputusan routing dari kesiapan forwarding menuju next hop.

pertanyaan: An engineer sees a route to 172.16.50.0/24 in show ip route but wants to verify what the data plane will actually use for a packet to 172.16.50.10 and whether the next-hop adjacency is available. Which verification step is most appropriate?
opsi_a: Only inspect the routing-protocol running configuration because it must be identical to forwarding state
opsi_b: Remove the routing process and test again
opsi_c: Only ping the router's own local interface IP
opsi_d: Inspect CEF/FIB for 172.16.50.10 and, if necessary, verify adjacency or neighbor resolution for the next hop
pembahasan: A route being present in the RIB does not by itself answer every question about the data-plane forwarding state. Checking CEF/FIB and adjacency information allows the engineer to distinguish the routing decision from forwarding readiness toward the next hop.

pertanyaan: Manakah deskripsi yang paling tepat tentang process switching pada forwarding Layer 3?
opsi_a: Setiap paket selalu diteruskan berdasarkan MAC address table tanpa CPU
opsi_b: Setiap paket yang menggunakan path ini diproses oleh CPU dan keputusan forwarding dibuat di software
opsi_c: Hanya paket pertama yang diproses CPU lalu semua paket berikutnya memakai FIB
opsi_d: CPU hanya memproses paket broadcast, sedangkan unicast selalu memakai fast-switching cache
pembahasan: Process switching memproses paket satu per satu melalui CPU dan melakukan keputusan forwarding di software. Opsi lain mencampur mekanisme Layer 2, fast switching, atau CEF.

pertanyaan: Which statement best describes process switching for Layer 3 forwarding?
opsi_a: Every packet is always forwarded using the MAC address table without the CPU
opsi_b: Each packet using this path is handled by the CPU and the forwarding decision is made in software
opsi_c: Only the first packet is handled by the CPU and all later packets use the FIB
opsi_d: The CPU handles only broadcast packets while unicast always uses the fast-switching cache
pembahasan: Process switching handles packets individually through the CPU and makes the forwarding decision in software. The other choices describe Layer 2 switching, fast switching, or CEF.

pertanyaan: Ketika router melakukan process switching terhadap frame Ethernet yang akan dirutekan, apa yang dilakukan terhadap header Layer 2 yang masuk?
opsi_a: Header Layer 2 dipertahankan utuh sampai destination akhir
opsi_b: Hanya destination MAC yang dihapus, sedangkan source MAC tetap
opsi_c: Header Layer 2 dikonversi langsung menjadi entry FIB
opsi_d: Header Layer 2 lama dilepas dan header Layer 2 baru dibuat untuk link keluar
pembahasan: Router merutekan berdasarkan destination IP, sehingga encapsulation Layer 2 pada link masuk tidak diteruskan apa adanya. Router membuat header Layer 2 baru yang sesuai dengan next hop dan interface keluar.

pertanyaan: When a router process-switches an Ethernet frame that must be routed, what happens to the incoming Layer 2 header?
opsi_a: The Layer 2 header is preserved unchanged until the final destination
opsi_b: Only the destination MAC is removed while the source MAC remains
opsi_c: The Layer 2 header is directly converted into a FIB entry
opsi_d: The old Layer 2 header is removed and a new Layer 2 header is built for the outgoing link
pembahasan: A router routes based on the destination IP, so the incoming Layer 2 encapsulation is not forwarded unchanged. It builds a new Layer 2 header appropriate for the next hop and outgoing interface.

pertanyaan: Tiga paket berturut-turut menuju prefix yang sama semuanya menggunakan process switching. Apa konsekuensi utamanya?
opsi_a: CPU melakukan keputusan forwarding untuk ketiga paket tersebut
opsi_b: Hanya paket pertama yang memerlukan route lookup, dua sisanya otomatis memakai cache
opsi_c: Ketiga paket hanya diperiksa oleh ASIC dan tidak menyentuh CPU
opsi_d: Router mengubah destination IP agar sesuai dengan next hop
pembahasan: Dalam process switching, setiap paket yang menggunakan switching path tersebut diproses oleh CPU secara individual. Tidak ada fast-switching cache atau CEF lookup yang menggantikan proses CPU untuk paket-paket itu.

pertanyaan: Three consecutive packets to the same prefix are all using process switching. What is the main consequence?
opsi_a: The CPU makes a forwarding decision for all three packets
opsi_b: Only the first packet needs a route lookup and the next two automatically use a cache
opsi_c: All three packets are handled only by an ASIC and never reach the CPU
opsi_d: The router changes the destination IP to match the next hop
pembahasan: With process switching, each packet using that switching path is handled individually by the CPU. A fast-switching cache or CEF lookup does not replace the CPU processing for those packets.

pertanyaan: Pada router dengan trafik transit tinggi, apa dampak paling mungkin jika banyak paket dipaksa menggunakan process switching?
opsi_a: MAC address table menjadi penuh lebih cepat
opsi_b: Routing protocol otomatis berubah menjadi static routing
opsi_c: CPU utilization meningkat dan throughput forwarding dapat menurun
opsi_d: Semua interface Layer 2 otomatis menjadi routed port
pembahasan: Process switching membebani CPU karena paket transit ditangani satu per satu oleh software. Pada trafik tinggi, hal ini dapat meningkatkan CPU utilization dan menurunkan kemampuan forwarding.

pertanyaan: On a router carrying heavy transit traffic, what is the most likely effect if many packets are forced to use process switching?
opsi_a: The MAC address table fills more quickly
opsi_b: The routing protocol automatically changes to static routing
opsi_c: CPU utilization increases and forwarding throughput can decrease
opsi_d: All Layer 2 interfaces automatically become routed ports
pembahasan: Process switching consumes CPU resources because transit packets are handled individually in software. Under heavy traffic, this can raise CPU utilization and reduce forwarding capacity.

pertanyaan: Router menerima paket IPv4 transit melalui process switching. Selain menentukan route keluar, operasi mana yang normal dilakukan sebelum frame baru dikirim?
opsi_a: Mengurangi TTL dan menyesuaikan IPv4 header checksum
opsi_b: Mengubah source IP menjadi alamat interface keluar tanpa NAT
opsi_c: Menghapus destination IP karena forwarding berikutnya memakai MAC saja
opsi_d: Mengganti routing protocol dengan ARP untuk memilih route
pembahasan: Router mengurangi TTL pada setiap hop Layer 3 dan memperbarui IPv4 header checksum sebelum meneruskan paket. Source dan destination IP tidak berubah hanya karena routing biasa; NAT adalah fungsi terpisah.

pertanyaan: A router receives a transit IPv4 packet through process switching. Besides choosing the outgoing route, which operation is normally performed before the new frame is sent?
opsi_a: Decrement the TTL and adjust the IPv4 header checksum
opsi_b: Change the source IP to the outgoing interface address without NAT
opsi_c: Remove the destination IP because later forwarding uses only MAC addresses
opsi_d: Replace the routing protocol with ARP to choose the route
pembahasan: A router decrements TTL at each Layer 3 hop and updates the IPv4 header checksum before forwarding the packet. Source and destination IP addresses do not change merely because of normal routing; NAT is separate.

pertanyaan: R1 menerima frame dari PC dan meneruskannya ke R2 dengan process switching. Manakah perubahan header yang paling tepat jika tidak ada NAT?
opsi_a: Source MAC dan destination MAC tetap; source IP berubah
opsi_b: Source MAC tetap milik PC; destination MAC menjadi MAC server
opsi_c: Semua alamat Layer 2 dan Layer 3 berubah di R1
opsi_d: MAC source/destination berubah sesuai link R1-R2, sedangkan source/destination IP tetap
pembahasan: Routing mengganti encapsulation Layer 2 pada setiap hop, sehingga MAC address pada frame keluar berbeda dari frame masuk. Alamat IP end-to-end tetap sama selama tidak ada NAT, meskipun TTL berkurang.

pertanyaan: R1 receives a frame from a PC and forwards it to R2 using process switching. Which header change is correct when NAT is not used?
opsi_a: The source and destination MAC remain the same while the source IP changes
opsi_b: The source MAC remains the PC MAC while the destination MAC becomes the server MAC
opsi_c: All Layer 2 and Layer 3 addresses change at R1
opsi_d: The source/destination MAC addresses change for the R1-R2 link while the source/destination IP addresses remain
pembahasan: Routing replaces the Layer 2 encapsulation at each hop, so the outgoing frame uses different MAC addresses from the incoming frame. End-to-end IP addresses remain the same without NAT, although TTL is decremented.

pertanyaan: Pada perangkat yang normalnya melakukan hardware forwarding, sebuah paket exception dipunt ke CPU. Pernyataan mana yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Semua trafik pada perangkat langsung berubah permanen menjadi process switching
opsi_b: Paket tersebut dapat diproses CPU tanpa berarti seluruh trafik transit memakai process switching
opsi_c: FIB otomatis dihapus agar CPU bisa menerima paket exception
opsi_d: MAC address table tidak lagi digunakan pada semua VLAN
pembahasan: Punt atau exception processing dapat membuat paket tertentu ditangani CPU, tetapi itu tidak berarti seluruh forwarding perangkat berpindah ke process switching. Trafik normal lain tetap dapat menggunakan CEF atau hardware forwarding.

pertanyaan: On a device that normally performs hardware forwarding, an exception packet is punted to the CPU. Which statement is most accurate?
opsi_a: All traffic on the device permanently changes to process switching
opsi_b: That packet can be CPU-processed without meaning all transit traffic uses process switching
opsi_c: The FIB is automatically deleted so the CPU can receive the exception packet
opsi_d: The MAC address table is no longer used on any VLAN
pembahasan: Punt or exception processing can cause a specific packet to be handled by the CPU without changing the forwarding path for all traffic. Other normal traffic can continue to use CEF or hardware forwarding.

pertanyaan: R1 memiliki route valid menuju 10.10.10.0/24. Dua skenario dibandingkan: Skenario X memakai process switching, Skenario Y memakai CEF dengan FIB dan adjacency lengkap. Apa perbedaan utama?
opsi_a: Pada X route tidak diperlukan, sedangkan Y wajib memiliki route
opsi_b: Pada X Layer 2 header tidak perlu di-rewrite, sedangkan Y perlu
opsi_c: Pada X CPU membuat keputusan per paket; pada Y tabel forwarding yang sudah dibangun digunakan untuk meneruskan paket
opsi_d: Pada X destination IP berubah menjadi next-hop IP; pada Y tidak
pembahasan: Keduanya tetap membutuhkan informasi routing, tetapi cara meneruskannya berbeda. Process switching melibatkan CPU per paket, sedangkan CEF memakai FIB dan adjacency yang sudah tersedia untuk forwarding.

pertanyaan: R1 has a valid route to 10.10.10.0/24. Two scenarios are compared: Scenario X uses process switching, and Scenario Y uses CEF with complete FIB and adjacency information. What is the key difference?
opsi_a: X does not require a route, while Y must have one
opsi_b: X does not need Layer 2 rewriting, while Y does
opsi_c: In X the CPU makes the decision per packet; in Y prebuilt forwarding tables are used to forward the packet
opsi_d: In X the destination IP changes to the next-hop IP, while in Y it does not
pembahasan: Both scenarios still need routing information, but they use it differently. Process switching involves the CPU per packet, whereas CEF uses already built FIB and adjacency information for forwarding.

pertanyaan: Manakah deskripsi paling tepat tentang fast switching?
opsi_a: Paket pertama untuk destination yang belum ada di cache membantu membentuk fast-switching cache; paket berikutnya menggunakan cache tersebut
opsi_b: Setiap paket selalu melakukan lookup penuh ke routing table melalui CPU
opsi_c: FIB dan adjacency harus sudah lengkap sebelum paket pertama datang
opsi_d: Fast switching hanya digunakan untuk frame Layer 2 dalam VLAN yang sama
pembahasan: Fast switching menggunakan route cache yang dibentuk berdasarkan trafik. Paket berikutnya menuju destination yang cocok dapat memakai cache sehingga tidak perlu mengulang proses CPU yang sama.

pertanyaan: Which statement best describes fast switching?
opsi_a: The first packet for a destination not yet in the cache helps build the fast-switching cache; later packets use that cache
opsi_b: Every packet always performs a full routing-table lookup through the CPU
opsi_c: The FIB and adjacency must already be complete before the first packet arrives
opsi_d: Fast switching is used only for Layer 2 frames within the same VLAN
pembahasan: Fast switching uses a route cache that is built based on traffic. Later packets to a matching destination can use the cache instead of repeating the same CPU processing.

pertanyaan: Pada fast switching, paket pertama menuju destination yang belum memiliki cache entry biasanya bagaimana?
opsi_a: Langsung dibuang karena belum ada FIB
opsi_b: Diproses melalui process level untuk menentukan forwarding lalu membantu membuat cache entry
opsi_c: Diteruskan hanya berdasarkan MAC address table tanpa routing lookup
opsi_d: Menunggu paket kedua agar cache dapat dibuat
pembahasan: Cache miss menyebabkan paket pertama diproses pada process level untuk menentukan jalur forwarding dan membuat cache. Setelah entry tersedia, paket berikutnya dapat menggunakan fast switching.

pertanyaan: In fast switching, how is the first packet to a destination with no cache entry typically handled?
opsi_a: It is immediately dropped because there is no FIB
opsi_b: It is handled at the process level to determine forwarding and then helps create a cache entry
opsi_c: It is forwarded only by the MAC address table without a routing lookup
opsi_d: It waits for a second packet before a cache can be created
pembahasan: A cache miss causes the first packet to be handled at the process level to determine the forwarding path and build the cache. Once the entry exists, later packets can be fast switched.

pertanyaan: Informasi apa yang paling relevan disimpan pada fast-switching cache?
opsi_a: Hanya hostname tujuan dan DNS server
opsi_b: Hanya source IP dari paket pertama
opsi_c: Seluruh routing table beserta semua neighbor protocol
opsi_d: Informasi forwarding untuk destination, termasuk outgoing path dan rewrite Layer 2 yang diperlukan
pembahasan: Fast-switching cache menyimpan hasil keputusan forwarding untuk destination yang telah digunakan. Ini memungkinkan paket berikutnya memakai outgoing path dan informasi rewrite tanpa full process-level lookup.

pertanyaan: What information is most relevant in a fast-switching cache?
opsi_a: Only the destination hostname and DNS server
opsi_b: Only the source IP of the first packet
opsi_c: The entire routing table and all protocol neighbors
opsi_d: Forwarding information for a destination, including the outgoing path and required Layer 2 rewrite
pembahasan: The fast-switching cache stores the result of a forwarding decision for destinations that have been used. This lets later packets reuse the outgoing path and rewrite information without a full process-level lookup.

pertanyaan: R1 sudah memiliki fast-switching cache untuk destination A. Paket baru datang menuju destination A dengan kondisi cache masih valid. Apa yang terjadi?
opsi_a: CPU wajib melakukan full routing lookup lagi
opsi_b: Router menghapus cache sebelum meneruskan paket
opsi_c: Paket dapat diteruskan menggunakan cache yang sudah ada
opsi_d: Paket harus menunggu ARP baru walaupun rewrite information sudah valid
pembahasan: Fast switching memperoleh keuntungan ketika paket berikutnya cocok dengan cache entry yang valid. Full process-level route lookup tidak perlu diulang untuk setiap paket tersebut.

pertanyaan: R1 already has a fast-switching cache entry for destination A. A new packet arrives for destination A while the cache entry is still valid. What happens?
opsi_a: The CPU must perform a full routing lookup again
opsi_b: The router deletes the cache before forwarding the packet
opsi_c: The packet can be forwarded using the existing cache
opsi_d: The packet must wait for a new ARP exchange even though the rewrite information is valid
pembahasan: Fast switching gains its advantage when later packets match a valid cache entry. A full process-level route lookup does not have to be repeated for each such packet.

pertanyaan: R1 memiliki cache untuk 10.10.10.10, lalu menerima paket ke destination baru 10.20.20.20 yang belum memiliki cache entry. Apa yang paling mungkin terjadi pada mekanisme fast switching klasik?
opsi_a: Cache 10.10.10.10 dipakai karena semua unicast memakai entry yang sama
opsi_b: Paket destination baru mengalami cache miss dan diproses untuk membentuk entry yang sesuai
opsi_c: Destination IP diubah menjadi 10.10.10.10 agar cache dapat digunakan
opsi_d: Semua cache langsung dihapus dan interface shutdown
pembahasan: Fast-switching cache digunakan hanya jika ada entry yang sesuai dengan destination. Destination baru yang belum ada di cache menyebabkan cache miss dan memerlukan process-level handling untuk membentuk informasi forwarding baru.

pertanyaan: R1 has a cache entry for 10.10.10.10 and then receives a packet for a new destination, 10.20.20.20, that has no cache entry. What most likely happens with classic fast switching?
opsi_a: The 10.10.10.10 cache entry is reused because all unicast traffic uses one entry
opsi_b: The new destination causes a cache miss and is processed to build an appropriate entry
opsi_c: The destination IP is changed to 10.10.10.10 so the cache can be used
opsi_d: All cache entries are immediately deleted and the interface shuts down
pembahasan: A fast-switching cache can be used only when a matching destination entry exists. A new destination without an entry causes a cache miss and requires process-level handling to build new forwarding information.

pertanyaan: Fast-switching cache menunjukkan next hop lama, tetapi routing topology baru saja berubah. Mengapa mekanisme cache harus menjaga sinkronisasi dengan perubahan routing?
opsi_a: Agar paket tidak terus menggunakan forwarding information yang sudah tidak sesuai dengan route terbaru
opsi_b: Agar ARP dapat menggantikan fungsi routing protocol sepenuhnya
opsi_c: Agar source IP setiap paket dapat diubah mengikuti next hop baru
opsi_d: Agar MAC address table Layer 2 dapat menentukan prefix terbaik
pembahasan: Route cache berisi hasil keputusan forwarding sebelumnya, sehingga perubahan topology dapat membuat entry lama tidak lagi tepat. Cache perlu diinvalidate atau diperbarui agar forwarding mengikuti informasi routing terbaru.

pertanyaan: The fast-switching cache points to an old next hop, but the routing topology has just changed. Why must the cache remain synchronized with routing changes?
opsi_a: So packets do not keep using forwarding information that no longer matches the current route
opsi_b: So ARP can completely replace the routing protocol
opsi_c: So each packet's source IP can be changed to the new next hop
opsi_d: So the Layer 2 MAC address table can choose the best prefix
pembahasan: A route cache contains the result of earlier forwarding decisions, so a topology change can make an old entry inappropriate. The cache must be invalidated or refreshed so forwarding follows the current routing information.

pertanyaan: Pada implementasi fast switching klasik, route cache juga memengaruhi load sharing. Karakteristik mana yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Selalu per-packet sehingga paket berurutan pasti berganti jalur
opsi_b: Selalu berdasarkan source MAC dan VLAN saja
opsi_c: Umumnya per-destination sehingga trafik ke destination yang sama cenderung memakai switching path yang sama
opsi_d: Load sharing tidak mungkin dilakukan jika fast switching aktif
pembahasan: Cisco mendokumentasikan fast-switching route cache sebagai mekanisme yang dapat melakukan load sharing per-destination. Karena itu destination yang sama cenderung menggunakan path cache yang sama, bukan berganti jalur untuk setiap paket.

pertanyaan: In classic fast switching, the route cache also affects load sharing. Which characteristic is most accurate?
opsi_a: It is always per-packet, so consecutive packets must alternate paths
opsi_b: It is always based only on source MAC and VLAN
opsi_c: It is generally per-destination, so traffic to the same destination tends to use the same switching path
opsi_d: Load sharing is impossible when fast switching is enabled
pembahasan: Cisco documents the fast-switching route cache as supporting per-destination load sharing. Therefore, traffic to the same destination tends to use the same cached path rather than alternating for every packet.

pertanyaan: Perbedaan utama antara fast switching dan CEF dalam hal pembentukan informasi forwarding adalah apa?
opsi_a: Fast switching membangun seluruh FIB sebelum ada trafik, sedangkan CEF tidak
opsi_b: Keduanya hanya membuat informasi setelah paket pertama diterima
opsi_c: CEF bergantung pada fast-switching cache untuk semua route
opsi_d: Fast switching bersifat demand-cache berdasarkan trafik, sedangkan CEF membangun forwarding information berdasarkan topology
pembahasan: Fast switching membuat cache saat destination mulai digunakan oleh trafik. CEF bersifat topology-based dan membangun FIB/adjacency dari state control plane tanpa harus menunggu paket pertama untuk setiap destination.

pertanyaan: What is the main difference between fast switching and CEF in how forwarding information is built?
opsi_a: Fast switching builds the entire FIB before traffic exists, while CEF does not
opsi_b: Both build forwarding information only after the first packet arrives
opsi_c: CEF depends on the fast-switching cache for all routes
opsi_d: Fast switching is demand-cache based on traffic, while CEF builds forwarding information from the topology
pembahasan: Fast switching creates cache entries as destinations are used by traffic. CEF is topology-based and builds FIB/adjacency information from control-plane state without waiting for the first packet to each destination.

pertanyaan: Pada banyak IOS release yang lebih baru, IPv4 fast switching klasik sudah dihapus. Jika sebuah komponen tidak dapat menggunakan CEF pada release tersebut, switching path apa yang tersisa menurut dokumentasi Cisco?
opsi_a: Process switching
opsi_b: Fast switching tetap wajib digunakan
opsi_c: Layer 2 cut-through switching
opsi_d: CEF distributed selalu otomatis aktif walaupun tidak didukung
pembahasan: Cisco mencatat bahwa pada release tertentu setelah penghapusan IPv4 fast switching, path IPv4 yang tersedia adalah CEF atau process switching. Jadi komponen yang tidak mendukung CEF akan menggunakan process-switched mode, bukan fast switching klasik.

pertanyaan: On many newer IOS releases, classic IPv4 fast switching has been removed. If a component cannot use CEF on such a release, which switching path remains according to Cisco documentation?
opsi_a: Process switching
opsi_b: Fast switching must still be used
opsi_c: Layer 2 cut-through switching
opsi_d: Distributed CEF is always automatically enabled even when unsupported
pembahasan: Cisco notes that after IPv4 fast switching was removed in certain releases, the available IPv4 switching paths are CEF or process switching. Therefore, a component that cannot use CEF operates in process-switched mode rather than classic fast switching.

pertanyaan: CEF disebut topology-based switching. Apa maksudnya?
opsi_a: CEF hanya bekerja jika ada STP topology change
opsi_b: CEF membuat cache hanya setelah destination menerima trafik
opsi_c: Forwarding information dibangun dari informasi topology/routing sebelum harus menunggu trafik ke setiap destination
opsi_d: CEF hanya dapat digunakan pada topologi full-mesh
pembahasan: CEF membangun FIB dan adjacency dari informasi control plane, sehingga tidak perlu menunggu paket pertama menuju setiap destination. Ini berbeda dengan demand caching pada fast switching.

pertanyaan: CEF is called topology-based switching. What does this mean?
opsi_a: CEF works only after an STP topology change
opsi_b: CEF creates a cache only after a destination receives traffic
opsi_c: Forwarding information is built from topology/routing information without waiting for traffic to each destination
opsi_d: CEF can be used only in a full-mesh topology
pembahasan: CEF builds the FIB and adjacency information from control-plane state, so it does not need to wait for the first packet to each destination. This differs from demand caching in fast switching.

pertanyaan: Apa fungsi utama Forwarding Information Base (FIB) pada CEF?
opsi_a: Menyimpan username untuk akses manajemen
opsi_b: Menentukan forwarding prefix, next hop, dan outgoing interface
opsi_c: Menyimpan hanya MAC address host pada VLAN lokal
opsi_d: Mencatat semua paket yang pernah melewati CPU
pembahasan: FIB adalah struktur forwarding Layer 3 yang dioptimalkan dari informasi routing. FIB membantu menentukan prefix yang cocok, next hop, dan interface keluar; MAC rewrite ditangani oleh adjacency information.

pertanyaan: What is the primary role of the Forwarding Information Base (FIB) in CEF?
opsi_a: Store usernames for management access
opsi_b: Determine the forwarding prefix, next hop, and outgoing interface
opsi_c: Store only host MAC addresses on the local VLAN
opsi_d: Record every packet that has passed through the CPU
pembahasan: The FIB is an optimized Layer 3 forwarding structure derived from routing information. It helps determine the matching prefix, next hop, and outgoing interface; Layer 2 rewrite information is handled by adjacency data.

pertanyaan: Apa fungsi utama CEF adjacency table?
opsi_a: Memilih routing protocol dengan administrative distance terendah
opsi_b: Menyimpan seluruh BGP path attribute
opsi_c: Menggantikan routing table untuk longest prefix match
opsi_d: Menyediakan informasi Layer 2 yang diperlukan untuk meneruskan paket ke adjacency/next hop
pembahasan: Adjacency table melengkapi FIB dengan informasi link-layer seperti rewrite encapsulation dan MAC address next hop pada media Ethernet. Pemilihan prefix Layer 3 tetap merupakan fungsi FIB.

pertanyaan: What is the primary role of the CEF adjacency table?
opsi_a: Choose the routing protocol with the lowest administrative distance
opsi_b: Store all BGP path attributes
opsi_c: Replace the routing table for longest-prefix matching
opsi_d: Provide the Layer 2 information required to forward the packet to an adjacency/next hop
pembahasan: The adjacency table complements the FIB with link-layer information such as rewrite encapsulation and next-hop MAC address on Ethernet. Layer 3 prefix selection remains the role of the FIB.

pertanyaan: Pasangan command dan tabel yang ditampilkan manakah yang benar?
opsi_a:
[cli]
show ip cef
[/cli]
menampilkan MAC address table; 
[cli]
show adjacency
[/cli]
menampilkan RIB
opsi_b:
[cli]
show ip cef
[/cli]
menampilkan ARP cache; 
[cli]
show adjacency
[/cli]
menampilkan STP state
opsi_c:
[cli]
show ip cef
[/cli]
digunakan untuk melihat FIB; 
[cli]
show adjacency
[/cli]
digunakan untuk melihat CEF adjacency table
opsi_d: Kedua command hanya menampilkan fast-switching cache
pembahasan:
[cli]
show ip cef
[/cli]
berhubungan dengan FIB, sedangkan 
[cli]
show adjacency
[/cli]
menampilkan informasi adjacency CEF. Keduanya saling melengkapi dalam forwarding CEF, tetapi bukan MAC table Layer 2 atau RIB.

pertanyaan: Which command-to-table mapping is correct?
opsi_a:
[cli]
show ip cef
[/cli]
displays the MAC address table; 
[cli]
show adjacency
[/cli]
displays the RIB
opsi_b:
[cli]
show ip cef
[/cli]
displays the ARP cache; 
[cli]
show adjacency
[/cli]
displays STP state
opsi_c:
[cli]
show ip cef
[/cli]
is used to view the FIB; 
[cli]
show adjacency
[/cli]
is used to view the CEF adjacency table
opsi_d: Both commands display only the fast-switching cache
pembahasan:
[cli]
show ip cef
[/cli]
is associated with the FIB, while 
[cli]
show adjacency
[/cli]
displays CEF adjacency information. They complement each other for CEF forwarding but are not the Layer 2 MAC table or the RIB.

pertanyaan: Hubungan mana yang paling tepat untuk pembentukan informasi CEF pada IPv4 Ethernet?
opsi_a: Routing information membantu membentuk FIB, sedangkan ARP membantu membentuk adjacency Layer 2
opsi_b: ARP membentuk seluruh FIB, sedangkan OSPF hanya membentuk MAC address table
opsi_c: FIB dibentuk dari STP, sedangkan adjacency dibentuk dari BGP community
opsi_d: MAC address table menggantikan FIB untuk semua trafik inter-VLAN
pembahasan: Secara konseptual, route yang dipilih control plane menjadi dasar FIB, sedangkan resolusi neighbor seperti ARP menyediakan informasi Layer 2 untuk adjacency. Keduanya kemudian digunakan bersama dalam forwarding CEF.

pertanyaan: Which relationship best describes how CEF information is built on IPv4 Ethernet?
opsi_a: Routing information helps build the FIB, while ARP helps build the Layer 2 adjacency
opsi_b: ARP builds the entire FIB, while OSPF only builds the MAC address table
opsi_c: The FIB is built from STP, while adjacency is built from BGP communities
opsi_d: The MAC address table replaces the FIB for all inter-VLAN traffic
pembahasan: Conceptually, routes selected by the control plane form the basis of the FIB, while neighbor resolution such as ARP provides Layer 2 information for adjacency. The two are then used together for CEF forwarding.

pertanyaan: FIB R1 sudah menunjukkan 10.20.0.0/16 via 192.0.2.2 keluar Gi0/0, tetapi MAC untuk 192.0.2.2 belum ter-resolve. Kondisi apa yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Route pasti dihapus dari RIB
opsi_b: FIB dapat sudah memiliki path Layer 3, tetapi adjacency belum lengkap sehingga neighbor resolution masih diperlukan
opsi_c: CEF otomatis mengubah destination IP menjadi 192.0.2.2
opsi_d: Router akan menggunakan MAC address destination akhir di jaringan 10.20.0.0/16
pembahasan: CEF dapat mengetahui next hop dan interface dari FIB sebelum informasi Layer 2 next hop tersedia. Pada Ethernet, ARP perlu menyelesaikan adjacency agar rewrite Layer 2 dapat dilakukan secara normal.

pertanyaan: R1's FIB already shows 10.20.0.0/16 via 192.0.2.2 out Gi0/0, but the MAC address for 192.0.2.2 has not been resolved. Which condition is most accurate?
opsi_a: The route must be removed from the RIB
opsi_b: The FIB can already contain the Layer 3 path while the adjacency is incomplete, so neighbor resolution is still required
opsi_c: CEF automatically changes the destination IP to 192.0.2.2
opsi_d: The router will use the final destination's MAC address on the 10.20.0.0/16 network
pembahasan: CEF can know the next hop and outgoing interface from the FIB before Layer 2 next-hop information is available. On Ethernet, ARP must resolve the adjacency so the normal Layer 2 rewrite can be performed.

pertanyaan: Jika FIB dan adjacency sudah lengkap sebelum ada trafik menuju 203.0.113.10, bagaimana paket pertama normalnya diteruskan pada CEF?
opsi_a: Harus selalu process-switched agar FIB dibuat
opsi_b: Harus membuat fast-switching cache terlebih dahulu
opsi_c: Harus menunggu paket kedua agar adjacency valid
opsi_d: Dapat langsung menggunakan FIB dan adjacency tanpa demand-cache paket pertama
pembahasan: CEF tidak memerlukan paket pertama untuk membangun route cache. Jika FIB dan adjacency sudah valid, paket pertama maupun paket berikutnya dapat menggunakan forwarding information tersebut.

pertanyaan: If the FIB and adjacency are already complete before any traffic is sent to 203.0.113.10, how is the first packet normally forwarded with CEF?
opsi_a: It must always be process-switched so the FIB can be created
opsi_b: It must build a fast-switching cache first
opsi_c: It must wait for a second packet before the adjacency becomes valid
opsi_d: It can immediately use the FIB and adjacency without a first-packet demand cache
pembahasan: CEF does not require a first packet to build a route cache. If the FIB and adjacency are valid, the first packet and later packets can use that forwarding information.

pertanyaan: FIB memiliki 10.0.0.0/8 via Gi0/1, 10.10.0.0/16 via Gi0/2, dan 10.10.10.0/24 via Gi0/3. Paket menuju 10.10.10.50 akan memilih apa?
opsi_b: 10.10.0.0/16 via Gi0/2 karena dipelajari lebih dulu
opsi_c: 10.0.0.0/8 via Gi0/1 karena prefix-nya paling besar secara numerik
opsi_d: Ketiga jalur selalu digunakan bergantian per paket
pembahasan: CEF melakukan longest prefix match. Alamat 10.10.10.50 cocok dengan ketiga prefix, tetapi /24 adalah yang paling spesifik sehingga dipilih.

pertanyaan: The FIB contains 10.0.0.0/8 via Gi0/1, 10.10.0.0/16 via Gi0/2, and 10.10.10.0/24 via Gi0/3. Which entry is selected for a packet to 10.10.10.50?
opsi_b: 10.10.0.0/16 via Gi0/2 because it was learned first
opsi_c: 10.0.0.0/8 via Gi0/1 because its prefix value is numerically larger
opsi_d: All three paths are always alternated per packet
pembahasan: CEF uses longest-prefix matching. 10.10.10.50 matches all three prefixes, but /24 is the most specific and is therefore selected.

pertanyaan: PC-A 192.168.1.10 mengirim paket ke server 10.10.10.10 melalui R1 lalu R2. Tidak ada NAT. Saat R1 meneruskan paket dengan CEF ke R2, apa yang benar?
opsi_a: Destination IP berubah menjadi IP R2 dan destination MAC tetap milik R1
opsi_b: Source IP berubah menjadi IP interface keluar R1 dan MAC tetap end-to-end
opsi_c: Alamat MAC pada frame di-rewrite untuk link R1-R2, sedangkan source dan destination IP tetap end-to-end
opsi_d: CEF tidak melakukan Layer 2 rewrite karena FIB sudah memiliki next hop
pembahasan: CEF menggunakan adjacency untuk membuat encapsulation Layer 2 yang sesuai dengan link keluar. Routing biasa tidak mengganti source/destination IP end-to-end, meskipun TTL berubah dan MAC address diganti pada setiap routed hop.

pertanyaan: PC-A 192.168.1.10 sends a packet to server 10.10.10.10 through R1 and then R2. NAT is not used. When R1 forwards the packet to R2 with CEF, which statement is correct?
opsi_a: The destination IP changes to R2's IP and the destination MAC remains R1's MAC
opsi_b: The source IP changes to R1's outgoing-interface IP and MAC addresses remain end-to-end
opsi_c: The frame's MAC addresses are rewritten for the R1-R2 link while the source and destination IP addresses remain end-to-end
opsi_d: CEF does not perform a Layer 2 rewrite because the FIB already contains the next hop
pembahasan: CEF uses adjacency information to build the Layer 2 encapsulation for the outgoing link. Normal routing does not replace the end-to-end source or destination IP, although TTL changes and MAC addresses are rewritten at each routed hop.

pertanyaan: Manakah pernyataan yang paling tepat tentang central CEF dan distributed CEF (dCEF)?
opsi_a: Central CEF tidak memiliki FIB, sedangkan dCEF hanya memiliki ARP table
opsi_b: dCEF berarti semua paket harus dikirim ke route processor sebelum forwarding
opsi_c: Central CEF hanya untuk Layer 2 switching, sedangkan dCEF hanya untuk NAT
opsi_d: Pada central CEF, FIB/adjacency berada pada route processor; pada dCEF, line card dapat memiliki copy untuk melakukan forwarding secara lokal
pembahasan: Perbedaan utamanya adalah lokasi forwarding information dan siapa yang melakukan lookup. dCEF memungkinkan line card melakukan forwarding dengan copy FIB/adjacency sendiri sehingga mengurangi ketergantungan pada central route processor.

pertanyaan: Which statement best describes central CEF versus distributed CEF (dCEF)?
opsi_a: Central CEF has no FIB, while dCEF has only an ARP table
opsi_b: dCEF means every packet must be sent to the route processor before forwarding
opsi_c: Central CEF is only for Layer 2 switching, while dCEF is only for NAT
opsi_d: With central CEF, the FIB/adjacency reside on the route processor; with dCEF, line cards can maintain copies and forward locally
pembahasan: The main difference is where forwarding information resides and where lookup occurs. dCEF lets line cards forward using their own FIB/adjacency copies, reducing dependence on the central route processor.

pertanyaan: Slide menyatakan hardware forwarding tables dibangun oleh CPU. Interpretasi mana yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: CPU harus meneruskan setiap paket meskipun hardware table tersedia
opsi_b: Control plane membangun dan memperbarui forwarding state, lalu data plane/hardware menggunakannya untuk paket normal
opsi_c: ASIC mempelajari OSPF neighbor tanpa bantuan control plane
opsi_d: FIB hanya dibuat setelah setiap paket selesai dikirim
pembahasan: CPU/control plane bertanggung jawab membangun state routing dan forwarding, sedangkan hardware dapat melakukan lookup untuk trafik transit normal. Karena itu 'dibangun CPU' tidak berarti setiap paket harus diproses CPU.

pertanyaan: A slide states that hardware forwarding tables are built by the CPU. Which interpretation is most accurate?
opsi_a: The CPU must forward every packet even when hardware tables are available
opsi_b: The control plane builds and updates forwarding state, then the data plane/hardware uses it for normal packets
opsi_c: An ASIC learns OSPF neighbors without control-plane involvement
opsi_d: The FIB is created only after each packet has been transmitted
pembahasan: The CPU/control plane is responsible for building routing and forwarding state, while hardware can perform lookups for normal transit traffic. Therefore, 'built by the CPU' does not mean every packet must be CPU-processed.

pertanyaan: Pada multilayer switch, PC1 dan PC2 berada di VLAN 10 yang sama. PC1 mengirim frame unicast ke PC2 dan destination MAC sudah ada di MAC table. Mekanisme utama yang digunakan untuk forwarding frame itu apa?
opsi_a: Layer 2 switching menggunakan MAC address table, bukan CEF Layer 3 lookup
opsi_b: CEF FIB harus digunakan karena semua paket IP selalu dirutekan
opsi_c: Process switching wajib karena destination IP ada di subnet lokal
opsi_d: Fast-switching cache menentukan access port tujuan
pembahasan: Frame yang tetap berada dalam VLAN yang sama diteruskan pada Layer 2 berdasarkan MAC address table. CEF relevan ketika perangkat melakukan forwarding Layer 3, misalnya inter-VLAN routing atau routed port.

pertanyaan: On a multilayer switch, PC1 and PC2 are in the same VLAN 10. PC1 sends a unicast frame to PC2 and the destination MAC is already in the MAC table. What is the primary forwarding mechanism?
opsi_a: Layer 2 switching using the MAC address table, not a CEF Layer 3 lookup
opsi_b: CEF FIB must be used because every IP packet is always routed
opsi_c: Process switching is required because the destination IP is in the local subnet
opsi_d: The fast-switching cache determines the destination access port
pembahasan: A frame that remains within the same VLAN is forwarded at Layer 2 using the MAC address table. CEF is relevant when the device performs Layer 3 forwarding, such as inter-VLAN routing or routed-port forwarding.

pertanyaan: Jaringan memiliki beberapa hop ECMP dan setiap perangkat menggunakan hashing CEF yang menghasilkan pilihan jalur yang berkorelasi. Apa risiko yang disebut CEF polarization?
opsi_a: Semua route hilang dari RIB saat ECMP aktif
opsi_b: ARP tidak dapat bekerja pada link ECMP
opsi_c: Sebagian link dapat terus terpilih secara tidak seimbang sementara link equal-cost lain kurang digunakan
opsi_d: Setiap paket pasti mengalami TTL expired
pembahasan: CEF polarization dapat menyebabkan keputusan hash pada beberapa hop mengarahkan banyak flow ke subset path yang sama. Akibatnya, distribusi trafik kurang merata meskipun secara teori tersedia beberapa equal-cost path.

pertanyaan: A network has multiple ECMP hops and each device uses CEF hashing that produces correlated path choices. What risk is referred to as CEF polarization?
opsi_a: All routes disappear from the RIB when ECMP is active
opsi_b: ARP cannot operate on ECMP links
opsi_c: Some links can be repeatedly selected while other equal-cost links are underused
opsi_d: Every packet necessarily expires its TTL
pembahasan: CEF polarization can occur when hashing decisions across multiple hops steer many flows onto the same subset of paths. The result is uneven traffic distribution even though multiple equal-cost paths are available.

pertanyaan: Mengapa per-flow load balancing sering lebih disukai daripada mengganti jalur untuk setiap paket pada beberapa equal-cost path dengan latency berbeda?
opsi_a: Karena per-flow selalu menggunakan CPU sedangkan per-packet selalu hardware
opsi_b: Karena menjaga paket dalam flow yang sama pada path konsisten dapat mengurangi risiko packet reordering
opsi_c: Karena per-flow mengubah destination IP agar sama
opsi_d: Karena per-packet tidak dapat digunakan pada jaringan IP
pembahasan: Jika paket dari flow yang sama melewati path dengan latency berbeda, paket dapat tiba tidak berurutan. Menjaga flow pada path yang konsisten membantu mempertahankan ordering, walaupun detail hashing bergantung pada platform.

pertanyaan: Why is per-flow load balancing often preferred over alternating every packet across equal-cost paths with different latencies?
opsi_a: Because per-flow always uses the CPU while per-packet always uses hardware
opsi_b: Because keeping packets from the same flow on a consistent path can reduce packet-reordering risk
opsi_c: Because per-flow changes the destination IP to make it identical
opsi_d: Because per-packet forwarding cannot be used in IP networks
pembahasan: If packets from the same flow traverse paths with different delays, they can arrive out of order. Keeping a flow on a consistent path helps preserve ordering, although exact hashing behavior is platform-dependent.

pertanyaan: CEF aktif dan mayoritas trafik transit berjalan normal di hardware. Sebuah paket menuju IP router sendiri diterima. Kesimpulan apa yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Karena CEF aktif, paket tidak boleh pernah mencapai CPU
opsi_b: Router harus menghapus adjacency sebelum menerima paket tersebut
opsi_c: Semua trafik lain ikut berubah menjadi process switching
opsi_d: Paket yang ditujukan ke perangkat sendiri dapat diproses oleh CPU sebagai control-plane traffic tanpa menonaktifkan CEF untuk trafik transit lain
pembahasan: CEF mempercepat forwarding transit, tetapi paket yang ditujukan ke perangkat sendiri adalah traffic lokal/control plane dan dapat diproses CPU. Hal ini tidak berarti CEF gagal atau seluruh forwarding berubah menjadi process switching.

pertanyaan: CEF is enabled and most transit traffic is being hardware-forwarded normally. A packet destined to the router's own IP address arrives. Which conclusion is most accurate?
opsi_a: Because CEF is enabled, the packet must never reach the CPU
opsi_b: The router must delete the adjacency before receiving the packet
opsi_c: All other traffic also changes to process switching
opsi_d: A packet destined to the device itself can be handled by the CPU as control-plane traffic without disabling CEF for other transit traffic
pembahasan: CEF accelerates transit forwarding, but traffic addressed to the device itself is local/control-plane traffic and can be CPU-processed. This does not mean CEF has failed or that all forwarding has changed to process switching.

pertanyaan: Command mana yang paling langsung digunakan untuk melihat IPv4 Forwarding Information Base pada Cisco IOS/IOS XE yang mendukungnya?
opsi_a:
[cli]
show ip route
[/cli]
opsi_b:
[cli]
show mac address-table
[/cli]
opsi_c:
[cli]
show ip cef
[/cli]
opsi_d:
[cli]
show spanning-tree
[/cli]
pembahasan:
[cli]
show ip cef
[/cli]
digunakan untuk melihat entry IPv4 CEF/FIB. 
[cli]
show ip route
[/cli]
menampilkan RIB, sedangkan MAC table dan STP adalah fungsi Layer 2.

pertanyaan: Which command most directly displays the IPv4 Forwarding Information Base on supporting Cisco IOS/IOS XE platforms?
opsi_a:
[cli]
show ip route
[/cli]
opsi_b:
[cli]
show mac address-table
[/cli]
opsi_c:
[cli]
show ip cef
[/cli]
opsi_d:
[cli]
show spanning-tree
[/cli]
pembahasan:
[cli]
show ip cef
[/cli]
is used to view IPv4 CEF/FIB entries. 
[cli]
show ip route
[/cli]
displays the RIB, while the MAC table and STP are Layer 2 functions.

pertanyaan: Engineer ingin melihat informasi rewrite Layer 2 yang lebih detail untuk adjacency CEF. Command mana yang paling tepat?
opsi_a:
[cli]
show adjacency detail
[/cli]
opsi_b:
[cli]
show ip protocols
[/cli]
opsi_c:
[cli]
show interfaces trunk
[/cli]
opsi_d:
[cli]
show arp statistics only
[/cli]
pembahasan:
[cli]
show adjacency detail
[/cli]
dapat menampilkan detail adjacency termasuk encapsulation/rewrite information pada platform yang mendukung. Command lain tidak secara langsung menampilkan CEF adjacency rewrite.

pertanyaan: An engineer wants to inspect more detailed Layer 2 rewrite information for CEF adjacencies. Which command is most appropriate?
opsi_a:
[cli]
show adjacency detail
[/cli]
opsi_b:
[cli]
show ip protocols
[/cli]
opsi_c:
[cli]
show interfaces trunk
[/cli]
opsi_d:

show arp statistics only
[/cli]
pembahasan:
[cli]
show adjacency detail
[/cli]
can display adjacency details including encapsulation/rewrite information on supporting platforms. The other commands do not directly display CEF adjacency rewrite data.

pertanyaan: R1 memiliki dua equal-cost next hop menuju 10.10.10.0/24. Engineer ingin mengetahui next hop CEF yang dipilih untuk source 192.168.1.10 menuju destination 10.10.10.10. Command mana yang paling tepat pada platform yang mendukungnya?
opsi_a:
[cli]
show ip route 192.168.1.10
[/cli]
opsi_b:
[cli]
show adjacency 192.168.1.10
[/cli]
opsi_c:
[cli]
show mac address-table address 10.10.10.10
[/cli]
opsi_d:
[cli]
show ip cef exact-route 192.168.1.10 10.10.10.10
[/cli]
pembahasan:
[cli]
show ip cef exact-route
[/cli]
digunakan untuk melihat hasil pemilihan CEF untuk pasangan source-destination tertentu, berguna pada ECMP. Command lain tidak menunjukkan hasil hash CEF untuk flow tersebut.

pertanyaan: R1 has two equal-cost next hops to 10.10.10.0/24. An engineer wants to determine which CEF next hop is selected for source 192.168.1.10 to destination 10.10.10.10. Which command is most appropriate on a supporting platform?
opsi_a:
[cli]
show ip route 192.168.1.10
[/cli]
opsi_b:
[cli]

[/cli]
opsi_c:

[/cli]
opsi_d:
[cli]
show ip cef exact-route 192.168.1.10 10.10.10.10
[/cli]
pembahasan:
[cli]
show ip cef exact-route
[/cli]
is used to inspect CEF path selection for a specific source-destination pair, which is useful with ECMP. The other commands do not show the CEF hash result for that flow.

pertanyaan: Pada perangkat yang mendukung command tersebut, engineer ingin memeriksa status CEF pada interface Layer 3 tertentu. Pilihan mana yang paling sesuai?

[cli]

[/cli]
opsi_b:

[/cli]
opsi_c:
[cli]
show mac address-table interface GigabitEthernet0/0
[/cli]
opsi_d:
[cli]
show spanning-tree interface GigabitEthernet0/0
[/cli]
pembahasan:
[cli]
show cef interface GigabitEthernet0/0 detail
[/cli]
memberikan informasi CEF yang terkait dengan interface pada platform yang mendukungnya. Command VLAN, MAC table, dan STP lebih berkaitan dengan switching Layer 2.

pertanyaan: On a device that supports the command, an engineer wants to check CEF status for a specific Layer 3 interface. Which choice is most appropriate?
opsi_a:
[cli]
show vlan brief
[/cli]
opsi_b:
[cli]
