[/cli]
pembahasan:
[cli]
show cef interface GigabitEthernet0/0 detail
[/cli]
provides CEF-related interface information on platforms that support it. The VLAN, MAC table, and STP commands are mainly related to Layer 2 switching.

pertanyaan: Pada IOS release yang tidak lagi mendukung IPv4 fast switching klasik, CEF dinonaktifkan untuk trafik Layer 3 yang sebelumnya CEF-switched. Dampak forwarding yang paling tepat adalah apa?
opsi_a: Trafik yang tidak dapat menggunakan CEF dapat jatuh ke process switching, sehingga beban CPU dapat meningkat
opsi_b: Routing table otomatis dihapus dan OSPF neighbor langsung down
opsi_c: Semua frame dalam VLAN yang sama berhenti diteruskan
opsi_d: Perangkat otomatis mengaktifkan cut-through switching Layer 2 sebagai pengganti
pembahasan: Pada release yang sudah menghapus IPv4 fast switching, alternatif untuk trafik yang tidak CEF-switched adalah process switching. Ini dapat meningkatkan CPU load dan menurunkan forwarding performance, sementara Layer 2 switching dalam VLAN adalah mekanisme terpisah.

pertanyaan: On an IOS release where classic IPv4 fast switching is no longer supported, CEF is disabled for Layer 3 traffic that was previously CEF-switched. What is the most accurate forwarding impact?
opsi_a: Traffic that cannot use CEF can fall back to process switching, potentially increasing CPU load
opsi_b: The routing table is automatically deleted and OSPF neighbors immediately go down
opsi_c: All frames within the same VLAN stop being forwarded
opsi_d: The device automatically enables Layer 2 cut-through switching as a replacement
pembahasan: On releases where IPv4 fast switching has been removed, traffic that is not CEF-switched can use process switching. This can increase CPU load and reduce forwarding performance, while same-VLAN Layer 2 switching is a separate mechanism.

pertanyaan:
Pada IOS klasik yang mendukung konfigurasi per-interface CEF, engineer menjalankan konfigurasi berikut pada interface ingress:
[cli]
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 no ip route-cache cef
[/cli]
Apa tujuan perubahan tersebut?
opsi_a: Menghapus seluruh routing table global
opsi_b: Menghapus semua ARP entry di interface egress
opsi_c: Menonaktifkan CEF switching untuk paket yang masuk melalui interface tersebut, sesuai perilaku platform yang mendukung command itu
opsi_d: Memaksa semua frame Layer 2 menggunakan STP blocking
pembahasan: CEF membuat keputusan forwarding pada sisi input, sehingga pada IOS klasik command per-interface tersebut digunakan untuk menonaktifkan CEF pada ingress path. Perilaku dan ketersediaan command bergantung pada platform/release, sehingga tidak boleh diasumsikan universal pada semua Catalyst modern.

pertanyaan:
On classic IOS that supports per-interface CEF configuration, an engineer applies the following on the ingress interface:
[cli]
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 no ip route-cache cef
[/cli]
What is the purpose of this change?
opsi_a: Delete the entire global routing table
opsi_b: Delete all ARP entries on the egress interface
opsi_c: Disable CEF switching for packets entering that interface, according to the behavior of platforms that support the command
opsi_d: Force all Layer 2 frames into an STP blocking state
pembahasan: CEF makes its forwarding decision on input, so on classic IOS this per-interface command is used to disable CEF on the ingress path. Command availability and behavior are platform/release dependent and should not be assumed on every modern Catalyst platform.

pertanyaan:
Pada platform IOS lama yang mendukungnya, output 
[cli]
show interfaces switching
[/cli]
menunjukkan counter Process, Cache misses, dan Fast. Arti 'Cache misses' yang paling tepat adalah apa?
opsi_a: Jumlah frame yang gagal dipelajari MAC table
opsi_b: Jumlah route yang tidak masuk ke RIB
opsi_c: Jumlah adjacency yang selalu lengkap
opsi_d: Jumlah paket yang diteruskan melalui process level karena tidak menemukan entry fast-switching cache
pembahasan: Pada konteks switching path klasik, cache miss berarti paket tidak menemukan entry pada fast-switching cache dan harus diteruskan melalui process level. Counter ini tidak berkaitan dengan MAC learning atau jumlah route di RIB.

pertanyaan:
On an older IOS platform that supports it, 
[cli]
show interfaces switching
[/cli]
shows Process, Cache misses, and Fast counters. What does 'Cache misses' most accurately mean?
opsi_a: The number of frames that failed MAC-table learning
opsi_b: The number of routes that failed to enter the RIB
opsi_c: The number of adjacencies that are always complete
opsi_d: The number of packets forwarded through the process level because no fast-switching cache entry was found
pembahasan: In the classic switching-path context, a cache miss means the packet did not find a fast-switching cache entry and had to be handled at the process level. This counter is not about MAC learning or the number of RIB routes.

pertanyaan:
Potongan ilustrasi R1 menunjukkan:
[output]
R1# show ip cef 10.20.0.0/16
10.20.0.0/16
  nexthop 192.0.2.2 GigabitEthernet0/0

R1# show adjacency GigabitEthernet0/0
Protocol Interface            Address
IP       GigabitEthernet0/0   192.0.2.2(incomplete)
[/output]
Apa pemeriksaan berikutnya yang paling relevan?
opsi_a: Memeriksa STP root bridge VLAN yang tidak terkait
opsi_b: Memeriksa ARP/neighbor resolution menuju 192.0.2.2 dan konektivitas Layer 2 pada Gi0/0
opsi_c: Menghapus route 10.20.0.0/16 karena FIB pasti salah
opsi_d: Mengubah destination IP aplikasi menjadi 192.0.2.2
pembahasan: FIB sudah menunjukkan jalur Layer 3, tetapi adjacency next hop belum lengkap. Karena itu fokus troubleshooting adalah ARP/neighbor resolution dan reachability Layer 2 menuju 192.0.2.2, bukan menghapus route yang sudah ada.

pertanyaan:
The following illustrative output is shown on R1:
[output]
R1# show ip cef 10.20.0.0/16
10.20.0.0/16
  nexthop 192.0.2.2 GigabitEthernet0/0

R1# show adjacency GigabitEthernet0/0
Protocol Interface            Address
IP       GigabitEthernet0/0   192.0.2.2(incomplete)
[/output]
What is the most relevant next check?
opsi_a: Check the STP root bridge for an unrelated VLAN
opsi_b: Check ARP/neighbor resolution for 192.0.2.2 and Layer 2 connectivity on Gi0/0
opsi_c: Delete the 10.20.0.0/16 route because the FIB must be wrong
opsi_d: Change the application's destination IP to 192.0.2.2
pembahasan: The FIB already identifies the Layer 3 path, but the next-hop adjacency is incomplete. Troubleshooting should therefore focus on ARP/neighbor resolution and Layer 2 reachability to 192.0.2.2 rather than deleting an existing route.

pertanyaan: Multilayer switch memiliki SVI VLAN10 192.168.10.1/24 dan VLAN20 192.168.20.1/24. PC10 mengirim trafik ke PC20, dan FIB serta adjacency untuk destination sudah valid. Jalur forwarding utama apa yang digunakan?
opsi_a: Inter-VLAN Layer 3 forwarding menggunakan CEF, lalu frame egress di-rewrite sesuai adjacency
opsi_b: Hanya MAC address table karena kedua host berada pada switch fisik yang sama
opsi_c: Process switching wajib karena trafik melewati dua SVI
opsi_d: Fast switching wajib dibuat lebih dulu walaupun CEF lengkap
pembahasan: Perpindahan antara VLAN10 dan VLAN20 membutuhkan routing Layer 3. Dengan CEF aktif serta FIB/adjacency valid, perangkat menggunakan CEF untuk memilih jalur dan melakukan Layer 2 rewrite pada egress.

pertanyaan: A multilayer switch has SVI VLAN10 192.168.10.1/24 and VLAN20 192.168.20.1/24. PC10 sends traffic to PC20, and the FIB and adjacency information are valid. What is the primary forwarding path?
opsi_a: Inter-VLAN Layer 3 forwarding uses CEF, then the egress frame is rewritten according to the adjacency
opsi_b: Only the MAC address table is used because both hosts are connected to the same physical switch
opsi_c: Process switching is required because traffic crosses two SVIs
opsi_d: Fast switching must be built first even though CEF is complete
pembahasan: Moving between VLAN10 and VLAN20 requires Layer 3 routing. With CEF enabled and valid FIB/adjacency information, the device uses CEF to select the path and perform the Layer 2 rewrite on egress.

pertanyaan:
Engineer melihat route 203.0.113.0/24 pada 
[cli]
show ip route
[/cli]
tetapi tidak menemukan entry yang diharapkan pada 
[cli]
show ip cef 203.0.113.0/24
[/cli]
Apa kesimpulan troubleshooting terbaik sebelum melakukan perubahan?
opsi_a: Routing table tidak relevan terhadap CEF, jadi kondisi ini selalu normal
opsi_b: Langsung hapus routing protocol karena FIB tidak pernah mengikuti RIB
opsi_c: Verifikasi status CEF dan konsistensi RIB-to-FIB/platform karena route di RIB seharusnya menjadi dasar forwarding state jika eligible
opsi_d: Clear seluruh MAC address table karena itu pasti penyebabnya
pembahasan: RIB adalah sumber penting untuk membangun FIB, sehingga ketidaksesuaian yang tidak diharapkan perlu diverifikasi sebagai masalah CEF, eligibility, atau sinkronisasi platform. Menghapus routing protocol atau MAC table tanpa diagnosis lebih lanjut terlalu agresif dan belum menjawab penyebab.

pertanyaan:
An engineer sees 203.0.113.0/24 in 
[cli]
show ip route
[/cli]
but does not find the expected entry in 
[cli]
show ip cef 203.0.113.0/24
[/cli]
What is the best troubleshooting conclusion before making changes?
opsi_a: The routing table is unrelated to CEF, so this is always normal
opsi_b: Immediately remove the routing protocol because the FIB never follows the RIB
opsi_c: Verify CEF status and RIB-to-FIB/platform consistency because an eligible RIB route should normally form forwarding state
opsi_d: Clear the entire MAC address table because it must be the cause
pembahasan: The RIB is an important source for building the FIB, so an unexpected mismatch should be investigated as a CEF, eligibility, or platform-synchronization issue. Removing the routing protocol or MAC table without further diagnosis is too aggressive and does not identify the cause.

pertanyaan: Pada platform modern yang hanya menyediakan IPv4 CEF dan process switching, engineer sengaja menonaktifkan CEF saat trafik transit sangat tinggi. Setelah itu CPU naik drastis tetapi routing table tetap benar. Penjelasan mana yang paling tepat?
opsi_a: Routing table yang benar menjamin hardware forwarding tetap aktif
opsi_b: Tanpa CEF, trafik Layer 3 dapat jatuh ke process switching sehingga CPU menangani jauh lebih banyak paket
opsi_c: CPU naik karena semua MAC address harus dipelajari oleh OSPF
opsi_d: CEF hanya memengaruhi control plane, jadi kenaikan CPU pasti tidak terkait
pembahasan: Routing table dapat tetap benar walaupun forwarding path berubah. Jika CEF tidak tersedia dan fast switching klasik tidak didukung, trafik transit dapat menjadi process-switched dan membebani CPU.

pertanyaan: On a modern platform that provides IPv4 CEF and process switching but not classic fast switching, an engineer intentionally disables CEF during heavy transit traffic. CPU utilization rises sharply while the routing table remains correct. Which explanation is most accurate?
opsi_a: A correct routing table guarantees that hardware forwarding remains active
opsi_b: Without CEF, Layer 3 traffic can fall to process switching, causing the CPU to handle far more packets
opsi_c: The CPU rises because all MAC addresses must be learned by OSPF
opsi_d: CEF affects only the control plane, so the CPU increase cannot be related
pembahasan: The routing table can remain correct even when the forwarding path changes. If CEF is unavailable and classic fast switching is not supported, transit traffic can become process-switched and heavily load the CPU.

pertanyaan: R1 memiliki FIB yang benar menuju 10.30.30.0/24, tetapi adjacency next hop menunjukkan rewrite MAC yang diduga stale setelah perangkat next hop diganti. Tindakan troubleshooting mana yang paling tepat terlebih dahulu?
opsi_a: Ubah prefix di routing protocol agar berbeda
opsi_b: Nonaktifkan seluruh routing pada R1
opsi_c: Tambahkan static route ke destination yang sama tanpa memeriksa neighbor
opsi_d: Verifikasi ARP dan adjacency untuk next hop, lalu refresh entry neighbor/adjacency secara terkontrol jika memang stale
pembahasan: Masalah berada pada resolusi Layer 2 next hop, bukan pada pemilihan prefix FIB. Karena itu verifikasi ARP dan adjacency lebih tepat sebelum melakukan perubahan routing yang tidak diperlukan.

pertanyaan: R1 has a correct FIB entry to 10.30.30.0/24, but the next-hop adjacency shows a rewrite MAC suspected to be stale after the next-hop device was replaced. What is the best first troubleshooting action?
opsi_a: Change the routing-protocol prefix to a different network
opsi_b: Disable all routing on R1
opsi_c: Add another static route to the same destination without checking the neighbor
opsi_d: Verify ARP and adjacency for the next hop, then refresh the neighbor/adjacency entry in a controlled way if it is truly stale
pembahasan: The problem is in Layer 2 next-hop resolution rather than FIB prefix selection. Verifying ARP and adjacency is therefore more appropriate than making unnecessary routing changes.

pertanyaan: Setelah perubahan konfigurasi, sebuah multilayer switch menunjukkan gejala berikut: inter-VLAN traffic menjadi lambat dan CPU tinggi, tetapi traffic PC-to-PC dalam VLAN yang sama tetap normal. Ditemukan CEF untuk IPv4 tidak aktif. Tindakan korektif paling logis adalah apa?
opsi_a: Pulihkan CEF sesuai dukungan platform dan verifikasi FIB/adjacency untuk trafik Layer 3
opsi_b: Hapus seluruh MAC address table karena same-VLAN traffic membuktikan tabel rusak
opsi_c: Nonaktifkan semua SVI agar CPU turun
opsi_d: Ubah seluruh access port menjadi routed port
pembahasan: Gejala memisahkan fungsi Layer 2 dan Layer 3: same-VLAN switching tetap normal, sedangkan routed traffic terdampak karena CEF tidak aktif. Memulihkan CEF dan memverifikasi FIB/adjacency menangani akar masalah tanpa mengganggu switching Layer 2 yang sudah bekerja.

pertanyaan: After a configuration change, a multilayer switch shows the following symptoms: inter-VLAN traffic is slow and CPU utilization is high, while PC-to-PC traffic within the same VLAN remains normal. IPv4 CEF is found to be disabled. What is the most logical corrective action?
opsi_a: Restore CEF according to platform support and verify the FIB/adjacency for Layer 3 traffic
opsi_b: Clear the entire MAC address table because normal same-VLAN traffic proves it is corrupt
opsi_c: Disable all SVIs to reduce CPU utilization
opsi_d: Convert every access port into a routed port
pembahasan: The symptoms separate Layer 2 and Layer 3 functions: same-VLAN switching still works, while routed traffic is affected because CEF is disabled. Restoring CEF and verifying the FIB/adjacency addresses the root cause without disrupting Layer 2 switching that is already functioning.
